bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zer/mgon po skyabs kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

klad kyi gtam/ klad kyi gtam/da lam tshe rig 'dzin pa mgon po skyabs kyis lo shas ring snga rjes su spel ba'i dpyad rtsom gces rigs khag phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas 〈bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zer〉 zhes pa'i deb 'di dngos su par skrun 'grem spel byas pa 'dis bod lugs gso rig gi bya bar don gnyer byed mkhan rnams la phan pa chen po 'byung ba ma zad/ gangs ljongs gso rig bstan pa'i bya gzhag la zhabs phyi bla na med pa 'grub rgyu'i yid ches dang / slad mar yang 'di dang 'di lta bu'i dpyad rtsom gang mang gang legs spel thub pa'i re ba bcas/bod ljongs bod lugs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge ming 'dzin pa gus dga' ba'i rdo rjes spyi lo2007lo'i zla4ba'i tshes12nyin/

dkar chagadakar chagakha ba cwan gyi ljongs 'dir dus nam zhig la 'gro ba mi'i zhabs rjes bkod pa dang gso rig gi myu gu 'bus pa'i skor che long tsam brjod pa/ (1)mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog nas gso ba rig par zhib 'jug bgyis pa'i skor phran tsam brjod pa/ (12)grub thob ril dkar gyi sbyor sde dang sbyor ming sogs la tog tsam dpyad pa bzhin ras gsal ba'i me long/ (30)bod lugs gso rig gi sdeb sbyor rig pa nub lugs gso rig gibusmosayi lam lugs la skyod bzhin pa'i khrod kyi dogs gnad 'ga'/ (slo)glo srin nad kyi brtag bcos skor ches mdor bsdus su bkod pa lhag bsam nyi ma'i 'od snang / (55)khrag rlung stod 'tshangs nad kyi brtag bcos skor mdo tsam gleng ba/ (73)bod sman gyi sman rdzas rig pa'i do dam skor gyi bsam gzhig thor bu/ (86)rngabs rwa dang zangs bum la thog ma'i dpyad pa na mnyam dgyes pa'i 'phrin bzang / (102)hor me dang spra ldan gser khab kyi phan nus rags tsam gleng ba gzhan dbang gso ba'i bdud rtsi/ (116)

st+waṃb('i010spru〉 0sa 116khurdu'i0 21khuskye1dzu10khugrub pa lus kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dam 'dzin byas te mu mthud du 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos pa'i skor phran tsam gleng ba/ (126)bad kan mgul 'gags dang smug po pho bar babs pa gnyis la brtag bcos byas pa'i myong tshor phran bu/ (136)khu lung srog chags dang ed ci'i nad gnyis la bod lugs gso rig gi steng nas ches thog ma'i bgro gleng blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig (1yo)bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyi byung 'phel dang de'i khyad chos tsam brjod pa log smra'i smra sgo gcod pa'i ral gri/ (161)da rgan nad kyi brtag bcos bla ma'i dgongs rgyan/ (184)grum bu'i nad kyi ngos 'dzin dang bcos thabs tsam brjod pa nyi gzhon bsu ba'i skya rengs/ (195)bod lugs gso rig gi shes rig bdag dbang skor gleng ba bden gtam dbyar gyi rnga gsang / (215)man ngag rin chen ril bu'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang de'i phan nus tsam brjod pa bla ma'i zhal lung / (76)khu ba dang klad pa bsam bse'u bcas kyi 'brel ba'i skor phran tsam gleng ba (skra8)bod yig ni bod lugs gso rig gi gyang rting ngam srog shing yin pa'i skor phran tsam brjod pa bden gtam mtsho byung lha mo'i pi wang / (2slo)mjug gi gtam/ (257)

st+waṃs(smo010spru| 0sa rwa16dzirdumib 7khu71khukrodzikha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir dus nam zhig la 'gro ba mi'i zhabs rjes bkod pa dang gso rig gi myu gu 'bus pa'i skor che long tsam brjod pa/dang po/ 'gro ba mi'i mes po kha ba can gyi yul nas byung zhing mched pa'i skor/krung go'i lo rgyus su pe cin kro'o kho'i mi byung nas lo khri 20 nas 70tsam song 'dug zer ba'ang yul de nas thon pa'i mi'i mgo bo 'gyur rdor gyur yod pa zhig gzhir bzung ste bshad pa yin/ mi de'i mgo bo'i che chung da lta'i mi'i mgo bo'i che chung las med cing / klad pa'i grub cha'i tshad da lta'i mi'i klad pa'i grub cha las nyung / de na da nas rtsis pa'i bgrang bya khri 20nas70lhag gi snga rol gyi mi'i lus kyi bongs tshad da lta'i mi dang 'dra ba shugs las rtogs thub/ rang cag kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir dus nam zhig mi'i rigs byung zer na/ nga tshos kyang gong gi rigs lam 'di spyad nas yul 'dir gdod ma'i mi yi lus kyi grub cha'am yan lag gi rjes shul sogs bkod yod par gzhi bcol te/ gang gleng bar bya ba'i gtam gyi mgo brtsam 1

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskazhing der rang blos ci lcogs kyis dbye zhib bgyis mthar sdom tshig 'god rgyu de yin/ de yang reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyi dpyad rtsom zhig tu bod kyi mes po ni ya gling gi nang nas ches 'byung snga ba zhig yin zhing / mi rigs gzhan pa'i mes po rnams kyang yul 'di nas gshegs pa bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther du mngon par gsal bas/ ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis phyogs lhung bral ba'i ngang nas zhib 'jug don du gnyer na rngo thogs pa'i bden lugs rnyed thub pa zhig yong nges yin zhes pa ni drang bden gyi bka' mchid zhig tu mngon/ de na rang re'i chab mdo'i mkhar ro'i nye 'dabs kyi brag ngos shig na gna' mi'i rkang rjes shig 'dug cing / de'i ring tshad du rmi1 2gda'/ yang chab mdo'i dpal zhod rdzong gi brag phug cig gi nang na mi'i rkang rjes gcig yod cing de'i ring tshad la rmi0 4nas0 6tsam mchis/dpal zhod rdzong gi rkang rjes 'di ni yul de'i dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du o rgyan padma 'byung gnas gnam nas sar phebs skabs kyi zhabs rjes yin par bshad/ gong gi che chung mi 'dra ba'i rkang rjes gnyis las cung rtogs thub pa ni dus rabs mi 'dra ba'i skabs kyi gang zag mi gnyis kyi rkang rjes yin pa mtshon/ lo khri20nas70lhag gi sngon rol gyi mi'i che chung da lta'i mi dang mtshungs pa gong las brjod zin pas/ dpal zhod rdzong du yod pa'i rkang rjes ni da lta'i mi zhig gi rkang rjes dang bsdur thabs med pas yul de ru byung ba'i mi la ma mtha' yang lo khri20nas70lhag gi lo rgyus yod pa smros med yin/ mkhar ro'i nye 'dabs kyi rkang rjes de ni de las kyang ldab 'gyur 2

st+waṃsardusmo0102to 0ba 116rdu(mis 7rduzu1khu10rdutsam gyis che bas yul de ru byung ba'i mir de las lhag pa'i lo rgyus mchis pa ngang ngam shugs kyis rtogs/ gzhan yang yon nan yon mo'i mi yang yul 'di'i rigs rgyud las chad par snang ste/ de yang bod mi bu gdong drug gi khongs su gtogs pa'i ldong gi rgyud pa rnams khu nu ri bo gtsor byas pa'i lis caja.ogo)chu bo'i 'gram brgyud du chags shing / yun ring 'gor rjes lis cang chu bo'i 'gram gyi bod pa rnams mi rigs yan gar ba rer gyur/ tha na yon nan khon min (lpokhyeṭhatsho) grong khyer gyi ming yang bod skad gangs mi yi sgra gdangs zur chags nas thon pa ni gro zhin dbyi(྾3khuciṭha)yis brtsams pa'i bod dang snang gshen mi rigs kyi 'brel ba(྾shā.oṃshwepo༅〉oṃlkolko4)zhes pa'i deb tu/ khu nu ri bo'i brgyud du to mi zhes pa'i mi rigs shig 'dug cing / mi rigs de rim bzhin lis cang chu bo'i nye 'gram brgyud nas gang sar khyab ces dang / yang de las snang gshen mi rigs kyi skad du khon(ṭha)zhes pa gangs gyi don dang mi(bye.oṃ)zhes pa mi yi don du go bas khon mi ni gangs mi yi don la 'jug ces bkod 'dug par dbye zhib tsam bgyis na/ thang yig gsar ma las/ to mi(7spyo.oṃ)ni nub 'jang yin/ bod kyi rigs su gtogs/ nag mi yang zer zhes pa las thad kar rtogs thub pa ni rgya nag gi yig tshang rnams su bkod pa'i to mi ni bod kyi rus su gtogs/sgra gdangs de ni bod skad kyi ldong mi'i gdangs dang ches mtshungs par ma zad/ smug po ldong gi rgyud pa'ang gnas 'di dag tu khyab yod pa gling sgrung du gsal bas/ rgya nag skad kyi to mi ni rang re'i skad kyi ldong mi yi don yin 3

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskapa rang gzhan gnyis kyi rigs lam nas bsgrub thub/ khon mi yi sgra gdangs la kro zhin dbyi yis snang gshen mi rigs kyi skad gzhir bzung nas dpyad mod/ dpyad 'bras de'i shugs las khon mi yi ming yang bod skad gangs mi yi sgra gdangs zur chags nas byung ba shes thub/ yon mo'i mi yang lis cang chu bo'i nye 'gram du byung zhing gnas de ni da lta dbyi rigs gzhis sdod byed sa'i lte bar gyur/ dbyi rigs ni bod yin pa kho tsho'i ngag rgyun du mes po spre'u yin zer zhing spre'ur a yis zer/ a yis zhes pa mes por go bas gsal/ de ni bod kyi yul mang shas shig tu ming gcig grub byed kyi yi ge de'i cha shas kyis ming hril bo'i don mtshon par bya ste/ dper na sbra lta bur mtshon na a mdo'i 'brog skad du ra dang rong skad du sba zer/ yang sprul la 'brog skad du rul dang rong skad du bul zer/ spun la yul kha shas su sun dang yul kha shas su pun zer/ de bzhin a myes zhes par yul kha shas su myes kyi ya btags med par byas nas a mes zer ba dang yul kha shas su ma med par byas nas a yes zer bas so// gzhan kho tshor yab mes nas brgyud pa'i gzhas shig tu(dzeetsāṣpesmo)rang rigs ni ldong gi rgyud pa yin zhing khu nu ri bo nas gnas 'dir lhag pa'i lo rgyus sogs gda'/ (dzeetsākhri.a)zhesapa'i gzhas kyi ming yang bod skad kyi sgra zur chags par bsam ste/ de ni rgya nag gi yig tshang rnams su bod la(zi)dang(rsā)zer/ dper na rgya yig gi mi nyag lo rgyus su (༅ṭwā4rṣa) lha ‘‘ṭhaṭhaṣṭhakṣadzeeṭha’’ zhes bkod yod pas rgya skad ྾phyo)ni kha ba can gyi yul ming bod ces pa'i don dang / (nyakhri)zhes pa 4

st+waṃbardustu010sprukau 0sa 116dzirduskyab sa1khuzu1dzu1godzibod kyi rus tshan rlangs kyi sgra 'gyur bar bsam/ de ni sngon gyi rgya nag gi yig tshang rnams su bod ces parsārsā)dang yang na yi ge de'i gzugs dang phal cher 'dra ba'i hphan(stsu)zhes bris 'dug pa bzhin/ rlangs ni rgya yig gi sgra gdangs nas(4ṣpe)zhes bris par yi ge de'i gzugs dang nye ba'i(tsākhri)la 'gyur bar bsam/ de na gzhas 'di'i ming ni bod rigs rlangs pa'i gzhas zhes pa bsdus nas bod rlangs gzhas zhes par 'gyur snyam/ yang kho tsho'i mi rabs nas mi rabs bar brgyud pa'i zangs rnga'i gzhas su 〈sloskyasmo〉 rsā’’lkommurki’ ṭhaṣṭhaṣṭhaṭhawaṃ’ 7lguṭhawaṃkremi ྾tho.alha4’ rnyestusaulkocipaṃ 7ṣṭhaṣṭhalkormi’ oṃrtsaṭhawaṃkre’ kloṣṭhakṣu༈oṃX da skya⑫dku 〈rsāmme.oṃ4spro〉 ‘‘dbyi rigs mes po rnams/ khu nu ri bor gnas/ brjid chags khu nu ri/ sngo ljang rtswa yis rgyan/ mes pos rta nor 'tsho/ 'brog gi 'tsho ba rol/gna' bo'i khu nu ri/ gang sar nor lug khyab/ ’’ ces pa'i dum tshan zhig 'dug pa sogs las kyang gdod ma'i dus nas ldong gi rgyud pa rnams gnas de dag tu khyab yod pa rtogs thub/gong gi snang tshul 'di rnams las 'o skol la tshor snang gson po zhig sbyin thub pa ni chab mdo'i mkhar ro'i rkang rjes de ni go la zlum po'i khyon 'dir mthong chos su dkon pas/ 'gro ba mi'i zhabs rjes ches thog mar gnas 'di ru bzhag 'dra'i snang ba ster thub/ de na krung go nas lo rgyus ches ring ba'i mi ni yon nan yon mo'i mi yin zhing / yon mo'i mi yang gnas 'di'i rigs rgyud las mched pa dag yin/ lhag par rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las/5

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska'abangs kyi mi rabs la 'byung ba rnam pa lnga'i snying bo las sgo nga chen po gcig yong ba/ phyi'i sgong shun la/ lha brag dkar po chags/ nang gi sgong chu la/ dung mtsho dkar mor 'khyil/ bar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha la/ rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ sgo nga phrum gyi bco brgyad chags/ sgo nga bco brgyad de dung sgong gcig tu yar nas byung / de ni smon pa'i mi bo lum lum yin/ zhes ya thog mi'i rgyud pa smon pa'i mi bo lum lum du ngos bzung /gzhan blon po bka'i thang yig las/ rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs bcal ba na// ri nag dgu 'das pha rol gangs ti se// gangs ri'i byang ngos ri bo spos ngad ldan// de gnyis bar na ma dros mtsho chen yod// ces dang yang de las phyogs bzhi dag na sems can kha 'dra bzhi// chu bo chen po bzhi ni phyogs bzhir 'bab// shar phyogs glang chen kha nas gaṅga 'bab// dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing ma dros bskor// chu brag lnga brgyar bcas nas shar mtshor 'bab// lho khyung 'dra ba'i kha nas sindha 'bab// baiḍūrya yi bye ma 'dren cing bskor// nub phyogs rta yi kha nas pakṣu 'bab// shel gyi bye ma 'dren cing sngar bzhin bskor// zhes thog mar 'gro ba mi'i 'byung khungs 'chad skabs smon pa'i mi bo lum lum gyi zhabs rjes bkod gnas kha ba can gyi yul yin par ngos bzung / yang de las/ dga' ldan lha yi yul nas lha bu gnyis//me tog u dum wā rar brdzus nas skyes// tsan dan dri ma med pa zhes bya dang // sruraya dri ma med pa zhes bya la// 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi rnams mched pa'o// zhes kha ba can gyi yul 'di nas rang re'i bod pa tsam gyi mes po ma 6

sa0('i010spru〉 0go 116dzirdu'i0 krokhu71dzu1khridzizad 'dzam bu gling gi mi'i mes po rnams yul so sor mched pa gsal bor bstan 'dug pa'ang bden don gyi 'bel gtam zhig tu mchis/ yang phyobs gzhan zhig nas bshad na rang re'i snga rabs pa'i gzhung mang che bar pur rgyal bod mi'i mes po spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ga nas 'khrungs pa'i pha spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin mo gnyis 'dus pa las byung zhes pa'i brjod tshul 'di dang / rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las 'gro ba mi'i mes po smon pa'i mi bo lum lum yin zhes pa gnyis la ji lta bu'i 'brel ba 'dug ce na/ bdag gi bsam gzhigs su spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang smon pa'i mi bo lum lum gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs tsam las gang zag gcig tu ngos bzung na 'grig de ni spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang smon pa'i mi bo lum lum gnyis 'jig rten mi yul du byon pa'i brgyud rim gyi lta ba gnyis gcig mtshungs yin zhing / byon gnas yang yul kha ba can du ngos 'dzin pa'i lta tshul gnyis gcig mtshungs yin/ gang zag de las rim bzhin bod mi bu gdong drug gi rgyud pa 'phel tshul gyi go rim yang gcig mtshungs yin pa bcas so//gnyis pa/ yul 'dir dus nam zhig la gso rig gi myu gu 'bus pa'i skor bshad pa/'dzam gling gso rig lo rgyus su mi dang na tsha gnyis lhan du byung zhes bkod 'dug cing / krung go'i gso rig lo rgyus ched mkhas sku zhabs khrin 7 —

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kunda dasas pa'i zla zeskayis sa'i go la'i steng 'gro ba mi'i 'gul skyod byung ba dang lhan gso rig gi myu gu yang 'bus mgo brtsams zhes 'chad/ skabs 'di'i gso rig ni gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang ba zhig gtan nas min la/ na tshar sman pa'i sman dpyad kyi rigs kyang myong goms kyi khrod nas rnyed pa tsam re yin/ dper na ltogs skom gyis mnar tshe zas skom 'tshol zhing / brgyud rim de'i khrod nas rdzas gang dag za rung zhing gang dag za mi rung ba'i shes rtogs byung / de dang lhan du rdzas gang dag gis na zug gang zhi ba'i blo phran tsam re rnyed pa de ni gso rig gi myu gu 'bus mgo brtsams pa'i dus yin/ dus skabs 'di nas bzung yul khams der skad brda ri mor bkod pa'i dus de yi ge byung ba'i dus kyi yun du/ yul de nas na tshar 'thab rtsod byed pa'i thabs sogs spyi sdom rgyab ste yi ger bkod cing / de nas bzung yul de'i gso rig gi ma lag cha tshang ba'i lam du zhugs mgo brtsams/ dus yun nges can zhig song rjes kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin rgyu'i gzhung lugs shig grub pa'i dus de ni gso rig gi gzhung lugs grub pa'i dus la ngos bzung na 'os/de na rang re'i ba tshor dus nam zhig nas bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung lugs grub zer na/ bgrang bya sum stong dgu brgya'i sngon rol tu dpal ldan 'bum bzhi 'khrungs pa der kun gyis ngos 'dzin byed/ skabs de'i 'bum bzhi ni nye lam nga tsho'i mthong chos su gyur ba'i 'bum bzhi 'di gtan nas yin mi srid/ 'on kyang ches thog ma'i 'bum bzhi de yang phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhung lugs shig yin pa ma zad/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'khrungs byed 8

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprushā 0ba 116༷(30 kroXskye1khumordukyi sa bon du 'khums/ de ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i brjod bya gtso bo 'jig rten gyi dngos po yod tshad 'byung lnga'am 'byung bzhis grub pa'i rig pa de yin zhing / de rnams gang zag gi lus steng nas gang la gang mkho ltar cha ma snyoms pas 'du ba 'khrugs par gyur/ 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i gang zag der gso bcos bya skabs gang zad pa gso zhing 'phel ba bri bar byed pa'i bya thabs spyad/ 'di ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi gtso byas pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin/ bod lugs gso rig gi brjod gzhir gyur ba'i lta ba 'di dus nam zhig gangs can pa tsho'i blo ngor 'khrungs zer na/ ma mtha' yang yul khams 'dir gshen bon gyi bstan pa ma dar gong gi sngon rol du 'dug dper na rdol bon sogs kyi skabs rang nyid kyi 'go ba'i lhar dmar mchod byed cing / ri mtho sa nas rlung rta bskyod pa'i srol mchis/ rlung rta skyod don yang 'go ba'i lhar skyabs bcol sgos rang lus kyi 'byung ba'i khams gang bri yod pa de gso ba'i cho ga zhig yin/ rlung rta'i ngos kyi stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi bos go rim ltar rlung sa me chu bcas mtshon/ ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul ni ljon shing la yang zhing g.yo ba'i cha che zhing ljon shing mang po 'dus par nags tshal zer/ nags tshal gyi khrod na ches dbang thang btsan pa ni stag yin pas stag gis rlung mtshon/'byung ba chung ba'i gras su rlung tshab tu shing 'jog don yang shing la yang g.yo'i mtshan nyin ldan pas so// sa'i snying bor ri rgyal rnams brtsi zhing ri rgyal rnams las ches mtho zhing brjid nyams ldan pa gangs kyi ri bo rnams 9

st+waṃgo(smo010sprushā 0ba 116dzirdumi0 krokhuzu1khu10khu'abyungabuzhes dang bee sngon las kyang me tog gi dbyibs dkar po dmar po ser po sngon po sogs bzhi bo kun gyi lo rkang ljang gu ral gri'i dbyibs can rkang dang lo ma sogs spu che zhing / me tog gi bzo dbyibs rgya men 'dra ba'i nang gi 'bru mdog du kha shas che ba'i khrod du dkar dmar ser sngo sogs ci rigs 'dres pa che chung yung dkar nas sro ma'i bar byung bduzhes dang /gzhung gzhan rnams su skyes gnas kyang mtho ba'i sribs ri yin pa gsal bor bstan/ 'on kyang dge chos kyis mdzad pa'i shing dang me tog sogs kyi ngos 'dzin dang ngos ji ltar 'phrod tshul skor du padma la rigs mang du mchis shing / chu las skyes pa nyid shas che/ 'dab ma rnams ni zla phyed dang zlum po sogs ci rigs pa chu'i kha la g.yeng ste sdod/ me tog chu khar 'thor te pad ma'i rigs kha shas mtshan mo kha phye ba la ku mud dar 'bod/ padma sngon po ni utpal nyid yin pas 'di gnyis rigs zur pa ci yang ma yin/ padma'i me tog che chung rigs mang du mchis shing / 'dab ma yang dbyibs sne zhib pa'i grwa la dmar mdangs chags pa ste/ padma'i spyan bya ba'i padma de yin cing /rang re'i yul gyi shing phran la skyes pa'i padmar grags pa de dag ma yin/'di'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs kyang mig dang 'dra/ zur la dmar mdangs chags pa yang mig dang 'dra/ rgya nag gi dkar yol steng du ri mo 'di mang du yod pa de yin/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi padma 'ga' zhig gi rigs ni yu ba dmar skya mdzub mo tsam pa'i steng du tsher ma dmar po sor phyed tsam pa dag gis g.yogs pas lag pas kyang 'dzin mi nus/ shing gi tsher ma ye khyad mi 19

st+waṃs(smo010spru〉 00 116khu(mi0 krokhuzu1dzu10khudog de kho na 'dug padma'i rtsa ba dkar po byis pa'i lag ngar tsam pa yod pa zhig rgya gar ba rnams kyis mar la brngos nas tshod mar byed/ ro 'o cag gi tshod dkar mthun pa zhig 'dug (11)ces gsungs pa 'di dang shel gong phreng sogs nas gsungs pa'i utpal sngon po gnyis skyes dbyibs dang skyes gnas che chung sogs tha dad du snang bas gang zhig 'thad ldan du 'dzin rgyu snyam tshe bdag gis 'di lta bu'i sdom tshig cig 'jog par 'dod de/ de yang lha mo'i tshul khrims tshang gis kyang snyan gzhung me long ma ru bkod pa'i mig zung utpal sngon po bzhin zhes bud med mdzes ma'i mig gi sgeg nyams skabs kyi dpe de dang rang re'i sman gzhung du bkod pa'i utpal sngon po gnyis so sor 'dug me long ma ru drangs pa'i utpal sngon po ni rang re'i yul na 'khrungs mang pa'i me tog lug mig ste ming gzhan rgyal ba'i spyan zer ba de yin 'dug gsungs/ me tog lug mig ni shel phreng las/ lug mig la rigs mang yang skabs 'dir dgos pa ni sngon ngo/ rgyal ba'i spyan can yin la/ming ni rgyal ba'i spyan can/ nī la utpal/ blon po dngu9/ mdog go slad/utpal ral gri ma/ ral gri'i 'khor lo/ 'dab sngon stong ldan/sgrol sngon stong 'khor/ lug skyes ma'i mig a byag sngon po rnams zer zhes dang /'khrungs dper/ lug mig na spang nyin srib skye// lo ma sngo skya chung la sgor//sdong bo smug la ring ba yin// me tog utpal 'dab stong ldan// 'dab ma sngo la ge sar ser// ro ni cung zad kha ba yin// rgyal ba'i spyan zhes bya ba yin//zhes dang / lcags phreng las kyang / nī la utpal snyoms pa yinayizhes 21

pod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagazhung snga ma rnams su me tog lug mig gam rgyal ba'i spyan can de'i ming gzhan du utpal zer bzhin pa gsal/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i spyan la utpal zhes ming 'dogs don ni de gnyis la che chung tsam yod pa las skye dbyibs dang kha dog gcig mtshungs su mchis pas de bzhin brjod mod/ de gnyis kyi ro nus zhu rjes rnams tha dad du mchis te/ dper na/ utpal gyi ro mngar zhing cung bska ba'i rnam pa can dang zhu rjes mngar bar zhu/ nus pa lci zhing bsil la glo dang mchin pa'i tsha ba sogs tshad pa'i nad rigs kun sel bar byed/ rgyal ba'i spyan can gyi ro kha zhing zhu rjes kyang kha bar zhu/nus pa bsil zhing dug dang rims tshad sel bar byed/ bai sngon dang shel gong phreng sogs nas ngos 'dzin gnang ba'i utpal sngon po de'i ro nus zhu rjes rnams dge chos lags nas gsungs pa'i padma'i rigs bye brag pa de'i ro nus dang gcig mtshugs su mchis pas de bzhin brjod/ de ltar brjod dgos don yang utpal 'di nyid sman du spyod sgo che zhing spyod sgo che ba'i sman 'di rang re'i gangs can pa'i yul tu mi 'khrungs pas de'i tshab tu ro nus zhu rjes rnams de dang yongs su mthun pa zhig la ming de btags shing sman gyi lag len skabs bkol spyod bgyis par bsam/ dper na po ta la yang rgya gar lho phyogs kyi siṅga lar yod pa'i spyan ras gzigs dngos su bzhugs pa'i gnas shig yin par bshad pa la/ de'i ming pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal bo'i bzhugs gnas po brang dmar por btags pa lta bu/ de ltar 'dogs don yang pho brang dmar po'i ri de'i chags dbyibs po ta lar mtshungs shing der 22

rlubardusmo0102smo 0sa rwa16rdurdumi0 7༷61khu1godziches thog mar bzhugs mkhan yang bod rgyal so gnyis pa srong btsan sgam po yin pa dang / khong nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul dngos yin pas so//gzhan gzhung de ru a shwa tha ste byang chub shing gi skyes dbyibs dang de'i che chung sogs gsal bor bkod cing / dzambu'i sdong bo zer ba yang dbus gtsang bas ku shu dang mdo smad pas chang ba lir 'bod pa'i sil tog de'i sdong bo yin par ngos bzung / a sho ka yang a mdo'i kha skad du 'o'u rje'u zer ba de e yin snyam zhes gsungs/ da rung tambura'i 'khru shing dang ta la'i sdong bo/ srin bu padma can/ a ma'i sdong bo dang de'i me tog 'bras bu bcas kyi dbyibs dang che chung sogs gzhan dang mi nor ba'i khyad chos legs par gsungs/ gong gi 'di rnams ni nye lam nga tsho'i mig lam du mthong thub pa'i khong gi gsung las btus shing der dbye zhib byas pa tsam yin/ khong gi lo rgyus su khong gis mdzad pa'i chas gos dang shing sman sngo sman srog chags sna tshogs/ pho brang dang rdo ring sogs mi 'dra ba'i 'dra ris che chung125yod par de'i rgyu mtshan dang 'grel ba yod pa zhig dang sman rdzas kyi ro nus la dbye zhib mdzad pa'i sman dang zas rigs kyi ro nyi shu(2)zhes pa zhig 'dug cing de mthong mkhan yang kha shas mchis mod/ da lta de rnams ming gi lhag mar gyur/ rgan bstan 'dzin don grub lags nas dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis rgya gar nas bris te bskur ba'i ri mo zhig tu gcan gzan ce spyang gi gzugs shig dang nim pa'i sdong bo'i dpe ris shig 'dug la/ ce spyang bris 'dug pa'i gsal bshad du ce spyang ni 'phar ba dang spyang 23

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaki gnyis phrad nas byung ba'i srog chags shig dang / rgya gar sogs su mang zhes bkod 'dug pas/ der ltos na nga tshos ngos 'dzin pa'i ce spyang de nor 'dug gsungs/ nim pa'i 'dra dper sdong rgan zhig bris shing de'i gam du glang chen dang mi bris 'dug pa shin tu chung bas der ltos na yang nga tshos ngos 'dzin pa'i nim pa yang nor 'dug gsungs/ 'dra ris 'di gnyis kyang bshad sgros tsam las da lta mkha' tshal ltar gyur/gnyis pa/ gso yul lus la zhib 'jug bgyis tshul/de yang khong gis mdzad pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos su/ pho mo'i lus la khyad par ci yang med// bud med rnams la ma tshang gcig kyang med// rlig sgong gnyis kyang mngal gyi nang du mchis// liṅga'i shun bu rtsa bar 'dus gyur pa// bha ga'i zur na yod pa'i bya le nyid// de yi 'og tu sha chung mdzub mo tsam// chags pa skyes tshe 'greng zhing sra bar 'ong // de ni skyes pa'i pho mtshan dod yin cing // de la sor mos reg cing bsgul byas na// bud med rnams la chags pa myur du skye// 'khrig pa'i skabs kyang sha de gar gyur pa'i// shun bu'i cha gnyis bha ga'i 'gram na gnas// de bzhin pho yi lto bar bu snod mchis// brang la nu ma 'bur ba'i rgyu yang mchis// (gzhon nu'i skabs pho la nu ma 'bur ba'i mgo brtsam nas slar yagi rlig pa'i dbus na srub dag mngon gyur ba// de yang mo mtshan zum pa'i shul nyid yin//(14)zhes dang /yang de las se 'bru sbom pa'i rigs can 'ga' zhig ni// mtshan gnyis 24

st+waṃ0rdusmo010spru༈ 0ba 116dzi mi0 7dzizu1khu1sadzipa'am 'gyur ba ma ning nyid// lus gnas 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel phran bu las// bud med pho ru 'gyur ba shin tu mang // de bzhin liṅga(15) zhes khu khrag sems gsum las grub pa'i rten pho mo ma ning gsum gyi khyad par la sngar ma grags pa'i bla med dbye zhib mdzad/ de bzhin de las/ pho ni rang lo bcu drug lon pa'i skabs// na tshod dar zhing nyer bzhi lo la rdzogs// mo ni rang lo bcu gsum lon pa na// na tshod dar zhing bcu drug lo la rdzogs//de'i phyir pho lo nyer bzhi lon pa dang // bud med bcu drug lo'am bco brgyad ma// 'dod pa 'os pa'i dus la bab gyur cing // khyim so 'dzin pa dag kyang 'di nas bya// lo tshigs de las da dung yun ring na// nad kyi rigs byed 'ga' yang 'byung bar bshad// skyes pa rnams ni na so chung ngu'i skabs// bud med spyad na stobs 'chor myur du rgas// 'on kyang bud med rnams ni chung dus su// skyes pa phrad na rgas kha sla// (16)zhes rten pho mo so so rang lo ga tshod kyi steng na tshod dar zhing smin bzhin pa dang / khyim thabs 'dzin par 'os pa'i lo tshad/ 'khrig pa spyad snga na zungs stobs shor bas rgas sla ba'i nyes skyon thon pa sogs gsal por gsungs/ yang de las bud med rnams la khu ba yod med la// thams cad kun gyi bshad tshul mi mthun te// dga' bo mngal 'jug mdo dang gsar phyogs kyi// rgyud sde rnams su khu ba yod par gsungs// slob dpon ba dha ra bya'i rjes 'brang rnams//'khrig pa spyad tshe mgo nas mjug gi bar// bud med rnams la khu ba 'ong zhes bshad// de phyir 'dod pa'i dga' ba bgos pa ni// mi yi rgyud la brgya 25

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dkyes pa'i zla zeska'agyur thob bo skad// 'on kyang de ni chags pa'i g.ya' chu la// khu ba yin par 'khrul ces gzhan dag zer// slob dpon gzhon nu'i bu ni pho mo gnyis// khu ba 'byung tshul khyad par med ces zer// da lta'i dus su shes can phal cher dang // gzhung mang sbyangs pa'i bud med rnams kyis kyang //mo yi rigs la khu ba med par bshad// kho bo smad kyi gtam la dga' ba'i phyir// grogs mo bud med mang po la dris kyang // khrel dgod byas te khu tshur bsnun pa las// drang por bshad mkhan gcig kyang rnyed ma nus// dbyangs can sgrol mas drang por bshad mod kyang // mo rang la yang tan tar cang mi 'dug / yang na chu zhig yin nam rlung zhig yin// rgad po nyams myong can gyis dpyad na shes//(17)zhes bud med rnams la khu ba yod med dga' bo mngal 'jug dang gsar phyogs kyi rgyud sde rnams su gsungs pa'i lta ba de dang khong gis bud med rnams la dris te gnas tshul dngos la rgyus lon byas pa'ang gsal/ gzhan de ru bud med rnams kyi zla mtshan 'byung dus dang /zla mtshan babs rjes kyi zhag ga dus mal du zhugs na bur skyes shing ga dus zhugs na bu mor skyes pa/ zla mtshan 'bab dus sogs su zhugs na pho mo gnyis kar gnod cing nad 'byung ba/ skyes pa'i khu ba rgyu gang du brten nas grub cing rkyen gang dang phrad nas phyir thon pa sogs mang du mchis/gsum pa/ mjug bsdu ba/khong gi zhal nas kyang / chen po'i lung dang gser gyi maṇḍal bcas//26

st+waṃ0(smo0102〉 0ba rwa16༷(mis krodzispu101saXbaskul ba'i skyes bu su yang ma mchis kyi// rigs pa'i dbyig mdzod 'dor la 'phang ba'i blos// rang gis dka' ba 'khur du blangs te bris// zhes gsungs pa ltar khong gis ma bskul dang len gyis grags 'gul ci yang med pa'i gzhan gyis za chog chog tu lus pa'i mi rigs 'di'i ched du mi tshe lcags smyug dang 'grogs te gang sar 'khyams nas 'dzam shing shes rig gi nying bcud bsdu gsog byas shing / rlabs chen gyi bgyi ba 'di don du gnyer skabs dka' las kyang mang po brgyab/ de ni khong gis mdzad pa'i rgyal khams rig pas bskor ba'i gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma ru/ sa mthar lhung ba'i snying rlung dang sdebs pa'i mig chu 'khrig pa'i dad pa yang lan du mar skyes/nags tshal du lam grogs med par song bas glang chen gyi dngangs skrag tsam dang / nyin gnyis la chu dang zas ma 'byor ba zhig kyang byung (18)zhes dang /shes rab rgya mtshos bris pa'i khong gi lo rgyus su/ skabs der ngas 'khur thang ri las che tsam zhig khur te bod 'dir cung zad phan thogs kyi re ba chen po byas dus/ skabs 'gar sgor rdog re gnyis kyang med par bsdad/skabs re dbyin ci sogs mkhas pa 'dra thug dus sgor sum brgya bzhi brgya am phrag nang nyar rgyu yod/ gang ltar rang gi mkhas 'dod dang skyid 'dod/dngul dngos 'byor thabs kyi re dogs rtsa ba nas bcad pa yin/ dge chos shi rjes ming shul gtsang ma gtsang rkyang yin(19)zhes gsungs pa lta bu/ yid pham pa zhig ni khong nyid la drin byas drin du mi go ba'i mi rigs 'di'i skabs de'i srid skyong 'ga'i phrag dog gi me lce 'bar drag nas ma nyes kha 27

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagayog gis btson bcug byas shing mnar gcod mang du thebs/ khong gi brtsams chos rnams kyang gang mang zhig skabs de dang bstun nas 'phro brlag tu btang / gnas tshul de rnams byung rjes khong gi zhal nas kyang 'dzam gling na dkon pa'i baiḍārya'i bum pa zhig rdo la brdabs soja20)zhes dang / yang khong gis ngas dka' las tog tsam brgyab pa de yin rgyu ni bod kyi don du byas pa'i khul yin kyang / gang yang byung ma song / de las khyed rang gis 'di 'dra byas nas sems la zhogs/ dper na/ lung pa kha byang lta zhig gi nang du me tog dkar po snying rje po zhig skyes/ de la dri ma snom mkhan phar zhog mig zur zhig gis kyang blta mkhan ma rnyed par lung pa kha byang lta de rang gi nang du skam pa 'dra ba red(21)ces gsungs/ de yang rgya nag gi rtsom pa po grags can yi ta hphu yis rlabs chen gyi mi sna byung ma myong ba'i mi rigs ni 'dzam gling steng ches snying rje ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs shig red la/rlabs chen gyi mi sna byung yang der brtsi bkur dang dga' zhen yid smon bcas mi byed pa'i mi rigs ni re ba med pa'i bran g.yog gi mi rigs shig red ces gsungs pa yang khong gi gnas tshul 'dir ltos na bla med kyi bka' mchid cig tu mchis/ yang khong gis/ gzhon dus dga' ba'i chung ma ngas ma blangs// rgas dus dgos pa'i nor rdzas ngas ma bsags// sprang bo'i mi tshe lcags smyug lhan cig tu// rdzogs pa 'di ni bdag gi snang ba skyo// zhes pa'ang nor bu rang la yod dus nor bu'i nor ngo mi shes pa'i mi rigs 'di'i ched du khong gis yod tshad phul yang / de rnams khong gi tshe srog la skyi g.ya' 28

st+waṃbardu'i0109shā 00 rwa16dzirdumi0 ba1dzizu1khupa'idziba'i mjug sdom rgyag byed du gyur skabs rang gi mi tshe 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum la bzhag pa'i sdom tshig cig tu 'khums/dpya da gzhi'i yig cha/(1)262(2)2yo (7)263 〈dpal ldan rgyud bzhi〉 1982lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/(3)2217(9)23lo (12)2327 〈shel gong shel phreng〉 1986lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/(5)2145rgan dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈'khrungs dpe dri med shel gyi me long〉1994lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/(6)2151 karma chos ldan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈bdud rtsi sman gyi 'khrungs dpe〉1993lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/(10)975 〈bee sngon〉 1982lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/(4)sbyi2posko8)928 (11)sbyi73 〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom deb dang po〉1990lor bod ljongs dpe rnying dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/ (13)sbyi8 (19)28 (20)924 (mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom phyogs sgrig〉 1988lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/(14)sbyi31 (15)232(16)227 (17)sbyitshidage 'gun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i ('dod pa'i bstan bcos〉 zhang kang then mā dpe skrun kung zis bskrun/(18)958 (21)2104a sngags tshe ring bkra shis kyis brtsams pa'i (dge 'dun chos 'phel〉 2004lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/29

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrod rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagrub thob ril dkar gyi sbyor sde dang sbyor ming sogs la tog tsam dpyad pa bzhin ras gsal ba'i me long /ngas de ring ma skul rang mos sgos grub thob ril dkar gyi sbyor sde dang sbyor ming sogs la tog tsam dpyad pa bzhin ras gsal ba'i me long zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom 'di spel bar rang nyid grags 'dod dang rang don ga ge mo zhig gi sger bsam bcings nas bris pa gtan nas min la/ 'jig rten pa'i mig lam na 'od 'tsher ba'i sgor mo'i ched du yang gtan nas min/ngas dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri don ni dus da lta'i nyin mo 'dir dpal 'byor tshong ra'i khrod na kha cig gis ljid tig tig gi bod lugs gso ba rig pa'i bya gzhag phrag par blangs nas tsher ma yod sar lham ma gyon par 'gro bzhin pas/ nga tsho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gso ba rig pa'i bzhin ras su grib nag phog nyen che bas snying khong gi drang gtam zhig brjod pa lags/ bod lugs gso rig la rgyus mnga' ba'i lha rje rnam pa/gal te nam zhig bdag gi dpyad rtsom 'di khyed rnam pa'i spyan lam du lhag pa'i skal ba ldan tshe nga ni ra lug spyang tshang sgor 'gro mkhan lta bu'i blun 30

st+waṃsordusmo010spru| 00 116dzirdutshib kro0zu1dzu10khurmongs shig tu mi brtsi bar dka' drin che/ gsham nas grub thob ril dkar gyi thog ma'i ming 'dogs tshul dang de'i sbyor sde/ phyis 'byung rjes 'jug pa tshos rang rang so so'i thad nas kha tshar rgyag lugs/ thog ma'i sman gyi sbyor sde dang phyis byung kha tshar ji ltar brgyab 'dug pa sogs kyi ming dang phan nus kyi dbye ba/ mjug bsdu ba bcas sa bcad chen po bzhir dbye nas bris pa la/dang po/ grub thob ril dkar gyi thog ma'i ming 'dogs tshul dang de'i sbyor spre sogs bshad pa/de yang gangs ri'i khrod na mdzad rjes kyi zhabs rjes rnam par bkra ba'i gzhan don kho nas mi tshe skyong mkhan gyi grub thob chen po lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal pos ches thog mar grub thob ril dkar gyi sbyor ba 'di gsar gtod mdzad cing / skabs der sman sna lnga las grub pa'i sman sbyor zhig yin/sman sbyor 'dir grub thob ril dkar zhes ming 'dogs don ni sbyor ba 'di gsar gtod mdzad pa po'i ming gi thog ma grub thob yin zhing ril bu'i phyi rtsi dkar po byas 'dug pa bcas kyis yin/ dper na mnyam med dwags po rje yis pho gcong dang bad smug sogs la phan pa'i sman kha dog nag po zhig bzos par dwags po'i sman nag dang / sde srid phag mo grub pas pho smug chu tshan chu skyur skyug pa sogs la bzos pa'i sman sbyor la phag grub lta bu rang re'i ljongs 'dir sman sbyor gsar gtod mdzad pa po'i mtshan sman ming du 'dogs srol mang bas grub thob ril dkar yang gong brjod ltar gsar 31

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagatod mdzad pa po'i mtshan dang ril bu'i kha dog tu bltos nas mtshan btags pa'o// grub thob ril dkar gyi sbyor ba ni man ngan lhan thabs las/gzhan yang grub chen thang stong rgyal po la// o rgyan mkha' 'gros zhal gzigs phul ba'i sman// gtso mos 'du ba spyi snyoms cha drug bzung // shar gyi mkha' 'gros srid pa'i bcud bsdus pa// de bzhin lho mas kun byed rgyal po dang // nub mas rin chen snying po kun bsdus dang // byang mas me tog sna tshogs bcud bsdus pa// gtso mo'i phyed mnyam rang rang ḍā kis 'phul//sbrang rtsis khu byas ril bu bra ril tsam// zhes gsungs pa'i gong sman sna lnga las grub/ rang re'i bod lugs gso rig 'dir byang lugs dang zur lugs zhes lugs chen gnyis chags yod pas gong sman lnga po las kun byed rgyal po zhes par zur lugs su spang rtsi do bo gtong zhing / byang lugs su hong len gtong / sman rdzas gzhan rnams gcig mtshungs su yod pa ni gsham ltar te/ dper na zur lugs ltar na a ru cong zhi ru rta spang rtsi do bo brag zhun bcas lnga yin zhing / byang lugs ltar na a ru cong zhi ru rta hong len brag zhun bcas lnga yin mod/ phyag len mdzad skabs bad khrag la phan pa'i sman re skon pa kha snon brgyab 'dug pa 'dra/ de ni rgan bstan 'dzin don grub lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈nyer mkho'i sman sbyor phyogs bsgrigs kun phan bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod〉 las/ cong zhi gser mdog hong len dang //re skon khams ruskaru rta)brag gi zhun// tshad sbyar me tog bcud kyis sbrus//phyi nang phal cher nad kun dang // khyad par bad khrag nad la bsngags//32

(brdusmo010sprusna 00 116rdu(mi0 krodzi71dzu1sadzi(byang lugs)zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / bsod nams don grub lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈sman sbyor lag len gyi gdams pa myong grub ma〉 ru gong ltar byang lugs kyi rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng re skon pa bsnan 'dug pa bcas so//gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng rang rang so so'i thad nas kha tshar rgyag lugs bshad pa/byang lugs ltar gyi rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng re skon pa bsnan nas sman sna drug tu gyur ba'i phyag len der mang che bas grub thob ril dkar zer zhing phyag len 'di lha ldan sman rtsis khang sogs nas byed/ zur lugs ltar gyi rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng spyir btang gi kha tshar rgyag lugs dang dmigs bsal gyi kha tshar rgyag lugs gnyis yod pa las/ dmigs bsal gyi kha tshar rgyag lugs ni/ rlung nad can la ar nag dang li shi/ mkhris nad can la gser me dang tig ta/ bad kan gyi nad can la se 'bru dang se yab/ glo la cu gang / snying la dzā ti/ mkhal mar sug smel/ mtsher bar ko la/ long la ya bakṣa ra/ lgang par rgya tshwa sogs nad pa rang rang gi nad rtags dang na lugs la gzhigs nas sbyar/ spyir btang gi kha 'dzin rgyag lugs ni/ rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng rlung ni nad rnams nyi mar ldan na bsreg pa'i grogs byed cing zla bar ldan na bsil ba'i grogs byed mkhan gyi nad tsha grang gnyis kyi sna 'dren mjug sdud/ khyab byed bcas byed mkhan kho na ru zad pas/ der 33

pod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska.ar nag dang li shi/ grang ba'i gtso bo bad kan gyi nad la se 'bru dang se yab/ nad spyi la bzang drug bcas bsnan pas sman sna bco lngar gyur/'dir gsal bshad bya rgyu zhig ni kha cig gis li shi nyis sdeb cing kha cig gis mi byed/ gong gi sman sna bco lnga can gyi sbyor sde 'di'i sbyor tshad ni/dper na/ a ru btul ma khe370 5dang / cong zhi btul ma khe210spang rtsi khe85brag zhun khaṇḍa khe177 5ma nu khe26se 'bru khe26se yab khe26ar nag khe19 5li shi khe 19 5cu gang khe13ko la(shun lpags dor ba)13sbrang rtsi (sbrang shal)khe 370 5bcas lhan du bsres nas bzos/ yang kha cig gis gong gi sman sna bco lnga bo 'di'i steng tig ta dang gser me gnyis bsnan nas sman sna bcu bdun can bzo bzhin pa bcas la yang grub thob ril dkar zer/gsum pa/ thog ma'i sman gyi sbyor sde dang phyis 'byung kha tshar brgyab 'dug pa sogs kyi ming dang phan nus kyi dbye ba bshad pa/mtshams 'di nas nga tshos phyir 'dang zhig brgyab tshe grub thob ril dkar gyi thog ma'i rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga can nas de'i steng kha tshar brgyab pa'i sman sna drug can dang bco lnga can/ bcu bdun can bcas tshang mar grub thob ril dkar zer bzhin pas de'i phyogs su blo zhib mos bsam gzhigs re btang tshe sbyor ba de dag gi sbyor ba'i kha grangs tha dad du 'dug pas/ phan nus kyang tha dad du 'dug pa smras med yin/ lhag par byang lugs kyis hong len 34

st+waṃ0rdusmo010spru7 00 rwa16rdurdumib krodziskye101brdugatong zhing zur lugs kyis spang rtsi gtong / hong len dang spang rtsi gnyis kyi phan nus kyang tha dad du 'dug pas byang lugs ltar gyi grub thob ril dkar kyi phan nus mchin khrag rgyas pa dang ngan khrag glo bar byer ba/ pho smug dang pho bar bad khrag rgyas pa sogs gtso cher gyur ba'i ldan 'dus nad la phan/zur lugs ltar gyi grub thob ril dkar bad kan skya smug ldan 'dus dang tshad snying lus su byer ba sogs gtso cher gyur ba'i bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kun la phan/ gong gi byang zur gnyis kyi rang rang so so'i rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga can gyi grub thob ril dkar gnyis kyi rang bzhin cung bsil/zur lugs ltar gyi rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng bzang drug dang a gar se 'bru se yab sogs bsnan pa'i sman sna bco lnga can gyi sbyor ba 'di pho smug dang ma zhu ba gtso cher gyur ba'i ldan 'dus kyi nad la phan zhing rang bzhin cung dro ba/ gong gi sman sna bco lnga can gyi sbyor ba 'di'i steng tig ta dang gser me gnyis bsnan pa'i sman sna bcu bdun can gyi sbyor ba 'di'i phan nus pho mchin dang bad mkhris kyi nad gzhir gtso cher phan zhing ldan 'dus sogs kyi nad la'ang phan/ rang bzhin snyoms/ gzhan byang lugs kyi rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga can dang de'i steng re skon pa bsnan pa'i sman sna drug can gnyis kyi sbyor bar sdeb sbyor gyi dpe cha rnams su 'khod pa ltar na cong zhi tsha btul byed cing / rtsa ba'i sman du ru rta gtong / zur lugs kyi rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga can du'ang ru rta gtong / mdo smad yul du sdeb bzhin pa'i sman sna bco lnga can dang bcu bdun can gnyis su cong zhi snyoms 'dul byed cing ru rta mi 35

pod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus 'a dgyes pa'i zla zeskagatong bar ma nu gtong bzhin pas/ cong zhi tsha btul dang snyoms 'dul gnyis kyi phan nus dang rang bzhin sogs gcig mtshungs min pa sus kyang 'chad mi dgos pa'i gtam zhig tu 'dug par ma zad/ ru rta dang ma nu gnyis kyi phan nus dang bsil drod kyi rang bzhin yang tha dad du 'dug pa bshad rgyud rkyang sel tu gsal/ rkyen 'di dag gis sbyor ba'i kha grangs mi mtshungs shing gtso sman gyi 'dul lugs da—dzwa ngoyo'adzin mi gcig pa'i sbyor ba'i phan nus kyang mi mtshungs pa ni rtogs sla ba'i gnas su gyur/ des na sbyor tshad dang phan nus mi gcig pa'i sbyor ba de dag la ming gi dbye ba tsam yang med par grub thob ril dkar zhes zer zhing yul so so'i sman khang gi sdeb sbyor khang du sdeb bzhin pa dang phan nus kyang byang lugs kyi re skon pa bsnan pa'i sman sna drug can las gzhan rnams gcig mtshungs su bris 'dug mdor na bdag gi bsam gzhigs su rtsa ba'i sman lnga'i steng kha tshar brgyab 'dug pa'i rigs la grub thob ril dkar kha tshar can zhes brjod na legs par snyam/ da dung rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga can yin tshe byang zur gyi lugs gang yin pa sman thum steng gsal bshad bya dgos/ kha tshar brgyab 'dug pa'i rigs la mtshon na sman thum steng gtso sman re gnyis dang lhan re skon pa sogs sman drug las grub ces bkod na ming la ltos pa tsam gyis rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga'i steng kha tshar brgyab 'dug pa rtogs sla zhing gsal bshad skabs kyi sbyor tshad la ltos tshe byang lugs ltar gyi steng re skon pa bsnan 'dug pa rtogs/sman sna bco lnga can dang bcu bdun can gnyis kyi sman thum gyi mdun ngos 36

st+waṃbardusmo0102smo 0ba 116rdurdumib hphurduskye1dzu1sakhusu grub thob ril dkar kha tshar can zhes 'khod dgos shing / phyi ngos sbyor tshad steng gong ltar gtso sman re gnyis dang kha tshar las kyang gtso bo'i rigs re gnyis bkod dgos/ gzhan kha grangs kyang 'bri dgos/ 'di ltar byed don ni dus da ltar mtshon na sman pa dang sman gnyis so sor bral nas gso bcos byed dgos shing / gso sman rigs sdebs sbyor khang nas gcig gyur tu spyi sman byas nas sdeb bzhin pas yin/ lhag par sman rdzas bzo grwa'i khe las shig gis sman rdzas shig la tshong byed ang rtags blangs nas sman rdzas de bzos rjes/ bzo grwa gzhan nas de'i rjes su bzos na brdzun mar brtsi/dper na sman rdzas bzo grwa'i khe las shig gis gong gi grub thob ril dkar kha tshar can zhig bzos nas mdun ngos su ming la grub thob ril dkar zhes bkod cing der ches thog mar grub thob ril dkar gyi ang rtags blangs tshe de ni tshad ldan gyi grub thob ril dkar du brtsi dgos shing / de'i rjes nas rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga can gyi grub thob ril dkar sman rdzas bzo grwa gzhan zhig gis bzos nas der grub thob ril dkar zhes brjod na der dus mi 'gyang bar brdzun ma zer ba sha stag tu snang / gong gi rkyen 'di dag gis kha tshar can la kha tshar yod pa'i ming 'dogs rgyu ni ches gal gnad zhig tu snang /bdag gis 'di ltar brjod tshe kha cig gis nga'i sman rdzas khe las bzo grwa'am sdeb sbyor khang gis sdeb bzhin pa'i sman sna bco lnga can nam bcu bdun can 'dir gna' nas da lta'i yun grub thob ril dkar zer bzhin pas der nor 'gal ci yang med ces brjod pa'am yang na grub chen thang stong rgyal 37

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zegapos kyang kha tshar rgyag lugs gsungs 'dug ces brjod na/ phyi rgyud ril bu'i skabs su khyung lngar kha tshar rgyag lugs gsungs 'dug mod/ kha tshar brgyab yod pa'i rigs der khyung lnga dzā ti'i kha tshar can dang khyung lnga 'gron thal kha tshar can zhes ming btags nas bkol bzhin pa kun gyi mthong chos su gyur/ yang dper na phyi rgyud phye ma'i skabs kyi se 'bru bzhi ba'i steng dong gra bsnan pas se 'bru lnga ba dang / gur kum bsnan pas se 'bru dwangs gnas su gyur ba las sngon ltar se 'bru bzhi ba mi zer/ da dung se 'bru dwangs gnas steng 'jam 'bras bsnan pas mo nad se 'bru drug par gyur zhing se me dang ga bur nag po sogs bsnan pas se 'bru pad 'dabs su gyur/grub thob ril dkar steng se me bsnan pas ril dkar pad sdong du gyur/gur kum mchog bdun steng kha gur bsnan pas gur kum mchog bdun kha tshar can du gyur/ lhag par grub chen thang stong rgyal pos kyang grub thob ril dkar steng kha tshar brgyab yod pa'i rigs tshang mar grub thob ril dkar zer dgos zhes gsungs med pa'i phyir/ spyir 'jig rten 'di'i bya dngos thams cad la rang rang so so'i thad nas ming re btags dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 〈snyan ngag me long ma〉 las gal te sgra don snang ba yis/'khor ba gsal bar ma byas na// 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag ni//smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur zhes dang / 〈lang kar gshegs pa〉 las/ming du gdags par ma mdzad na// 'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur// de bas rmongs pa spang pa'i phyir// mgon pos ming du gdags par 38

sab('i010spru| 00 rwa16rdurdumis 7khu61dzu1sakhumadzad ces gsungs pa ltar phan tshun la mi nor ba'i ched du'o//bzhi ba/ mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/bsgyur bcos dang bsgyur bcos kyi khrod nas sman pa dang sman rdzas gnyis so sor bral zhing sman rdzas rigs bzo grwa khang nas gcig gyur du bzo bzhin pa'i nyin mo 'dir/ sman rdzas bzo grwa dang sman rdzas bzo grwa'i bar na khyod pham nga rgyal gyi 'du shes shugs drag pas lan rer dngos ma brdzun mar 'gyur zhing brdzun ma dngos mar 'gyur nyen yang che/ 'di dang 'di lta bu'i bgyi ba dag gis nga cho re srol rgyun gso rig gi tshe srog la 'jab rgol byed mus su 'dug cing / bdag gi nyin shas kyi gnyid kyang 'phrog song bas lhad med lhag bsam gyi snying gtam 'di thol byung du bris pa lags/ mjug mthar na chung gzhon nu bdag gi snying gtam 'di gangs can pa'i gso rig gi bya gzhag la don gnyer mdzad mkhan gyi gangs can pa tshor phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalo//39

st+waṃ0(smo010sprushā 00 rwa16༷('is krorduzu101sarduphyogs su 'gro dgos na de gnyis kyi phyogs la byang cha nges can zhig yod dgos/ 0smo2yi gom stabs hi ma la ya'i 'dabs kyi mi rigs 'di'i gso rig khrod slebs nas bgrang bya bdun brgyad tsam son zhing / de'i yun mang che bas yin min gyi gnas lugs gang la yang mi rtogs par gzhan rjes su rgyugs ci thub bya bzhin mchis/ nyung shas 'gas6smoṣṭayi gzhung lugs la rgyus mnga' phran tsam med par de'i skor gleng tshe smyon pa dang 'on par kha brda byed pa bzhin rna ba ye nas mi g.yor bar rang re'i gzhung dang mthun thabs bral zer zhing / sngo sman gyi skye ba'i yan lag bdun ldan dang lag len bco brgyad/ rgyud bzhi dang nyams yig sogs nas gsungs pa'i 'dul sbyong byed thabs rnams bod lugs kyi0smo2yi dgongs pa rang yin zer/ don ngo mar de bzhin 'dug kyang da dung rdo khog tu brdung ba tsam gyis spyi tshogs 'di'i dgos mkho skong mi thub la/ tshan rtsal gyi lam du yang ye nas skyod mi thub pas mig rgyang ring du 'phangs nas mu mthud dar spel gtong rgyu ni nga tsho'i 'os 'gan yin/ gong gi gnad don 'di gnyis las dang por rang lugs kyi rig pa'i gzhung la thos bsam dman pas blun po'i blo sna gar khrid dam yang na rang kho na'i 'tsho ba tsam las mi rigs 'di'i las dbang la do snang ma byas pa'i skyon 'dug gnyis par rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol dang gsar ba thams cad bdud kyi cho 'phrul du brtsi ba'i skyon yang 'dug41

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang po/ bod lugs sdeb smyor rig pa'i dgongs don dang6āo yi dgongs don 'ga' tha dad yin pa'i skor/spyir0smoṣṭadang0ṣṭa2sogs ni nub lugs gso rig gi sman rdzas bzo sa'i cha rkyen du dmigs nas sdeb sbyor khang du cha rkyen 'di dang 'di 'dzoms dgos/'khor khang de las sman rdzas rnams go rim 'di dag brgyud nas bzo dgos zer ba las/ gnas de na bod lugs dang krung lugs sman rdzas rnams dug 'don byed sa med cing / tha na phye mar bzo sa yang med/ gnas 'di na ril bu bzo rgyu dang de skam rgyu/ phye mar sbyin shubs skon rgyu/ de gnyis la shun pags skon rgyu tsam gyi cha rkyen las ci yang mi 'dug de'i mi tshad rang gzhung gi ril bu'i phyag len bya srol ni thog mar 'dam thag yun ring byas shing de nas ril bu bzo dgos/ de ltar bzos pa'i ril bu'i ngo bo shin tu mkhregs po yin/ 'dam thag gi yun ci tsam ring na sman nus lus kyi rtsa lam nas 'dug yun ring / 'on kyang0smo2yi 'khor khang nas thon pa'i ril bu'i ngo bo sob sob yin zhing / mkhregs po yin tshe pho ba nas lam sang mi 'ju ba'i skyon du brtsi/ yang rang gzhung du sman gyi rgyu cha rnams kyang bsil sman rnams grib bsil nas bsil skam dang drod sman rnams me nyi'i khrod drod skam bya rgyu ni rgyud las/ bsil sman grib lhags drod sman me nyis skem zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / sman rgyu de dag la'ang ngo bo tsha bar 'gyur byed la tsha 'dul dang ngo bo grang bar 'gyur byed la grang 'dul byed srol sogs 'dug pas/ sman rdzas rnams kyi skam sa'i dbye ba dang 'dul sbyong gi phyag 42

st+waṃbardusmo010sprukau 0ba 116dzi(mis 7khuskye1dzu1sakhulen las sman nus su thad kar 'gyur ldog thebs bzhin pa smros med yin/'on kyang6smoṣṭadang02ṣṭayi 'khor khang nas ril bu rnams glog 'od nas skam zhing tsha tshad tu'u 74tsam gyi steng bzhag nas btsan skam byas/ skam zin pa'i ril bu zos na der tshig dri bro zhing skam ma thag pa'i ril bur reg na bsreg snyam byed/ nye lam nub lugs gso rig ni rgyal spyi'i steng nas ches tshad ldan gyi gso rig tu brtsi zhing / gzhung lugs 'di gtso bor bzung nas rdzas 'di dang 'di sman du gtong mi chog ces dang sdeb sbyor lam lugs kyang gong ltar bya dgos zhes pa sogs kyi dgongs don bstan/ dgongs don de ltar na rang re'i sdeb sbyor du ches spyod sgo che ba'i gter dngos sman dang srog chags sman ye nas mi 'gro/ skye dngos sman rdzas las kyang dug shas che ba'i rigs gtsor bzhag pa'i sman rdzas gang mang zhig bkol mi chog gzhan0smoṣṭadang0ṣṭa2khang nas thon pa'i sbyor ba rnams spyi sman byas nas bongs cher bzos shing / gso bya re re'i khams dang na so pho mo nad gzhi'i lci yang sogs la gzhigs nas sger sman bzo sa'i cha rkyen ye nas dben/ gong gi gnad don rigs la dbye zhib tsam byas tshe/ nga tsho'i yab mes byang sems can tshos bzhag pa'i nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi sdeb sbyor rig pa nye lam gu dog pa'i byi khung ltar bzo dgos 'dra/43

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaganyis pa/ yul dus kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung dang mthun pa'i6āo yi 'khor khang lam lugs shig gsar gtod bya dgos pa'i skor/gna' mi'i kha dper 'dul ba yul dus dang bstun dgos zer ba'am/yang na yul dus kyi rgyal po dang bstun dgos zer ba ltar/ nga tsho'i gom mtshams 'dir slebs dus 'dzam gling gso rig gi rtsa ba'i rtsa don la rgyab brten byas nas rang gzhung dang bstun pa'i mdun lam nyag cig 'tshol rgyu ni mi rigs 'di'i gso rig gi 'phar rtsa mu mthud ldang thub rgyu'i re ltos yin/de yang sman rdzas thon skyed dang spus tshad do dam gyi tshad galpimmutsha4sdzadnghazlazloṣṭha1tshornyornyermāwo)las/ sman rdzas thon skyed du bkol ba'i krung sman rgyu cha spus tshad tshad gzhi ltar nyo bsdu byed dgos la/ de'i thon yul phal cher gcig mthun yin dgos zhes bkod yod pas/ 'o skol bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung dang bstun pa'i tshad ldan sbyor ba zhig yin tshe/ sbyor sde der mkho ba'i sman rdzas rnams kyi thon khungs la khyad par che ba ma zad/ sngo sman lta bur btu dus kyang khyad par che/ srog chags sman yang de bzhin dus dang na tshod pho mo'i dbye ba bcas khyad par che bas gang la gang mkho ltar spyod rgyu ni gal 'gangs che ba'i gnas shig go/ 'on kyang da lta'i dus 'dir bod yul chol gsum stod smad kun tu6smoṣṭa'am0ṣṭaṣṭayi sdeb sbyor khang 'dzugs dang 'dzugs mus su snang zhing / kho tshos don ngo mar sman gyi rgyu spus la ye nas do snang byed bzhin med/ sman gyi rdzas tsam yin tshe de sdeb sbyor du 44

sasardu'i010spru| 0sa 116khu(mi0 gradzizu1khu10khugatong bzhin pa ni dper na gi wang gi tshab tu mis bzos gi wang gtong /spyir gi wang ni mchin pa'i nad rigs kun la phan yang mis bzos gi wang mchin khrag smad du lhung bar shin tu gnod/ yang g.yu rnying rigs mchin par phan yang da lta kun gyis gtong bzhin pa'i sa g.yu gsar ba'i rigs 'di mchin par gnod ces mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gi drang srong zhal lung du gsal/ 'di'i phyogs la sman rdzas thon skyed dang spus tshad do dam gyi tshad gzhi las/ rtswa sman zhib gsher byas rjes rgyal khab dang yang na sa gnas rtswa sman tshad gzhi dang mthun dgos zhes bkod yod/ tshig rkang 'di'i shugs bstan du rtswa sman ma yin pa'i sman gyi rdzas su chog pa'i rigs rnams kyang tshad gzhi dang mthun dgos pa'i dgongs don mchis pa rtogs sla la rtogs par bya rgyu'ang gal che/ tshad gzhi dang mthun min gyi lta rtog byed mi rgyal khab bam sa gnas de'i sman rdzas bdag dam las khungs kyi mi sna yin yang / nye lam kho tsho'i khrod na bod sman gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs shes mkhan phar zhogatha na bod yig shes mkhan yang dkon pas/ mthar gtug na skabs bab rang so so'i sdeb sbyor khang gi mi snas lta rtogs bya rgyu ni gnad dam pa yin/0smoṣṭadang6ṣṭaṣṭa'akhor khang du sman rdzas rnams dug 'don byed sa'i gnas med pas de rigs rang nyid kyis log tu bzo dgos/ de ni sman rdzas thon skyed dang spus tshad do dam gyi tshad gzhi las/ rtswa sman 'dul skabs kyi rlangs btso dang brngo ba sogs kyi 'dul ba byed tshul de/ de'i thon skyed gzhi khyon dang mthun pa'i thon skyed 'khor khang du byed dgos pa ma zad/ rlung rgyu ba 45

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang du ba/ rdul sel thub la drod mar 'bebs pa sogs kyi sgrig chas bzang po yod dgos zhes 'khod yod/ de na bod lugs sman sbyor rig pa lta bur mtshon na sman gyi rgyu spus tshad ldan yin pa gzhir byas thog de rnams dug 'don byed sa dang skam bsed byed sa/ phye ma dang ril bu/ lde gu/ sman mar/ khaṇḍa/ thal sman/ sman chang sogs bzo sa bcas su 'di dang 'di lta bu'i cha rkyen 'dzoms dgos zhes gtan du phab rjes/ de nas0smoṣṭadang0ṣṭaṣṭayi 'khor khang skor gleng mgo brtsam na legs/ 'dir gsal bshad bya rgyu zhig ni0smo2yi 'khor khang du ril bu bzo bzhin 'dug kyang / srol rgyun gyi phyag len min pas ril bus ril bu'i nus pa zhig thon par byed na phyag len gyi dgongs don gtso bo bor mi nyan/ phye ma rnams btung bde ba'i ched du ngo bo gcig tu 'dril ba yin na 'dam btags ma byas par ngo bo sob sob yin na'ang chogagong du bstan pa'i rtsa don rnams krung go'i rgyal khab nas krung lugs sman sbyor gyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas0smo2yi lam lugs ltar krung sman bzo bzhin par gtan du phab pa'i rtsa don rigs yin la/ gzhung de'i spyi'i rtsa don brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i dgongs don tsam las sman rdzas 'dul sbyong byed gnas su 'di dang 'di lta bu'i cha rkyen dgos zhes bkod mi 'dugagal te nam zhig 'di'i phyogs nas krung lugs kyi dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i 'dul sbyong byed sa'i cha rkyen lam lugs shig gtan du dbab tshe/ lam lugs der rang re'i bod lugs sdeb sbyor dang mthun pa'i cha tsam re mchis 46

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprug 0sa 116dzirdu3sa ⑪rduzu1dzu1sakhukyang / krung lugs gso rig dang bod lugs gso rig gnyis kyi gzhung lugs kyi rtsa ba mi gcig pas de yis nga tsho'i dgos mkho ye nas skong mi thub/lhag par krung sman du mthong dkon pa'i sman rdzas rnams bod sman du bkol rgyu mang pas/ bod sman sdeb sbyor khang la sus kyang tshab byed mi rung ba'i bod lugs gso gzhung dang bstun pa'i 'dul sbyong lte gnas shig dgos/de ltar ma byas tshe bod sman dang krung sman gnyis nye ba'i lo shas yun nub lugs dgongs pa'i0smoṣṭadang0ṣṭa2sogs kyi rjes 'brangs nas srol rgyun a ma'i phyag len yul gyar 'khyam rgyu'am lnga lam du 'gro rgyu las rang nyid kyi khyim gzhis na sdod sa med 'dug 'di lta bu'i nyen kha'i me tshan khrod slebs 'dra'i gnad don rnams lhag don ni0smo2dgongs pa ci bzhin sdeb sbyor byed dgos zhes bka' bsgrags mkhan tshor srol rgyun rig gnas kyi mkhyen rgya chung zhing / thog ma'i dus su de tshad mar bzung nas lag len byed mkhan tshos gnas skabs kyi dpal 'byor tshong ra'i dgos mkho kho nar dmigs pa'i skyon dag las ma 'das/ spyir gzhung lugs 'di gnyis ka re re nas 'dzam gling gso rig chen po bzhi'i gras su brtsi don yang rang rang gi thad nas thun mong ma yin pa'i nad gzhir ngos 'dzin bya thabs yod pa de yis nub lugs sam deng rabs gso rig gtsor byas pa'i gso rig gzhan rnams yongs kyis brtag dka' ba'i nad gzhir brtag thub pa'i dge mtshan mchis pa dang /sman rdzas rnams la thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dul sbyong bya thabs dang 'dul zin pa rnams brgyud rim 'dra min re brgyud nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sdeb 47

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed sto gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasbyor bya srol yod/ de ltar thon pa'i sbyor ba gang mang zhig gis 'dzam gling gso rig gi bcos thabs khrod lus pa'i stong cha mi nyung ba kha skong byed thub/yang na gso rig gzhan gyi sman sbyor las gzhung 'di gnyis kyi sbyor sde 'ga'i nus pa legs pa sogs kyi dge mtshan ldan pas yin/ de'i phyir sman nus la thad kar 'brel ba yod pa'i srol rgyun gyi phyag len rnams dor mi rung /sngon ltar nga tshos gzhan gyis kha gdangs na rang gis kha gdangs shing /gzhan gyi mig btsum na rang gis mig btsum pa ltar nub lugs0smo2yi dgongs don ci bzhin bod sman sdeb sbyor byed mi rung / rang so so'i thad nas bsam mno re btang ste dus thung ngu'i nang gnad don 'di thag gcod bya rgyu ni bdag gi rtsom thung 'di'i brjod snying yin la/ smug sprin dkyil na mgo 'thoms pa'i nga tshos lam sne zin rgyu'i 'dun pa nyag cig yin/ de na thog mar0smoṣṭayi gzhung lugs la rgyus mnga' che ba'i na gzhon tsho dang srol rgyun gyi phyag len la mkhas pa'i rgan gras rnam pa'i lta ba gnyis kyi dbu ma'i lam nas rang re'i bod sman gyis rang rkya 'pher ba'i 'tsho gnas shig 'tshol thabs bya dgos/ 'tsho gnas de ni gcig nas 'dzam gling gso rig gi kha phyogs dang mthun zhing / gnyis nas srol rgyun gyi phyag len ma nyams pa zhig yin dgos/ nye lam rgyal spyi'i sman rdzas gras su srog chags sman dang gter dngos sman mi 'gro bas/ sngo sman kho nas bod lugs gso rig gi rgyud 'dzin dang gso bya nad pa'i 'dun pa skong thabs bral/ de'i rkyen gyis gter dngos sman la mtshon na bod lugs gso rig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dul 48

st+waṃ0khusmo010spru| 0sa 116khu('is 7dzizu1khu1sakhusbyong khrod nas thon pa'i rdzas de yis mi'i lus su log nus mi 'byung ba'i bden dpang byas nas mu mthud bed spyod bya dgos/ dper na dngul chur btso bkru sbyangs gsum byas nas thon pa'i btso thal la krung go'i rgyal khab nas dug med ces rabs dang rim pa'i bden dpang thob yod pa lta bu/srog chags sman yang de bzhin byas chog dper na nub lugs sman sbyor dbyo to so'u(ṣṭhalolko)yang thog mar nor dang phag gi sha sha men guṣṭhaṣā)las blangs te grub pa'i phyir/ 'dir srog chags sman las bse ru dang gla rtsi sogs gtong mi chog pa ni rtsa che'i srog chags de dag nub par dog pa yin pas/ sman rdzas de rigs la tshab sman gtong dgos/ tshab sman gtong skabs rdzas de'i ro nus zhu rjes sogs gtong yul gyi rjes su mthun pa zhig yin pa las gong smros ltar gi wang gi tshab tu rgya nang gi mis bzos gi wang gtong ba lta bu byed mi rung / rang gzhung du mkhris khaṇḍa dang lug ru ser po sogs kyis gi wang bzo srol yod pa de btang na gi wang dngos kyi ro nus zhu rjes dang mthun la/ rgya nang nas thon pa'i mis bzos gi wang lta bu'i log nus 'byung mi srid/ bod lugs gso rig gi0smoṣṭazer tshe sman rdzas rnams tshad ldan yin pa gzhir byas thog 'dul sbyong dang phyag len cha tshang byed thub pa'i 'khor khang zhig dgos pa las/ da lta'i 'khor khang 'dis bod lugs gso rig gi 'dun pa skong ba las gnod phog pa'i skor gong smros ltar/ 'on kyang6smo2yi rtsa don du thon skyed sgrig chas kyis sman gyi rgyu spus la gnod mi chog pa dang yang na sman la btsog 'gyur sogs thebs mi chog ces 'khod 49

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskayod mod/ da lta phye mar bzo byed kyi 'phrul chas kyang ngal ma gsos par yun ring bkol na de las thon pa'i sman phye tsha mor chags 'dug ril bu'i skor gong du song zin pas 'dir bskyar bzlos mi bya/ bdag gi bsam gzhigs su sman rdzas bzo grwa so sor thob pa'i chog mchan yi ger ltos te/sbyor ba de rnams su rdzas rnams 'dul dgos tshe cha rkyen gang dag tshang dgos par gzhigs nas/ bzo grwa der 'dul sbyong gi cha rkyen 'di dag tshang dgos zhes gtan la dbab dgos/ cong zhi drug pa dang bdud rtsi sum sbyor gnyis kho na'i chog mchan yi ge thob pa'i bzo grwa zhig tu mtshon na/ bzo grwa de'i 'dul sbyong khang du thal sman dang / khaṇḍa/ sman chang / sman mar sogs bzo sa'i cha rkyen mi dgos/ cong zhi 'phrul thal gyi chog mchan yod pa'i sman rdzas bzo grwa zhig la mtshon na/ der phye ma bzo sa dang thal sman bzo sa/spyin thum skon sa/ shun pags rgyag sa tsam las mi dgos/ 0ṣṭa2ni sman khang gi khongs gtogs sdeb sbyor khang gi lam lugs yin zhing / lam lugs de ni rtsa ba'i cha nas6smoṣṭayi dgongs don dang mtshungs kyang / cha rkyen de bzhin mthon po med/ 0ṣṭaṣṭanas thon pa'i sbyor sde rnams sman khang rang gi nang khul nas bkol rgyu las tshong ra'i steng 'grems mi chog sman khang gi sdeb sbyor khang zhig la mtshon na tha na sman sbyor brgya'i yan bzo bzhin pas/ bu92yi 'khor khang rnams su phal cher cha tshang ba'i 'dul sbyong byed sa re dgos 'dug gong gi cha rkyen rnams 'dzoms tshe de rnams su 'dul sbyong phyag len gzhung ltar byas nas der gzhan gyi dris ma gos shing btsog bsgyur ma thebs 50

st+waṃpa(smo0102sta 00 116dzi(mi0 lirduzu1khu1sakhupar thon pa'i sbyor ba rnams bod sman dngos yin la/ bod lugs0smoṣṭa'am0ṣṭaṣṭanas thon pa'i sbyor ba'ang yin/rang lugs kyi phyag len rgyud 'dzin byas thog gzhan lugs kyi legs cha dang rgyal spyi'i sman sbyor rig pa'i rtsa don brtsi srung bya rgyu ni thengs 'di'i brjod gzhi'i yang snying yin/ de'i rkyen gyis0smoṣṭayi rtsa don duṣṭasmo rigs dngaram̐ṭwāṃblurigs ma bcos rgyu cha nas sman gyi zhib las dang skam sa/ thum rgyag sa bcas 'khor khang gzhan dang so sor yin zhing / mdor na 'phrul chas sogs tshang ma ched spyod yin dgos zhes dang / yang de las btsan dug skye dngos phra rab nas 'bu phra'i sbrum sgong bzos dngos thon skyed ni rang rang gi thon skyed byed sa nas thon skyed byed dgos zhes pa'i dgongs don la'ang bsam mno zhig mi gtong ga med yin/ rang gzhung gi dgongs don dngos su skyes dngos sman gang rung zhig la mtshon na btu dus nas rdzas gzhan gyi dris ma phog cing so sor skam dgos/ de bzhin gter dngos sman sogs sman rdzas gzhan rnams kyang gtsang ma byed dgos/ nyar tshags byed skabs phan tshun dris ma gos par so sor nyar rgyu sogs bstan yod pa ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi las/ du ba ma phog gzhan gyi dris ma gos// rang gi nus ldan yon tan dpag tu med ces dang / gsum pa sman rnams nor bu bdud rtsi dang //mchod rdzas shes par bya ba gsum yin te zhes dang / sman rnams mchod pa'i rdzas kyi rigs su shes// zhes pa ltar yin mod/ da lta de bzhin phyag len bgyi mkhan ma ning gi bu ltar gyur/ de na da lta'i sman rdzas bzo grwa che 51

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagras 'ga' shas su sman gyi sbyor sde bzhi bcu lnga bcu re'am de las mang bar bzo bzhin pas/ sbyor sde mang po'i chog mchan thob pa'i bzo grwa tshos bzo bzhin pa'i sbyor ba de dag gi khrod na dug shas can gyi sman sna re gnyis sam de las mang ba re yod srid/ don ngo mar6smoṣṭayi dgongs don brtsi srung byed na sman rdzas bzo grwa de dag la6smoṣṭayi 'khor khang kha shas re dgos 'dug pa smros med yin/ dper na sman rdzas bzo grwa zhig gi sbyor sde rnams kyi khrod na dug shas can gyi sman bong nga nag po dang stag sha/ kyi lce gsum mchis pa'i dbang du btang na/ rdzas de gsum mkho sa'i sbyor sde rnams la logs su 'khor khang re dgos shing / dug med sbyor sde rnams la 'khor khang gcig bcas sman rdzas bzo grwa der 'khor khang bzhi dgos pa'i phyir/ 0smo2yi lam du zhugs pa'i sman rdzas bzo grwa tsho'i khrod na gcig nas bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs don dang mi mthun zhing / gnyis nas0smoṣṭayi rtsa don dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod mi nyung ba re yod pas/ tshong don kho nar dmigs nas gang la yang do snang mi bya ba'i bya spyod rnams spel mtshams bzhag na legs/gsum pa/ rang gzhung dang mthun pa'i6lo yi lam lugs shig dgos pa'i skor dang lam lugs de bod yig gi steng nas lag bstar bya dgos pa'i skor/spyir mi rigs shig dar rgyas su gtong na rang mi rigs kyi skad dang yi ger brten nas gnas skabs dang ma 'ongs pa'i spyi tshogs khrod mkho ba'i 52

st+waṃ0rdusmo010smyata 00 116༷rdu2ba 4dziskye1dzukṣekhushes bya rnams gsog 'jog byas nas/ rang mi rigs gtso bor bzung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/ de na thog mar0smo2dang022yi gzhung lugs cha tshang zhig bod yig tu bsgyur zhing gnas skabs da lta'i srol bzhin gzhung lugs der brten nas lo2—3gyi bar tsam du6smoṣṭadang0ṣṭaṣṭayi 'khor khang nas zin thor bkod dgos pa'i rigs sogs tshang ma bod yig gis 'bri dgos/ kha cig gis0smoṣṭayi 'khor khang nas zin thor bkod dgos pa'i gnas tshul rnams rgya yig las bod yig gis bkod mi thub zer na/ 0smo2yi lam lugs ni spyi lo1989lo nas mgo bzung ste rgya yig tu bsgyur zhing rtsa don de lag bstar byed mgo brtsams pa las/ de'i sngon rang rgyal gyi sman bzo grwa'i bca' khrims su0smo9yi rtsa don med pa'i phyir/de'i rkyen gyis sngon med gzhung lugs shig rgya yig tu bsgyur te rgya yig gi steng nas lag bstar bya thub na/ gzhung de bod yig tu bsgyur te bod yig gi steng nas lag bstar bya mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan khab rtse tsam yang ma mchis/lhag par bod sman bzo grwa zhig la mtshon na bod yig gi steng nas6smo2yi rtsa don lag bstar byas na bod lugs gso rig ni bod yig gi steng nas 'tshar longs byung ba dang / tshad ldan gyi bod sman sdeb sbyor mkhan zhig yin na bod yig steng nas rim bzhin nar son pa'i bod lugs gso rig bod yig gi steng nas sbyang ba zhig yin pas/ a ma'i lham a pha'i zhwa shul du 'jog pa lta bu'i rgya yig gi lam nas zin bris rgyag don ma mchis so// gong nas bshad pa'i lo2—3gyi bar 'di ni nga tshor mtshon na bar brgal gyi dus 53

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaskabs tsam yin la/ dus skabs 'dir0smoṣṭayi gzhung lugs la rgyus mnga' yod pa'i na gzhon tsho dang srol rgyun gyi phyag len la mkhas pa'i rgan gras rnams kyi lta ba gnyis kyi dbu ma'i lam nas/ rang re'i bod sman gyi sdeb sbyor rig par mu mthud du rang rkya 'pher ba'i 'tsho gnas shig bskrun dgos/'di lta bu'i tshad gzhi zhig gtan khel bya skabs/ da lta'i05ṣṭayi 'khor khang gi tshad gzhi ru ma tshud pa'i 'dul sbyong khang sogs su 'di dang 'di lta bu'i cha rkyen dgos zhes gtan la dbab dgos/ de nas da lta'i rgyud rim khrod sman nus la thad kar phog thug gtong bzhin pa'i gnas rnams la bsgyur bcos byed dgos/ dper na ril bu skam sa yang sman nus la phog thug med pa'i skam srol zhig gsar gtod dam yang na gzhan gyi dris ma gos pa sogs ches gtsang ma'i sgos srol rgyun ltar skam dgos/gal te bdag gi rtsom thung 'di rigs mthun skye bo gang mang zhig gi spyan lam du lhag pa'i skal ba ldan tshe/ sprang bos gnam gang yod med brtsad pa'i dper mi 'jog par chos nor gnyis med kyi sprang phrug zhig gis rang mi rigs kyi gso rig 'phar rtsar shugs snon rgyag pa'i rlung shugs khab rtse tsam du brtsi rogs//mjug mthar phran gyis bris pa'i dpyad rtsom 'dir nongs spyod mchis na zhang blon sogs sman srung rnams la bshags shing / dge ba'i cha tsam re mchis na lus can tshe yi bar chad sel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /54

st+waṃb(smo010spru༈ 0sa rwa16dzi(migo krorduzu1dzu1bakhuslo srin nad kyi brtag bcos skor ches mdor bsdus su bkod pa lhag bsam nyi ma'i 'od snang /deng rabs gso rig dgongs pa'i ce he'am12 nad kyis mi'i rigs kyi che srog la slar yang dpung 'jug byas nas gnyan srin de 'gos khyab tu 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ 'dus 'dril dug srin gyis skyed pa'i ce he nad de'i rgyu rtags la bdag gis bsam gzhigs yang yang btang mthar/ da lta bod lugs sman pa phal mo ches nad gzhi 'di gcong nad la ngos 'dzin bzhin pa 'di cung mi 'tsham pa'i blo zhig kyang 'gog med du byung rkyen/thengs 'dir ce he nad 'di gcong nad la ngos bzung na mi 'thad pa'i skor dang / nad 'di gso bya gcig nas gcig brgyud de yams thabs su 'gos 'gro ba'i brgyud rim/ gnyan srin de glo bar babs pa'i rtags dang de'i bcos thabs sogs gna' deng gso rig la gzhi bcol zhing der rang gi nad thog nyams myong gis cung zur rgyan pa'i tshul tu bkod na bgyi ba 'di don du gnyer ba'i skye 'gro kha shas la tog tsam phan par snyam nas ches mdor bsdus su bkod par/55

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang po/ ce he nad gnyan srin gyis skyed pa'i nad gzhir ngos bzung na 'os 'tsham yin pa'i skor/thog mar bod lugs gso byed pa tshos 'dus 'dril dug srin gyis skyed pa'i nad gzhir gcong nad ces ming 'dogs don ni rgyud las/ glo gcong sha skem shes chung 'gul mi nus// byi la'i mgul 'dra zas sman phan skyed chung // zhes gsungs pa ltar glo gcong gi nad rtags su sha skem zhing shes pa chung la 'gul bskyod khag pa'am mi nus pa/ dbugs gtong len byed skabs byi la'i mgul 'dra bar ngar ngar gyi sgra grags/ zas spyod mi 'phrod pa'i rigs 'dzems shing gnyen po sman gyis bcos par phan skyed chung bas/de dang 'dus 'dril dug srin gyis skyed pa'i glo ba'i ce he nad kyi rtags dang cung mtshungs pas thog mar glo ba'i ce he nad la glo gcong zhes ming btags/ de bzhin 'dus 'dril dug srin gyis skyed pa'i ce he nad tshang mar gcong nad ces btags/ dper na 'dus 'dril dug srin glo bar babs nas nad phog par glo gcong dang mkhal mar phog par mkhal gcong /rgyu mar phog na rgyu gcong / sgal tshigs su phog na sgal tshigs kyi rus gcong /mchin par phog na mchin gcong / lgang bar phog na lgang ba'i gcong nad sogs zer bzhin pas/ bod lugs sman pa zhig gis nad ming de dag la thad kar ltos tshe rgyu ma zhu ba las byung ba'i sha skem shing zungs zad pa'i nad rnying 'gar go rgyu las gzhan don ci yang mtshon mi thub/ nga tshos nad gzhi 56

st+waṃs(smo010sprusmo 0ba 116dzi(skya0 ⑪rduzu10krodzizhig la zhib 'jug bya dgos tshe thog mar nad gzhi de'i rgyu dang rkyen gsal rtogs byas mthar nad de'i rtags la gzhigs rgyu dang / de nas der sman pa'i gnyen po 'tshol zhib bya rgyu bcas ni spyi 'gros kyi lugs shig yin/ de na gcong nad ni yun ring nad kyis mnar bas srog gnas pa'i rten lus zungs rnams zad cing skem por gyur ba'i don du go ba zhig dang / yang na karma bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'grel tu/ gcong nad ni khong nad do// de ma zhu ba'i rgyu las byung ba'o// zhes gsungs 'dugagong gi bzhed tshul gnyis las snga ma'i rigs 'bras bur bltos nas bshad pa dang / phyi ma'i rigs rgyur bltos nas bshad pas/ mdo don rgyu ma zhu bas skyed pa'i khong nad yun lon zungs zad la go de ni rgyud las/ sde bzhi gcong gi rtsa ba ma zhu ba// zhes dang / yang de las/ bad mkhris rlung gis 'ju ba'i mthu nyams te// myags byed bad kan dag gis myags ma nus//'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pas 'ju ma nus// me mnyam rlung gis dwangs snyigs 'byed ma nus// de la ma zhu zhes su brjod pa yin// ma zhu'i dbang gis pho ba'i bad kan 'phel// be snabs de yis rlung rgyu'i rtsa sbubs bkag /lhen dang lcags dreg me drod nyams la sogs// gcong nad ma lus skyed par byed pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar bad kan myags byed dang mkhris pa 'ju byed/ rlung me mnyam gsum gyis smin zhing 'ju ba'i mthu dang nus pa nyams nas rdzas gang zhig pho bar slebs pa de dang po bad kan myags byed kyis 'dag pa ltar ram cham cham la btang nas myags par byed mi nus par 57

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskarang sor lus/ de nas 'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pas 'ju ma thub pa'am ma zhu ba/ de nas me mnyam rlung gis dwangs snyigs 'byed ma nus par 'dres mar gnas/ log lam du zhugs pa'i rgyu der ma zhu ba zhes brjod/ ma zhu de'i dbang gis pho ba'i bad kan 'phel ba'i be snabs de yis rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa sbubs rnams bkag nas lhen dang / lcags dreg me drod nyams la sogs pa'i gcong nad rigs ma lus pa skyed par byed/ 'on kyang 'dus 'dril dug srin gyis skyed pa'i ce he nad ni gong ltar ma zhu bas skyed pa zhig min par/ gnyan srin ltar 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba zhig yin phyir bdag gi bsam gzhigs su 'dus 'dril dug srin gyis skyed pa'i ce he nad 'di bod lugs gso rig gzhung gi gnyan srin gyis skyed pa'i nad cig tu ngos bzung na legs snyam/ de ni dpal spungs dbon karma bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i bka' 'grel tu/ gnyan nad ni ngo bo lus la gnas pa'i lhan skyes kyi srin bu dang nad bdag gis skyed pa'i par pa ta zhes pa'i dug can gyi srin bu gnyis rkyen gyis phrad nas lus zungs/ dri ma bcas la 'bab pa'i dug rims la zer zhing / nges tshig ni srin bu khros pa'i dug gis lus zungs dri ma bcas ma rung byed cing / 'phral du srog 'phrog pa'i gdug pa can gyi nad nyen che ba'i ming ngo // zhes gsungs pa ltar par pa ta ni mi'i lus na lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu zhig min par rjes byung gi srin bu zhig yin/ gzhan gnyan srin par pa ta zhes pa ni srin bu rigs gcig ma yin zhing phyi rol yul nas mi'i lus su 'gos srid pa'i 58

st+waṃ0(smo010sprushā 0ba 116༷rdumis 7rduzu1khu1badziganyan srin rigs gang mang zhig gi spyi ming yin par 'dod/ de ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhir/ dbye ba babs sa ming gis tha dad de// mgo la babs na klad gzer zhes bya zhing // gre bar gag pa ro stod gzer thung ste/ / pho bar gnyan glang rgyu mar rgyu gzer la// lpags la me dbal tshigs la rmen bu skyed//nywa la nywa log shar babs lhog par bshad// sha rus rtsar bem 'drul phyir 'bras zhes bya// zhes gsungs pa'i gong gi klad gzer gyi srin bu dang lhog pa'i srin bu/ me dbal gyi srin bu/ 'bras kyi srin bu sogs rdzas 'gyur rig pa'i 'phrul chas kyis brtag tshe tha dad du snang bas kyang ra sprod byed thub/gzhan yang slob dpon padma'i bdud rtsi bum bzang las/ nad gzhi gang la yod par 'bab/ ming ni srin bu par pa ta bya ba yin/ rgyu ni gdon gyis bskyed/ 'jug ni ba spu'i bu ga dang sna nas 'jug ces dang / lhan thabs su/ rgyu la rkyen des tre tres ho zhes sam// par pa ta de srin gyi gzugs sprul ba// rtsangs pa'i mgo dbyibs kha che sbrul lta bu'i// mjug ring rta bla ltar du yan lag mang // rlung gshog ldan pas phyogs kun rgyu ba ste// bar snang khams nas ba spu'i sna sgor 'jug / ces gsungs pa ltar par pa ta zhes pa'i gnyan srin 'di nad can mi'i kha rlangs sam de mkha' dbugs su khyab par mchis pa'i gnyan srin rnams nad med mi'i ba spu'i bu ga dang sna khung / gre ba dag brgyud nas 'gos 'ongs pa'i brgyud rim 'di yang / deng rabs gso rig dgongs pa'i 'dus 'dril dug srin ni mi'i lus su thog ma nas mchis pa'i lhan skyes kyi srin bu zhig min par phyi rol yul nas 'gos khyab 59

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskarang bzhin gyis thon pa'i dug srin zhig yin zhing / dug srin de gson lus la brten nas skyes 'phel byed thub pa las/ gal te srog chags shig gi lus la ma brten tshe 'phel mi thub/ dug srin 'di mkha' rlung dang 'grogs pa'i thal rdul du nyin brgyad nas bcu bar 'tsho thub pas/ nad med mis dug srin mchis pa'i mkha' rlung snar rngub pa'am yang na dug srin de nad med mi'i ba spu'i bu ga nas pags pa brgyud de lus su zhugs/ gzhan dug srin 'gos 'dug pa'i kha rlangs thad kar phog pas 'gos pa sogs gong gi par pa ta lus su zhugs pa'i rnam par yongs su mthun phyir/ gong 'og gzhung lugs gnyis kyi brjod tshul mi 'dra ba tsam las brjod snying gcig tu khel 'dug de na ce he nad gcod nad la ngos bzung na mi 'tsham zhing gnyan srin gyis skyed pa'i nad cig tu ngos bzung na ha cang legs snyam/ dper na glo ba'i ce her glo srin nam glo ba'i gnyan srin dang / mkhal ma'i ce her mkhal srin nam mkhal ma'i gnyan srin lta bu/ de yang mkhan chen bai ro tsa nas kyang / bden cing 'thad na legs bshad byis pa'i tshig kyang nyon// mi bden don dang 'gal na rgyal ba'i bka' yang zhog / ces gsungs 'dug pas phran gyis kyang 'di ltar brjod na 'gal ba med par snyam/gnyis pa/ gnyan srin de'i dbye ba dang 'tsho tshad/ 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba'i rgyu lam sogs bshad pa/gnyan srin der dbyibs kyi sgo nas mi'i bzo dbyibs dang glang gi bzo 60

st+waṃb(smo010sprukau 00 116dzirdumib ⑪khuskye107dzidabyibs/ byi'u yi bzo dbyibs/ byi ba'i bzo dbyibs bcas bzhi mchis/de dag las mi'i rigs la mi'i bzo dbyibs dang glang gi bzo dbyibs gnyis phog mang / gnyan srin de rnams sdod khang dron mo'am nyi 'od mi phog sa'i bsil grib tu dor ba'i kha lud du zla drug nas brgyad bar 'tsho thub/gal te kha lud du yod pa'i gnyan srin der nyi 'od chu tshod gnyis la phog na gnyan srin de shi 'gro/ yang na tsi we zhan gyi 'od skar ma bcu gnyis nas nyi shur phog rjes shi 'gro/ spyir bzha' tshan dang brlan gsher che sar 'tsho yun ring zhing skam sar 'tsho yun thung / gnyan srin de mi'i lus su zhugs pa'i brgyud rim ni pags pa dang 'ju lam/ dbugs lam bcas gsum yin/de las kyang pags pa dang 'ju lam brgyud nas 'gos 'ongs pa'i tshad gzhi ha cang dma'/ de ni pho ba dang rgyu ma long ga sogs 'ju byed ma lag rnams kyi nang ngos su mchis pa'i skyi shun srab mo der 'gog nus shin tu che bas gnyan srin 'di gnas de dag tu skyes 'phel byung rgyu khag 'gos khyab tu 'gro sa'i rgyu lam gtso bo dbugs lam yin pas glo bar nad gzhi 'di phog mang / gzhan mkhal ma dang klad pa lgang ba sogs su'ang khrag dang men bu brgyud nas 'go bzhin 'dug gsham nas bdag gis gnyan srin 'dis glo yul bzung nas nad 'gyur byung ba'i rgyu rkyen dang dbye ba/ brtag thabs dang nad rtags/ bcos thabs sogs gtso bor bzung nas bshad par bya'o//61

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagasum pa/ slo srin nad kyi rgyu rkyen bshad pa/de yang man ngag lhan thabs su/ rgyu la rkyen des tre tres ho zhes sam//par pa ta de srin gyi gzugs sprul ba// rtsangs pa'i mgo dbyibs kha che sbrul lta bu'i// mjug ring rta bla ltar du yan lag mang // rlung gshog ldan pas phyogs kun rgyu ba ste// bar snang khams nas ba spu'i sna sgo 'jug / ces gsungs pa ltar glo srin phog pa'i nad pas glo brgyab pa'i kha rlangs phog pas gnyan srin kha rlangs brgyud nas phog pa'am yang na glo brgyab rjes gnyan srin dbugs lam brgyud nas mchil ma'i zegs ma mang po dang lhan bar snang du 'thor/ ches chung ba'i gnyan srin yod pa'i mchil phran de dag mkha' rlung nang yun ring 'dug thub/ mkha' rlung du khyab pa'i gnyan srin yod pa'i mchil phran de mis dbugs gtong len byed skabs sna khung dang gre ba brgyud nas glo bar babs/bzhi ba/ blo srin nad kyi dbye ba bshad pa/nad gzhi 'dir gtso bo'i sgo nas thog mar byung ba'i glo srin dang slar byung glo srin/ khrag gi 'khor rgyun la brten nas 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba'i glo srin/ dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi glo rdol glo srin/ brang skyi'i gnyan srin bcas lnga mchis/62

sabardusmo010spru| 0sa 116khu(mib krokhuzu101bakhulnga ba/ slo srin nad kyi rtags bshad pa/spyi'i rtags su glo ba bad kan sa chu'i rang bzhin can gyi yul yin pas dbyar dus bde la dgun dus na/ nyin par bde la mtshan mor na/ lhag par glo srin gyi nad 'di phog tshe byad bzhin nag por gyur nas dug phog pa ltar gyi rtags thon/ dgong dro'i dus su lus la tsha ba rgyas shing skabs 'gar lus grang shum byed/ gnyid khung du lus rngul mang du thon rkyen gnyid sad skabs lus steng mal gos 'byar 'dug gzhan sgyid pa skyur la shes pa chung zhing sems khums mi bde ba/ snying gi 'phar grangs je mgyogs su 'gro/mtshan gnyid yer zhing rna bar 'ur 'khrog sgrog pa dang mgo yu 'khor/ kha zas la yi ga med cing lus zungs rnams rim bzhin zad nas lus sha rid por 'gro/ dbugs gtong len dka' zhing rgyab mdun sbrags nas gzer/thog ma'i dus lud pa wu gsob can lu/ rim bzhin rnag khrag 'dres mar lu/bud med rnams la gong gi rtags rnams kyi steng zla mtshan 'byams pa'am yang na 'gag pa/ dus ltar mi 'bab pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yang 'byung srid/ bye brag so so'i rtags las/ 1 thog mar byung ba'i glo srin ni mang che ba byis par phog mang bas der byis pa'i glo srin yang zer/ ches thog mar gnyan srin gyis gnas bzung nas nad 'gyur byung ba'i yul der thog ma'i nad 'gyur lte gnas zer/ thog ma'i nad 'gyur lte gnas ni glo ba'i yal 'dabs stod ma'i smad phyogs sam smad ma'i stod phyogs kyi brang skyi'i mdun 63

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zegadang/ glo ba g.yas g.yon gnyis las g.yas phyogs bcas su byung mang /nad 'gyur byung ba'i che chung ni10⑪tsam yin/ de'i kha dog ser skya yin la/ngo bo rlon zhing yun lon rjes nad 'gyur byung sa'i gnas de skam gyong du 'gro/2 slar byung glo srin ni gso byar de sngon glo srin nad phog cing rjes nas slar yang glo srin nad phog par zer/ nad gzhi 'di rigs byung ba'i rgyur sna gnyis te/ dang po ni phyi rol yul nas glo srin gyi gnyan srin 'gos khyab tu 'ongs pa/ gnyis pa ni sngon phog pa'i glo srin gyi gnyan srin slar yang rang lus nas skyes 'phel byung ba/ slar byung glo srin gyi gtso bo'i nad 'gyur byung sa ni glo rtse yin/3 khrag gi 'khor rgyun la brten nas 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba'i glo srin ni/thog mar byung ba'i glo srin nas thon zhing / de ni glo sgo'i rmen bu'i rtsa mdud dam yang na nad 'gyur byung sa'i gnas kyi rtsa phran dag nas glo srin gyi gnyan srin 'dzul te glo ba'i nad 'gyur ma byung sa'i gnas sam lus kyi gnas gzhan du khrag rtsa brgyud nas 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba'i rigs shig yin/ der myur ba'i rang zhin can dang cung myur ba'i rang bzhin can/ dal ba'i rang bzhin can bcas gsum mchis/ myur ba'i rang bzhin can ni dus yun thung ngu'i nang gnyan srin 'bor chen zhig lus kyi khrag rgyun 'khor rgyugs nang 'dzul nas gnas gzhan ste rgyu ma dang mkhal ma klad pa sogs su byer 'gro/ de'i rtags su sgyid pa skyur zhing 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba je zhan du 'gro/64
