st+waṃgo(smo010sprusnga 00 116khurdu3so krodziskye1khu1baXpags 'og nas khrag thon/ lus kyi gang sar smug thig 'byung zhing zungs khrag nyams pa sogs kyi rtags thon/ bye brag rgyu mar babs na btsog pa 'gag cing grod pa sbos pa'am 'khru ba/ kha zas la dang ga med pa/ klad par babs na shes pa mi gsal zhing mgo na/ lus la tsha ba rgyas shing skyug mer langs/ mig gis gsal bor mi mthong / glo bar babs na dbugs hal zhing gtong len khag glo lu mang zhing lud par khrag 'dres/ mkhal mar babs na mkhal rked na zhing lus grang shum byed/ skabs 'gar chu sor tsha 'brab gtong / myur ba'i rang bzhin can 'di dus thog ma bcos par klad pa lta bur byer tshe srog nyen che bas gzab/ cung myur ba'i rang bzhin can dang dal ba'i rang bzhin can gnyis dus yun ring po'i nang gnyan srin 'bor chung re yang yang khrag rgyun 'khor rgyugs nang 'dzul nas mched 'gro ba zhig dang / nad gzhi 'di rigs gnas gzhan byer stangs gong gi myur ba'i rang bzhin can ltar yin mod/ byer 'gor po yod pas gong ltar gzab mi dgos/ de'i rtags su tsha ba phran bu yang yang rgyas shing kha zas la dang ga med pa/ lus sha skam pa/ mtshan gnyid chung zhing gnyid khug skabs rngul nag thon/4 dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi glo rdol glo srin ni glo srin phog nas lo bcu yan son pa'i rigs la byung mang zhing glo bar u khung 'dug gzhan la 'gos khyab rang bzhin che/ nad rtags su dbugs hal zhing sha mdog smug nag chags/ byang khog g.yas g.yon gnyis cha mi snyoms/ na sar kong kyong 65

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskachags/ rtsib ma'i bar je dog tu 'gro/ byang khog stod kyi sha gnad rnams nyams shing nad 'gyur byung sar mdzub mos brdung na nyog sgra grags/ glo ba'i yul du brdung na dbugs 'tshangs nas skrangs yod pas rnga sgra grags/ 5glog 'od kyis brtag na glo bar i khung mchis shing dbugs 'tshangs nas skrangs rkyen glo ba cher rgyas pas mchin dri mar babs 'dug gzhan snying gi gnas 'gyur zhing brang skyi mthug tu phyin/5 brang skyi'i gnyan srin ni byis pa dang na gzhon la phog mang / der skam pa'i rang bzhin can dang sim rlon rang bzhin can/ rnag brang bcas gsum mchis/ nad gzhi 'di phog pa'i brgyud rim ni brang skyi dang bar thag nye ba'i glo ba nas thad kar phog pa'am yang na men bu brgyud nas phog pa/khrag gi 'khor rgyun nas phog pa bcas gsum 'dug skam pa'i rang bzhin can la nad rtags dmigs bsal can med la yun lon rjes sim rlon rang bzhin can du 'gyur 'gro/ sim rlon rang bzhin can gyi rtags su lus la tsha rgyas shing rngul nag mang ba dang sgyid pa skyur ba/ byang khog stod du chu bsags shing rgyab mdun sbrags nas gzer/ rnag brang gi rtags su dug nad phog pa'i rtags mchis shing zungs khrag zad pa/ lus sha rid cing byang khog stod du rnag bsags pa/ gso bya kha shas la rnag dang lhan du dbugs kyang bsags 'dug pa bcas so// 66

st+waṃbardusmo010sprusmo 0ba 116rdurdumi0 pa rduzu1dzu10khudrug pa/ blo srin nad kyi bcos thabs bshad pa/nad gzhi 'di'i bcos thabs la deng rabs gso rig gis dbyi yan cin(zaloltasko)dngali hphu'u phin(lko//rkyukyā)/ pichin zhan 'an(khrikyikhyiṣṭhaloltaṣpe)/len me'i sulko:2rsārsā)/ dbyi'an tin khron(muṣṭha1khyobho)/ te 'an ci hre dbyang son nā(ṭwātswamazlo7khrirnyermyekhrotstshalko)sogs las sna gsum nas lnga bar lhan du 'thung bzhin pa'am/ yang na li hphu'u phin ten(lke/)rkyukhrisnra1)lta bu 'thung bzhin 'dug li hphu'u phin ten gyi phan nus cung legs kyang rin gong shin tu mtho bas gso byas 'thung rgyu khag gzhan rnams gzhung ltar lo phyed nas gcig gnyis rer btung yang de tsam gyi phan 'bras mi 'byung zhing / de'i log nus su pho mchin gnyis gtso byas pa'i don snod gzhan la nad 'gyur thebs kyin 'dugand 'dir rang re'i bod kyi gso gzhung du bkod pa'i sman sbyor rigs bkol na phan nus legs shing log nus chung ba'i dge mtshan ldan pas gsham nas bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs don gzhir bzung nas spyi bye brag gi bcos thabs sogs cung 'god par bya ba la/ dang po spyi'i bcos thabs su/ sman sbyor bse ru nyer lnga dang bse ru bcu bzhi/ zangs thal nyer lnga/ chu sman zangs thal nyer lnga/ cu gang nyer lnga/ gtso bo nyer lnga/ rin chen skem gyi sbyor ba/ da lis bcu drug glo 'khun brgyad pa/ rgun 'brum bdun pa/ zangs thal nyer drug sogs las sna re gnyis tsam zla lnga drug rer bsten na nad pa mang shas kyi nad gzhir sangs drag 'byung thub/ gong gi 67

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasbyor sde dag las bse ru nyer lnga dang bse ru bcu bzhi/ zangs thal nyer lnga rnams kyi phan nus shin tu legs kyang sbyor ba 'di dag tu bse ru dngos dgos mod/ kha cig gis kha sha sha ba'i rwa yang de dang 'dra zhes gsungs 'dug pas bse ru'i tshab tu kha sha'i rwa dang sha ba'i khrag rwa btang na chog ces 'phen bzhin pas der de tsam gyi phan nus gtan nas thon gyin mi 'dug 'on kyang deng skabs bse ru sman du gtong mi chog pas der tshab sman zhig mi gtong ga med yin/ gzhan rje zur mkhar ba'i glo rnag drag skyugs kyi sbyor ba dang / zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos tsher sngon sbyor ba sogs kyi sbyor sde dang phan nus la ltos na nad gzhi 'dir shin tu phan pa'i tshor snang re ster yang sbyor sde de dag bdag gi 'khor yug tu med pas nad thog steng bkol thabs bral/ nad gzhi 'di'i rjes gcod du tshigs pa bzhi ba dang lnga bar me gdab/gnyis pa bye brag gi bcos thabs su thog mar byung ba'i glo srin dang slar byung glo srin/ khrag gi 'khor rgyun la brten nas 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba'i glo srin/ dal ba'i rang bzhin gyi glo rdol glo srin bcas la spyi'i bcos thabs ltar bya/ der dper na snga dro dang phyi dro da lis bcu drug ril bu gsum rer kha tshar du khyung lnga ril bu lnga re/ nyin gung zangs thal nyer lnga gnyis re bcas zla gsum la bsten rjes nad gzhir brtag dpyad bya rgyu/ yang na snga dro dang phyi dro rgun 'brum bdun pa ril bu gsum rer kha tshar du khyung lnga lnga re/nyin gung gtso bo nyer lnga'am bse ru nyer lnga ril bu gnyis re bcas gong ltar 68

rluspurdu'i010sprushā 0ba 116rdurdumib 7rduskye1dzukroXbasten zhing rjes susnuglog 'od sogs kyi brtag dgos/ rlung shas che na nub a gar so lnga'am yang na a gar bco lnga ril bu gsum re bsten rgyu/ zungs zad cing zhan na nub dbang lag bcu ba'am lnga ba ril bu gsum re bsten rgyu/yang cig bshad na nad gzhi 'di rigs la man ngag bye ring las/ glo rnag ril nag ces bya ba// dmar rtsi('bri mog)tshos btsod byi kusgog skyab 'or btsos// chu tshod phrul bor gyur ba nus ldan bsreg / cu (gang)gu8gum)li(shi)ruspurta)starsābu)shijamangar)tsan(dkar)pozholdikrong)//zla ba(rgun 'brum)ga bur sbyar zhing glo rnag la// zangs thal bsnan zhing zhib btags sbrang dkar gyis// ril bu lug ril tsam dril gung gnyis mur//zhes dang / nyams yig brgya rtsa las/ lud pa rnag khrag lu ba la// pho rog nor bu a krong sro lo dkar// spang rtsi do bo star bu ru rta rnams// zhib btags ba 'o dron mos phul la btang // lud pa rnag khrag 'dres la thengs pas chog / ces dang / yang de las/ cu gang sro lo a krong gsum gyis glo tshad gcog star bu pa yag 'bri rta gsum gyis 'dren/ drug sbyor rtsa ba'i sman/ 'dren la ma nu ru rta bsnan/ zhes dang yang de las/ dkar po yar 'dren bcu gsum sbyor ba la// sro lo spang rgyan zi ra dkar po dang // de las srab pa tsan dan dkar dmar dang // cu gang gur gum gi wang sum sbyor la// utpal shing mngar a krong sum gnyis thub// ba yag rtsa ba star bu'i sum cha thub// 'gar shing mid pa 'khril na dzā ti bsnan// chu nad bol gong skrangs na lcam pa bsnan// khrag shas che na ba sha ka bsnan bya// glo ba'i 69

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasman la sman thun chung na mi 'gro/ thun tshad che dgos/ 'phul byed ba'i 'o mas byed/ ces gsungs pa dag lag len tshul bzhin byed thub na yang shin tu legs snyam/brang skyi'i gnyan srin gyi skam pa'i rang bzhin can gong ltar bcos rgyu dang / sim rlon rang bzhin can gyi bcos thabs su gong ltar gyi steng da lis brgyad pa dang a bhi drug thang mang tsam gtong rgyu/ der man ngag bye ring las/ zangs brdar phye ma thur mgo do// mu zi btul ma de dang mnyam//tsha la bzang po thur mgo gang // dngul chu lhad med zho do dang // ma nu ru rta mtheb tshigs tsam// chang sbyar 'dam btags snga dro gcig / byas la ril bu lug ril tsam// nyi mas skam thag chod par bya// sla ngar rdza sbub ril bu bzhag / bar mtshams 'dag pas legs par bcad// steng nas bye ma skam pos mnan// 'og nas shing me bzang po yis// nyi ma phyed tsam bsreg byas la// de nas phog la grang ba dang // rin chen thal bar 'gyur ba yin// de la phur yog zab 'gron thal// bse ru rgyu ru kha sha'i ru// shwa ru btsod ru thun tshad re// tsan dan dkar dmar bsil gsum dang // shing tsha pi ling thun bzang re// zhib par btags pa'i phye ma de// sbrang rtsi phul gsum chu bcad la// mar gsar sdor dang bcas pa de// gong gi sman btab 'dres par bya//lde gu de nyid kham bu re// srod dang snga dro'i dus su za// drag po khro chu'i sbyor ba des// rgya mtsho tsam yang skam par nges// zhes gsungs 'dug pa'i sbyor ba 'di yang nad thog steng phebs pa'i skal ba zhig ldan tshe shin tu phan 70

st+waṃb(smo0102| 00 116dzi(tshi0 ⑪dzispu1khu1bakhusnyam/ byang khog stod du chu mang tsam bsags par yang de las/ glo bar rnag zhugs phyi nang gnyis// phyi rnag rtsib ma'i bar nas dbyung zhes dang /rgyud kyi thur ma'i le'u ru/ de la rtsib ma'i gong bar btsal te dbul// nang du rdol nas thur rtse byol gyis 'gro// zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyab phyogs sog gzhug nas mar drang thad du thig gdab pa'i rtsib ma bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i bar ram brgyad pa dang dgu ba'i bar/ yang na mchan 'og dkyil nas mar drang thad du thig gdab pa'i rtsib ma drug pa dang bdun pa'i bar dug sel ma mog gis dug sel byas shing / sbrid sman1phrocan gyi pho lo kha yin nam lis to kha yin rgyab/ de nas khab ang grangs12can lta bu rtsa bar 'gyig sbubs skon pa zhig gis gnas der gting du1 5 da 2 5khulitsam btsug na khab rtse byol gyis 'gro ba byang khog nang du phug yod pa'i rtags yin/'gyig sbubs kyi sne mo khab gdong5chad1slom can zhig gi rtse mor skon nas rim bzhin phyir 'dren thabs bya/ 'dren thengs rer1'khyam las brgal mi rung / bsags chu mang ba'i rigs la nyin gsum bzhi re'i mtshams nas slar yang thengs re drangs chog byang khog tu rnag bsags par gong ltar gso bcos bya rgyu dang rnag 'dren thabs kyang gong ltar bya/ gal te rnag shin tu nur por chags na byang khog tu0 9phrokho5 mang tsam brgyab nas rnag gsher por bzos nas phyir 'dren thabs bya/ khab ang grangs12yan gyis 'dren dgos/ gso bya re gnyis la rnag dang lhan du dbugs kyang bsags 'dug pas/ gal te dbugs mang bsags nas glo ba je chung du 71

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagyur 'dug na sgrog rus dkyil ngos nas cung phyi zur gyi rtsib ma gnyis pa'i bar khab btsug nas phyir 'dren thabs bya/ phran gyi nad thog lag len du gso bya gsum gyi byang khog stod du bsags pa'i rnag nur po chags par thabs ji ltar bkol yang phyir 'dren ma thub/ gso bya de dag la nub lugs sman pas gshags bcos byed dgos zer yang bdag gis snga nub da lis bcu drug khyung lnga kha tshar can dang / nyin gung zangs thal nyer lnga bcas yun ring bsten du bcug pas sangs drag byung /bdun pa/ mjug bsdu ba/bdag gis bgrang bya bcu'i yun gso bcos khang gi sman pa'i 'gan khur zhing / bgrang bya de dag tu glo srin phog pa'i gso bya mi nyung ba zhig la gso bcos bya rgyu'i go skabs ldan pas/ 'dir 'khod pa ni gso bya de dag la gso bcos byas pa'i brgyud rim nang rang nyid la nyams myong phran bu re thob pa de dang rang re'i gso dpyad kyi gzhung gnyis lhan du spel nas thol byung du bris pa zhig yin/ der nor 'khrul gyi cha dang ma dag pa'i cha sogs mchis tshe rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis dag bcos dang skyon brjod byed rgyu gal//72

st+waṃbasmo00sprukau0ba16༷mib7khuzudzukrordukhrag rlung kau 'dzis nand+ra kyi brtag bcos ra ma tsam glang ba/dang trī/nga ༵shā ༵snasdu snasbya ṭwāṃsna ṭwāṃ zlosna shāsdo snrokā trīsdongs dnghaganyis gyi gshib bsdur//lho 65 /) stuno:de ci :go 1do theṭa:rdokhrag rlung da 'angs nad ga 'a kha ga sa nga rabs ga ga gi gshe thonapo'inadagazhirangosa'adzinabazhinaparangarangahacang khra // //de sori gi kho /skyo gi 'i 'tha~X/ je thong ṭwāṃbs ga ṅgi sa ṭwāṃkā 'id ma ṭwāṃg zlophar rtsa khrag med mar nga bar khrapy-i snyid mdī nad ra/ ra tha mal ṭwāṃ ḍi ngarnyi spyadhi gāspya sdodī rshaṭwāṃ ma nga sdu ṭwāṃ sdo~X༈ py-i kādhi dhipyi/ladhil daṭwāṃ' snyi tsa 901snarnyi'abyeshugs yinanang kta ba༄rdzushupy-iṭwāṃ〉6ṭwāṃdzoṅgizhanasnyingakā tsa rshazlosgropo las khraṭwāṃ zhid man nad / bye ba༄ma shu slopa te sprutho ṭwāṃ nga6khrol2lasadamasdob/'dashugapy-ikyangasnaspriswā2las zlo ngalhakhrolaṭwāṃlas dma~X na ra gnas skabs khrag ṭwāṃ ma narno zlo/khrag da ma nad can nad pa0phro——20phro dal ba rang ban 73

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskamakhal ma'i mkhal 'bras chung ba'i gnyan tshad/ mkhal phor gyi gnyan tshad/sbrum ma reg dug can/ mkhal steng gsher rmen gyi skran nad dang klad nad can bcas kyis thon bzhin pas der phral myur gyi khrag shed mtho nad zer/80phro—90phrogaso bya nyid la rgyu rkyen gsal po med cing lus kyi don snod gzhan du nad 'gyur byung med par khrag shed mthon por chags par khrag shed mtho nad zer/ de yang gong gi khrag shed mthon po'i nad gzhi 'di khrag rlung stod 'tshangs su ngos bzung na 'os 'tsham 'dug pa'i skor ni karma nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i 〈sman bsdus e〉 las khrag rlung stod 'tshangs 'di ngan khrag rlung gis bus pa yin par 'dug ces dang / mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis rlung khrag 'thab nas phan tshun 'khrugs pa'i khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad 'di ni gtso bor khyab byed kyi rlung dang gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs nas rlung khrag 'thab ste ngan khrag rlung gis bus pa'i khrag rlung gi nad du ngos 'dzin byed dgos par gsungs/ gzhan mi dbang sde srid rin po ches mdzad pa'i 〈man ngag lhan thabs〉 su khyab rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbang gis khrag rlung nad byung zhes gsungs 'dug pa dag ni deng rabs gso rig gis 'phar rtsa'i rtsa sbubs su rgyu ba'i rlung gi dwangs ma'i cha ma 'dang bar gtsog rlung gi cha 'phel ba/ khrag gi ngo bo gzhan du 'gyur nas khrag sla bar gyur ba'am khrag 'dril chags pa/ rtsa sbubs kyi nang rol tu khrag dreg chags nas rtsa rgyud je dog tu song rkyen sogs kyis khrag shed mthon por chags bzhin pa gnyis so so'i gzhung lugs kyi 'chad srol tsam las gcig mtshungs 74

st+waṃbardusmo010sprusnga 00 116dzi(tshib kroXskye1dzu1sakhusu 'dugabod lugs gso rig gis khrag rtsa'i rgyu lam 'di bu ga zhig tu rtsis yod cing rtsa sbubs der rlung khrag gnyis rgyu bzhin pa ni 〈dpal ldan rgyud bzhi〉ru/ rgyu lam bu ga'i gnas lugs phyi nang gnyis// nang gi bu ga srog zungs dri ma gsum// chu dang zas rgyu bcu gsum gnas pa yin// zhes dang /ci yang de las/ rlung khrag rgyu ba'i bu ga phyi nang kun// 'brel byas lus ni skyed cing gnas pa dang // srog gi rtsa ba yin phyir rtsa zhes bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar srog rtsa nag po de nang gi bu ga'am srog gi rtsa bar gyur ba'i gnas der rlung khrag gnyis rgyu bzhin pa gsal por bstan yod pa dang / deng rabs gso rig gis glo bar rngub pa'i rlung gi dwangs ma(02)dang glo ba'i sdod rtsa'i khrag snying khams g.yon mar phyin rjes snying khams g.yon ma nas 'phar rtsa che ba'i rigs brgyud pa de ches phra ba'i 'phar rtsa rnams brgyud nas dwangs ma'i cha rnams sha tshil rkang rus khu ba sogs su 'gyur/ de las rlung gi snyigs ma(dzu02)dang khrag gi snyigs ma'am gnas skabs sha tshil sogs su 'gyur ma thub pa'i rigs ches phra ba'i sdod rtsa phra mo rnams nas sdod rtsa che ba'i rigs brgyud nas snying khams g.yas par song zhing de nas glo bar song bas gnas de ru rlung gi snyigs ma rnams dbugs gtong len byed skabs phyir phul bzhin pa dag kyang rtsa sbubs der rgyu bzhin pa rlung khrag gnyis yin pas bod kyi gso rig gi dgongs pa dang ches mthun 'dug gal te gong du bstan pa'i rtsa rgyud der nad 'gyur byung ba'am nang du rgyu ba'i khrag rlung la nad 75

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska'agyur byung tshe khrag shed mthon po'i nad dam khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad 'byung bzhin pa ni gong sman dkon mchog phan dar gyis mdzad pa'i 〈nyams yig brgya rtsa〉 las/ phrag gong gnyis su 'phang sla zhing // sla ba bzhin du gzer phran 'byung // de la ming ni khrag rlung zer// ngo bo khrag ngan rlung bus yin// zhes dang nad gzhi 'dir khrag shas che ba'i khrag rlung dang rlung shas che ba'i khrag rlung gnyis 'byung bzhin 'dugaganyis pa/ khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi rgyu rkyen/nad gzhi 'di'i rgyu ni rlung khyab byed dang rlung gyen rgyu gnyis su 'dod pa mang mod/ lhan thabs su rgyu ni rlung khyab byed gcig pur sbyar 'dug cing yul ni srog rtsa nag po'am khrag rtsar sbyar 'dug rkyen ni 〈nyams yig brgya rtsa〉 las/ de rkyen drag shul las dang chang rgan 'thungs// gnyid chag nyi mas dros dang gyen la phyin// kog nyal sems las lus sems sgrim rnams so// zhes pa ni khrag shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs dang rlung shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs gnyis kyi lhan rkyen du gsungs/ nad gzhi de gnyis kyi so so'i rkyen las dang po rlung shas che ba'i rkyen ni 〈man ngag lhan thabs〉 las/ 1 de rkyen lto dang gnyid chag bser bus bus// mang du smras dang yid mi dga' ba'i tshig / mya ngan sems las che dang chu klung sgra// phyi yul char rlung grang ba kha thal dang // ja sogs bsil ba'i rkyen gyis rlung bslang ste// rlung shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs 'di las 'byung // zhes pa ltar chang rag dang phag sha 76

st+waṃbardusmo010sprusnga 0sa rwa16dzi(skya0 krorduzu1dzu1sadzisogs longs spyod pa'am ngad can bser bu'i khrod sdod drags pa/ chu sgra dang rlangs 'khor gyi sgra che sa'am 'phrul 'khor gyi sgra che sa sogs su sdod drag pas slong bzhin pa dang lhag par khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi rgyu khyab byed rlung ni gsham gyi rkyen 'di dag gis slong bzhin pa de/ 〈man rgyud〉 las/ khyab byed 'gro 'dug rtsed mo drags pa dang // 'jigs dang yi mug kha zas rtsub pas 'khrugs// snying spyugs brgyal 'bog mang du smra ba dang // 'gro 'dod 'jigs skrag mi snyan tshig gi slong zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa/ khrag shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs kyi slong rkyen ni/ yang 〈lhan thabs〉 las/ lus sems 'khrugs pa'i sgo gsum bya ba byas// me nyis drod che sna tshogs chang mang 'thung // drag shul rkyen gyis khrag ngan kha bslangs te// khrag shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs 'di las 'byung zhes pa ltar/ zas skom kha tshwa skyur ba'i rigs bsten drags pa'am rno zhing tsha la snum pa de bcud can gyi rigs rgyun ring bsten pas slong bar byed/ khrag ngan dang khrag 'dril chags pa sogs kyi rgyud rim ni me mnyam rlung dang kha zas zhu ma zhu'i bar na gnas pa'i lus kyi me drod mkhris pa 'ju byed de'i cha shas khrag rang la gnas pa'i me drod gnyis kyi mthu'am stobs nyams par gyur bas/ pho bar zas ma zhu ba'i nyes pa dwangs ma'i char 'dres/ de nas dwangs mar nyes pa'i cha yod pa de khrag tu 'gyur la/ khrag de rang gi char yod pa'i me drod kyis legs par smin ma thub par khrag ngan 'phel zhing rgyas nas nad du gyur/ yang na me drod kyi stobs 'bar drag pas log pa'i las byas te khrag 'phel ba'ang yod/ spyir 77

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dasgros pa'i zla zeskakhrag gi ngo bo drod yin pa ni (dpal ldan rgyud bzhi〉 ru khrag dang mkhris pa tsha ba me ru 'dod ces pa ltar dang / zas spyod sman dpyad drod chen por bsten drags pas khrag 'dril chags pa'am rtsa sbubs kyi ngos su khrag dreg chags pa bcas so//gsum pa/ khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad rtags/nad rtags ni mgo bo na zhing mgo yu 'khor ba dang mig rus na ba/ mig rab rib byed pa/ rna bar 'ur 'khrog sgrog pa/ rgyab mdun sbrags nas gzer zhing dbugs stod du 'tshangs pa dang gnyid yer ba/ kha lce skam zhing snying g.yugs che ba/ skabs 'gar don med khong khro langs pa/ mya ngan dang lus rtsol bas bcag pa/ mtshan mo gnyid bcag pa sogs kyis glo bur je sdug tu 'gro/ nad gzhi lci ba'i rigs la mig sprin dmar por chags shing mig sprin steng gi khrag rtsa phra mo rnams gas rdol 'byung srid/ deng rabs gso rig gi steng nas nad gzhi 'di'i 'phel rim la 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i skabs dang / khrag rtsar nad 'gyur byung ba'i skabs/ don snod dang dbang bor nad 'gyur byung ba'i skabs bcas gsum du bgos 'dug 'phel rim de dag las dang po'i skabs su lus khams kyi rtsa phran rigs la nad 'gyur byung nas khrag shed mthon por chags shing gso bya'i mgo bo na ba dang mgo yu 'khor ba tsam gyi rtags las snying dang mkhal ma klad pa bcas su nad 'gyur byung med pas skabs 'dir 'os 'tsham gyi ngal gso byas shing sman btung ba 78

shīb(smo010sprusmi 0ba 116rdurdutshib kroXzu1dzu10khutsam gyis phyir rgyun ldan du gyur 'gro/ 'phel rim gnyis pa'i skabs su 'phar rtsa phra mo dang chung ngu'i rig mkhregs por gyur ba'am rtsa sbubs je dog tu 'gro/ yang na rtsa phran de rigs lhod par gyur zhing mkhal ma'i mkhal 'bras chung ba'i rtsa phran du gnon btsur thebs pa'am rlung gi cha ma 'dang ba bcas las 'byung / skabs 'dir gso bya'i mgo bo na zhing mgo yu 'khor ba/brjed ngas che zhing blo rtse gcig tu gtad mi thub par sems sayeng 'gro ba'i nad rtags rnams mchis/ skabs 'dir snying dang mkhal ma klad pa bcas su nad 'gyur byung ba'am de dag las sna gcig gam sna gnyis la nad 'gyur byung 'dug pa/ 'phel rim gsum pa'i skabs su (1)snying la nad 'gyur byung na snying khams g.yon ma cher rgyas pa dang snying je cher song ba/snying si/ byed las je zhan du song zhing lci tshad je mthor gyur ba sogs snying nad can gyi nad rtags gang mang zhig ston/ (2)mkhal mar nad 'gyur byung na mkhal ma'i nus pa nyams shing gcin dug phog pa/ gcin pa thon dka' ba sogs kyi nad rtags thon/ (3)klad par nad 'gyur byung na klad pa'i khrag rtsa phra mo'i rigs mkhregs por gyur ba'am je dog tu 'gro/ khrag rtsa'i nang du khrag 'dril chags nas khrag gi bzhur rgyun bkag pa sogs kyis khrag rgyu ma thub pa'i khrag rtsa phra ba'i rigs skam 'gro/ yang na klad pa'i nang du khrag rtsar gas rdol byung nas klad khrag shor ba 'di ni nad gzhi ha cang lci ba'i rigs la 'byung bzhin pas skabs 'dir gso bcos byed rgyu khag khrag 'dril gyis khrag rtsa'i rgyun bkag cing 'og gi rtsa dkar la gnon btsur 79

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskathebs pa'am khrag rtsar gas rdol byung nas klad khrag shor ba'i rigs gnyis kyi gang yin yang gso bya rnams dran med du brgyal 'gro/ dbugs ring len byed/ 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba je mgyogs su 'gro/ bshang gcin dbang med shor/lus yongs kyi tshor ba nyams pa'am gzhogs gcig gi tshor ba nyams 'gro/skabs 'dir snying mkhal klad pa sogs kyi gnas gang la'ang nad 'gyur byung na mig sprin 'og gi khrag rtsa phra mo rnams gas rdol byung nas mig sprin dmar por chags/ yang na khrag rtsa de rnams mkhregs por gyur bas mig rab rib byed cing gsal bo mi mthong pa sogs kyi nad rtags rnams thon/bzhi ba/ khrag rlung stod 'tshangs nad kyi bcos thabs/stod 'tshangs nad kyi spyi bcos su kha zas rtsub la snum bcud che ba'i rigs spang rgyu dang spyod lam bsil drod snyoms sar lus rtsol bas ma bcag par dal bar sdod rgyu las mya ngan sems las che zhing mtshan gnyid bcag pa sogs spang byar gdams dgos/ sman du ratna bsam 'phel dang sro dmar bdun thang / mu tig nyer lnga(rlung shas che ba)/ byu dmar nyer lnga(khrag shas che ba dang klad pa'am rtsa dkar du nad 'gyur byung ba)/ bla med/ a gar so lnga/ ko khrag bcas bsten dgos/ dpyad du mgo'i sdud sgo gsum du spra me'am gser tel gyis bsreg rgyab gsang dang po dang drug bdun gsang /mnan na na ba'i gsang yod sa bcas su zangs bum brgyab pas phan/rlung 'phel nas khrag shed mthon por chags pa'i nad gzhir kha zas su 80

st+waṃsardusmo010spru5 00 116dzi(3sa ⑪khuzu1dzukrokhurus bcud gsum gyi khu ba dang lug sha bu ram/ bur chang / rus chang rnams bsten zhing / spyod lam du yid du 'ongs pa'i grogs dang lhan du kha brda byed pa'am cung mun khung yin pa'i gnas su gos dron po gyon nas rlangs 'khor dang 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi 'ur sgra med par dal cag ger sdod rgyu las mya ngan sems las rigs byed mi rung / slob gnyer ba zhig la mtshon na dpe char dus rtag tu blta klog mi byed pa/ sman du ratna bsam 'phel dang mu tig nyer lnga/ a gar brgyad pa/ srog 'dzin bcu gcig a gar so lnga/ dzā ti shing kun li shi gsum bsres pa rnams gang la gang phan gyis bsten/ skabs 'dir mtshan gnyid yer na li shi dang sug smel/ dzā ti/zi ra dkar po rnams kyi phye ma 'o mar bskol nas ska sla zho tsam byas nas btang na shin tu phan che bar snang / yang na a ga ru dang li shi/ dzā ti/ ru rta/ a byag bongs cher bskyed pa de btung na rlung shas che bar phan zhing /gong sman pa'i lugs kyi a ga ru dang dzā ti shing kun sgog skya sga skya/ g.yer ma li shi rnams chang gis phul rgyu de yang shin tu phan/ rlung shas che ba'i nad gzhi 'dir gong sman rnams bsten thog ko byi bdun pa dang / tsan dan bco brgyad/ sro dmar bdun thang sogs khrag sman 'ga' zhig kyang bsten rgyu gal/ dpyad du brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams dang rgyab gsang dang po/drug pa dang bdun pa/ mgo'i sgo bzhi/ yan lag gi mthil bzhi bcas su dzā ti dang go snyod cha mnyam byas pa'i hor gyi me btsas bsro/ yang na spyi gtsug dang mtshogs gsang du spra me gdab rgyu'am gser tel gyis bsreg gzhan spyi 81

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagatsug tu spra ldan gser khab gdab na'ang shin tu phan/khrag 'phel nas khrag shed mthon por chags par kha zas su 'bras thug dang ba glang gi sha gsar ba/ ba mdzo'i zho dar sogs sla bsil gyi rigs ran par bsten rgyu las g.yag sha dang mar rnying / chang rgan sogs snum bcud drag la rnying ba'i rigs spang / spyod lam du lus rtsol bas ma bcag pa dang / nyi 'od dang me 'od sogs la yun ring bsten par mi bya zhing nyin gnyid ma log pa bcas bya/ sman du nad tshabs chung ba'i skabs sga skya dang tsan dan dmar po/ hong len/ skyu ru/ ba sha ka sro lo dmar po sogs kyi chig thang btang bas phan/ nad gzhi lci ba'i skabs sro dmar bdun thang dang sro lo dmar po'i thang / skyu ru nyer lnga/ byu dmar nyer lnga/ ratna bsam 'phel/ 'brong rtse chos rje a gar brgyad pa rnams bsten/ 〈nyams yig brgya rtsa〉 las ru rta gzer 'dzoms hong len gzer sman ser po rnams zhib par btags la chu gtsang phul la btang / 'di ni bdud rtsi sum sbyor zhes bya ste// khrag gi stod 'tshangs ma lus sel bar byed// ces gsungs pa ltar bdud rtsi sum sbyor 'di yang shin tu phan/ dpyad du 'bras bu gsum thang nyin gsum nas bdun bar bsten pas ngan khrag zungs khrag so sor dbye thog mtshogs gsang dang / gser mdung / dngul mdung / sgang rtsa/dpral rtsa/ rgyab rtsa drug 'dus sogs nad babs dang bstun nas gtar rgyu gal/khrag shed mthon po'i nad rkyen gyis snying la nad 'gyur byung na stod 82

st+waṃsardusmo010posmo 00 116khu(tshis krokhuzu1khu1sodzi'atshangs la phan pa'i gong gi sman sbyor rigs gco bor bsten thog snying la phan pa'i bi ma la'i sbyor ba dang / sga skya shing kun kha ru tsha gsum bsres pa'i thang / ma nu bzhi thang dang dzā ti cha mnyam byas pa'i thang sogs gtong /yang na a ga ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha ru rta rnams bsres pa'i phye ma btung bas phan/ 'tshangs che na ske stong tsa ra khung du me btsa' gdab rgyu'am gnas de nas brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams kyi bar stod nas mar phyogs su phur 'ded bya/ yang na dkar nag mtshams dang rgyab gsang drug bdun bcas su hor me gdab/mkhal mar nad 'gyur byung na gong sman steng mkhal mar phan pa'i sug smel bcu ba dang a ru bcu ba/ a brag bcu dgu/ pad rag mdog ldan bcas bsten dgos/ gal te skabs 'dir rlung shas che na gso byed nyi dkyil dang go yu bdun sbyor bsten na phan mod/ khrag shas che tshe sbyor ba 'di gnyis kyi gtso bo se 'bru yin pas btung mi rung /klad par nad 'gyur byung na gong sman steng a gar nyi shu dang bsam nor/da lis bco brgyad/ byu dmar nyer lnga/ nag chu'i byu dmar bdun cu sogs bsten dgos/ skabs 'dir gsal bshad bya rgyu zhig ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ru gsungs pa'i gza' nad dam skya rengs gsar ba ru gsungs pa'i grib skyon zer bzhin pa'i nad gzhi de'i kha cig klad khrag 'khar 'gag gam klad pa'i khrag rtsar gas rdol byung nas thon bzhin pa dang / kha cig rtsa dkar la thad kar nad 'gyur byung nas thon bzhin pas skabs 'dir grib 83

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaskyon phog bzhin pa'i nad gzhi de dag las klad khrag 'khar 'gag byung ba'i rigs la bod kyi gso rig gi thabs lam du dus thog mtshogs gsang dang sna rtsa/ dpral rtsa rnams gtar na phan nus legs par 'byung nges/ rjes nas gong sman yun ring bsten zhing khrag sla bar 'gyur ba'i sman rdzas rigs bsten dgos/ zla phyed tsam gyi 'phro nas spyi gtsug tu spra ldan gser khab gdab na shin tu phan/ skabs 'dir gso bya'i lus kyi gzhogs phyed kyi tshor ba nyams nas 'gul skyod ma thub tshe gzhogs de'i an stong tshigs pa dang bo nas nyi shu'i bar zangs bum brgyab nas yar mar 'ded rgyu dang / gzhug chung dpyi leb nas byin brla'i phyi sul dang de nas phyi long brgyud gung mtheb bar zangs bum brgyab nas yar mar 'ded/ yang na mchan 'og nas gru mo'i gzhug bar dang de nas lag pa'i rgyab zur bar du gong ltar bya rgyu 'am phur mnye bya/ 'dir zangs bum dang phur mnye'i rgyu lam gyi dpe mtshon tsam las bstan med pas nad thog lag len gi khrod nas em chi so sos rtsa dkar gyi rgyu lam gang zhig tu nad 'gyur byung yod pa gsal rtogs thub rjes rgyu lam der zangs bum rgyag rgyu'am phur mnye byas na shin tu legs par snang / do snang bya rgyu zhig ni nad gzhi 'di rigs la bod lugs dang nub lugs gang gi thad nas khrag sla bar 'gyur ba'i sman rdzas rigs bsten rgyu las klad pa'i khrag rtsa gas rdol byung bar 'khrul nas khrag gcod sman rigs bsten na mu mthud khrag 'dril chags pa'i nyes pa 'byung bas gzab rgyu gal/ klad pa'i khrag rtsa gas rdol byung nas grib skyon phog pa'i rigs la gur kum lnga ba'am kha 84

st+waṃb(smo0102to 0ba 116rdurdumib 7rduzu1dzu7khur dang dom mkhris bsres pa sogs khrag gcod sman rigs gtong dgos/sna rtsa dang dpral rtsa mtshogs gsang sogs gang nye'i rtsa gtar nas khrag gi 'ol kha bsgyur/ nad gzhi 'dir yang bod lugs dang nub lugs gang gi thad nas khrag gcod sman rigs gtong rgyu las khrag sla bar 'gyur ba'i sman sbyor rigs bsten na mu mthud khrag bzhur ba'i nyes pa 'byung bas gso byed pa tshos gsal rtogs thub rgyu gal/ mdor na khrag rlung stod 'tshangs sam khrag shed mthon po'i nad rkyen kyis klad par nad 'gyur byung na khrag rtsa'i nang gi khrag 'dril sogs kyis 'og gi rtsa dkar la gnon btsur thebs pa'am khrag rtsar gas rdol byung nas rtsa dkar la bkag 'gog thebs pas rtsa dkar gyi nad rtags gang mang zhig ston pas nga tshos kyang stod 'tshangs la phan pa'i sman sbyor bsten rgyu dang khrag sla bar 'gyur ba'i rigs sam khrag gcod sman rigs gang la gang mkho ltar bsten thog rtsa dkar la phan pa'i sman sbyor rigs bsten rgyu ni/ snying la nad 'gyur byung na snying sman gtong rgyu dang mkhal mar nad 'gyur byung na mkhal ma'i sman gtong rgyu lta bu'o//85

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kunda dasas pa'i zla zeskabod sman gyi sman rdzas rig pa'i do dam skor gyi bsam gzhigs phran bu/bgrang bya bcu phrag kha shas kyi yun la sa'i go la'i ltebs gnyer zhig na grags 'gul ci yang med pa'i bod mi rigs 'di'i rig gnas bcu'i ya gyal gso ba rig pa'i gom stabs gser sa 'og na yod kyang 'od nam mkhar 'phros pa ltar 'dzam gling gso rig gi ches sngon thon skor gyi mdun du slebs bzhin pa'i nyin mo 'dir/ ka kha'i mgo rting mi shes pa'i bod lugs gso rig la dung zhen che ba'i bod lugs gso rig ched mkhas kyi go ming thob pa'i skye bo gang mang zhig kyang spyi tshogs dpal 'byor tshong ra'i khrod na bod lugs gso rig gi ched du 'dur rgyugs byed bzhin pas/ wa mo rams skyabs kyi mkhas dbang de tsho bod lugs gso rig 'di rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong mkhan gyi skyabs mgon yin nam/ spyang ltogs 'dur rgyugs byed pa sha'i ched du yin/ da dung gdams ngag gzhan la btsong ba'i tshong ba dang dug 'don tshul bzhin med pa'i sdeb sbyor mkhan yang mang po zhig thon bzhin pas/ nga tshos da dung gna' snga mo snga mo zhig gi gtam rgyud gleng nas sngon byon mes po'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes rnams gzhan la ngoms nas 86

st+waṃb(stu010posnga 0sa 116khu(skyab krokhuzu1dzu1sakhu'adug rgyu yin nam/ dus rabs kyis sprad pa'i 'os 'gan khur du bzhes nas gnad don gyi dri ba de dag la rgol lan re ster thabs bya rgyu yin/gsham nas bdag gis ma skul rang mos kyis tshan rig gi 'phrul chas ji ltar bkol yang bod sman bzo skabs bod sman gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rgyab 'gal byed mi rung ba'i skor dang / bod sman gyi thon khungs la bdag dam bya dgos pa'i skor/ dam pa gong ma'i dgongs pa gzhir bzung thog dus rabs gsar ba'i 'bod skul gyi 'dun pa skong ci thub bya rgyu'i skor/dug 'don tshad ldan dang sbyor ba tshad ldan bya dgos don gyi skor/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rang nyid kyis bdag dam bya rgyu'i skor sogs ches mdor bsdus tsam 'god par bya ba la/dang po spreb sbor mkhan pos rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rgyab 'gal byed mi rung ba'i skor/1 rgyud du so ma rnying ba lo dus ma lon pa zhes gsungs 'dug kyang /thengs shig nga tsho bod sman bzo grwa zhig tu blta skor du 'gro skabs sdeb sbyor mkhan gyi mi sna zhig gis bshad don/ nye lam kho tshos sman sbyor gang mang zhig tshan rig gi 'phrul chas la brten nas bzo bzhin pa dper na sman sna gcig sdeb sbyor byed rgyu'i mgo brtsams pa nas 'phrul chas kyi rigs brgyud de bzo bskrun grub tshar rjes kyi dus yun la tha na lo phyed dgos kyin 'dug zer/ de na nga tshos zhib 'dang re brgyab tshe bod sman gyi sbyor sde mang che bar 87

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasngo sman rigs yod pas/ sngo sman rigs btu dus kyi dus su btus pa'i nyin mo nas lo gcig gi yun du bkol rgyu las de las 'gyangs na rnying par gyur 'dug pa gong smṛs ltar dang / dus yun thung ngu'i nang bkol dgos pa'i sman sna 'di btus pa'i nyin nas bzung dus gang tsam 'gor rjes sman du gtong / sman du btang rjes tha na lo phyed tsam gyi rjes su bzo grub tshar bzhin pas/ gso bya'i lag tu 'byor rjes dus ci tsam 'gor 'dug pa bcas kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnad don der thugs khur cher bzhes rgyu gal/2 gzhan sman rdzas so so'i skye sar yang dbye ba chen po 'dug ste/ nyin dang sribs/ ri sgang dang klong / tsha ba'i yul dang bsil ba'i yul lta bu/de na nyin du skyes dgos pa'i sman rdzas khag cig srib tu skyes pa/ srib tu skyes dgos pa'i sman rdzas khag cig nyin du skyes pa/ ri mtho sgang du skyes dgos pa yul dma' sar skyes pa/ dma' sar skyes dgos pa ri brag mtho sar skyes pa/ tsha ba'i yul dang bsil ba'i yul yang de bzhin go ldog tu skyes pa bcas kyi sman rdzas la gzhung du gsungs pa'i ro dang nus pa zhu rjes sogs tshul bzhin med pa ni gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes kyang sngo sman rnams skyes gnas ma yin pa dang dus las yol ba/ brlan dang yan lag rgyas pa rtswa skya lta bur gyur ba ni sman gyi rdzas tsam yin pa las nus pa ci yang mi 'byung zhes gsungs pa lta bu/ dper na/ yul mtho sar skyes dgos pa'i hong len yang dma' sar skyes 'dug par rgod g.yung gnyis las g.yung ba dang de'i nus pa yang dman pa dri med shel phreng du gsal/ de na skyes rgyun 88

st+waṃb(smo010pokau 0ba rwa16khurdumis krokhuskye1dzu1sarduchad par nye ba'i sman rdzas rigs nga tshos 'debs 'dzugs bya dgos pa lta bu byung tshe rang rang so so'i skyes sar 'debs 'dzugs bya rgyu gal gnad che bas mtho sgang tu skyes pa'i sro lo dmar po dang bya rgod sug pa lta bu yul dma' sar 'debs 'dzugs byas par gzhung ltar gyi phan nus mi 'byung pa shugs kyis shes/ skye sar skyes pa'i sman rdzas kyi phan nus ni mes po'i zhal lung las/ gangs can de sribs kyi ri la bsil sman dang / 'bigs byed ces pa gdags kyi ri ngos su drod sman skyes pa de ni bsil drod rang rang gi gnas su skyes pa'i phyir gdags sribs go ma ldog par bzang la/ de yang nyi zla'i 'od phog pa tsha bsil gyi nus pa stobs dang ldan pa de 'dra bar skyes pa ni skye sar skyes pa zhes bya ste/ yon tan mchog tu gyur ba yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar sman rdzas btu sgrub bya skabs skye sar skyes 'dug pa btu rgyu yang gal gnad che ba zhig tu snang /3 sman rdzas rnams btu ba'i dus der yang dbye ba chen po 'dug ste/de yang rgyud las/ btu dus rtsa ba yal ga sdong lo gsum// sdong bo'i rigs yin rus rtsa sha nad sel// ston ga rtsi skam dus su btu bar bsngags// lo ma zho dang myu gu rnam pa gsum// lo ma'i rigs yin snod rkang lha nad sel//'dabs rgyas char gyi dus su btu bar bsngags// me tog 'bras bu rtse mo nom pa gsum// 'bras bu'i rigs yin mig don mgo nad sel// ston ser smin pa'i dus sar btu bar bsngags// skogs pa bar shun tshi ba rnam pa gsum// shun pa'i rigs yin lpags rgyus yan lag sel// kha 'bus dpyid 89

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakyi dus su btu bar bsngags// bshal sman rtsi skam nus gting 'gro'i dus//skyugs sman kha 'bus gyen 'dren dus su btu zhes gsungs 'dug kyang / kha cig gis lcum rtsa lta bu dbyar gzhung du btu ba dang skyer ba'i bar shun lta bu stong khar btu bzhin pa'ang bdag gi mthong chos su gyur/ da rung yang kha cig gis pri yang ku gzhon nu lta bu gsar skyes kyi dus su btu dgos pa'i rigs dus ltar btus na lag 'bab nyung bas dbyar gzhung dang ston mgo'i dus yal rkang mkhregs por gyur skabs btu bzhin pas ma dag pa'i log lam 'dir 'gro mtshams 'jog rgyu yang gal gnad che ba zhig tu snang /4 spyir thang dang phye ma'i yun tshad dam bzos grub byung rjes kyi nyin nas bzung lo gcig gi ring bkol nas tshar dgos pa ni dam pa gong ma'i dgongs don du snang mod/ da lta sman khang so sor bkol bzhin pa'i thang phye yang lo gsum bzhi re 'gor bzhin pa kun gyis shes gsal tu snang / lhag par da lta 'phrul chas bkol nas bzo bzhin pa'i ril bu 'dir dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo rgan bstan 'dzin don grub lags nas kyang phye ma'i nus pa las ril bu'i nus pa ye nas med/ de ni ril bu 'di rigs la 'dam btags ma byas pa'i phyir/ spyir 'dam btags kyi yun ci tsam ring na de tsam gyis sman nus yun ring lus kyi rtsa lam nas 'dug thub pa dang ril bu yang yun ring bzhag kyang sman nus mi yal ba'am mi rnying zhes gsungs bzhin pas/ ril bu'i rigs thams cad 'dam btags byed ma thub kyang rin chen ril bu'i rigs 'dam btags byed dgos par bsam/90

sas(smo010pokau 0sa 116dzirdu3ba krodzisku10krodzide ni sna gcig nas mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len yun ring mi nub par gnas thub pa dang / sna gzhan zhig nas sman nus yun ring lus kyi rtsa lam nas sdod thub cing sman rdzas 'di rigs yun ring bzhag kyang rnying bar mi 'gyur ba'i dge mtshan ldan/zhar byung brjod rgyu zhig ni kha cig gis g.yu rnying nyer lnga sogs rin chen ril bu khag cig phye mar bzos nas spyin ril tu bcug na srol rgyun ltar ril bu bzos pa las kyang sman nus myur bas/ kho tsho'i rig pa de gsar gtod kyi rig pa zhig yin zhes lab bzhin pas/ rgyud kyi dgongs par sman nus shin tu myur bar thang dang de nas phye ma/ sman nus dal zhing lus kyi rtsa lam khag nas yun ring sdod thub par ril bu zhes gsungs 'dug pas/ rig pa der gsar gtod kyi rig pa zhes brjod na 'grig srid dam/ ngas skabs 'dir ril bu'i rigs spyin ril tu blugs na mi 'grig ces brjod pa min mod/ brjod bya gtso bo thang phye ril bu'i myur dal dam pa gong mas gsungs yod pa las de ring thol byung du rnyed pa'i rig lam gsar ba zhig min pa de yin/mdor na sngo sman rnying ba dang dus su ma btus pa/ skye sar ma skyes pa/thang phye rnying drag pa sogs 'phrul chas brgya 'grim yang sman gyi rdzas tsam du zad pa las der gzhung ltar gyi ro nus zhu rjes mi 'byung ba gong smros ltar lags pas/ bod sman bzo skabs bod sman gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rgyab 'gal mi byed par rang mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 91

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagazhir bzung nas der tshan rig gis zur rgyan na legs/gnyis pa/ bod sman gyi thon khungs la bdag dam bya dgos pa'i skor/nye ba'i lo shas nang bod lugs sman khang gi sman bzo grwa phud/ krung sman bzo grwa khang dang phyi sman bzo grwa khang bcas su'ang bod sman bzo bzhin par ma zad/ krung min bod min gyi bzo grwa yang gang mang zhig thon bzhin pas/nga tshos bzo grwa khang de dag gi ming la brtag tshe bod sman gyi khyad chos ci yang mi ldan mod/ dpal 'byor tshong ra'i steng na rkang brtan po tshugs 'dugagang ltar yang bod sman sdeb sbyor byed mkhan nyin ltar je mang nas je mang du 'gro bzhin pas/ sdeb sbyor byed rgyu'i rgyu de'i thon khungs la'ang bsam gzhigs phran tsam mi gtong ga med byung / spyir bod sman gyi sman rdzas rig pa'i sbyor sde las mang che ba mdo dbus mtho sgang gi khor yug kho na las med pas mi rnams kyis sa brkos rdo slog byas nas sngo sman dang shing sman/ gter sman rigs blangs tshe dus mi 'gyangs par sman sna gang mang zhig gi rgyud chad par gdon mi za/ gnad don 'dir kan lho khul gyi khul dpon rta mgrin thar nas kyang kho bos mthong ba'i hrin krin gyi tshags par zhig tu bod sman gyi thon khungs gtso bo dbyang dbugs kyi cha nyung zhing khor yug btsog bsgyur ma byas pa/ nyi 'od dang bar thag nye ba'i mtho sgang dang rgyal khab kyis bdag dam bya rgyu'i skyes dngos sman nam srog chags sman sogs yin zhes 'khod 92

st+waṃ0rdusmo010spru| 0ba rwa16khu('ib 7khuzu1khu10khu'adug pas/ gal te ma 'ongs par thon khungs de rnams med par gyur tshe bod sman gang ltar byas nas dar spel gtong rgyu zhes brjod pas/ dper na spang rtsi do bo dang sro lo/ hong len/ bya rgod sug pa/ lcum rtsa/ spor gyi rtsa ba/ dbang lag sngo stag sha dang rta lpags pa lta bu'i rtsa ba bcas brko bzhin pas lo de'i rjes ma nas skyes shul der mi skyes pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar/gzhan brag zhun dang cu gang lta bu lo brgya phrag mang po'i yun chags pa zhig yin pas thengs gcig blangs rjes yun ring chags mi thub/ gzi dang khyung skyugs/ dbang ril lta bu da lta'i yun nas lag sor rnyed khag lhag par 'das pa'i lo shas nang mtho sgang gi yul 'di nas gnas tshal rigs med par bzos pa'i tshabs shin tu che bas shing sman rigs kyi thon khungs kyang de bzhin je nyung du btang 'dug pa smra mi dgos/ da dung srog chags gla ba dang shwa ba/ dom la sogs kyi rigs rgyud kyang chad par nye 'dug pas/ de na gong gi gnad don 'di rigs la nga tshos ci lta bu'i rgol lan re sprod rgyu zhe na/ thog mar thon khungs la bdag dam byas nas gang 'dod ltar sngo sman dang gter sman shing sman sogs 'thu sgrub byed du mi 'jug cing / de'i zhor skyes rgyun chad nye ba'i sngo sman dang shing sman rigs rgya che'i rong 'brog mang tshogs la rang rang so so'i gdags sribs kyi skye sar 'debs 'dzugs byed du 'jug rgyu/ kha cig gis tshan rig gi thabs lam la brten nas dus thung ngu'i nang 'tshar skyes byed du bcug na 'grig zer yang / de ltar byas na sman sna der rang byung khor yug nas skyes pa ltar tshang dgos pa'i 'byung lnga'i 93

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskacha sogs snyoms med pas sman gyi tshab rung ngam rdzas tsam du zad/ srog chags sman la tshab gtong rgyu las thabs gzhan med/gsum pa/ dam pa gong ma'i dgongs pa gzhir bzung thog dus rabs gsar ba'i 'bod skul gyi 'dun pa skong ci thub bya rgyu'i skor/1 dam pa gong ma'i dgongs don gzhir 'dzin rgyur skabs don sna gnyis yod de/ dang po ni da lta kun gyis nad thon lag len steng bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i sman sna bzhi brgya yas mas tsam yod pa de mu mthud sngon ltar tshad ldan du sdeb sbyor bya rgyu dang / gnyis pa ni gso bya re re'i lus zungs dang na tshod nad gzhi bcas la gzhigs nas dmigs bsal gyis sdeb sbyor bya rgyu ste/ dper na gso bya gnyis kyi gtso bo'i nad gzhi gcig kyang nad gzhan bsdongs zla yod med mi gcig pa'am/ yang na na tshod dang lus zungs nad gzhi'i lci yang mi 'dra ba gnyis la sman sbyor a gar so lnga lta bu rigs gcig sprod dgos tshe/ nad gzhan bsdongs zla yod med sogs la gzhigs nas gso bya gcig la sbyor sde de'i nang gi gnyan sman rigs mang tsam btang zhing / gzhan zhig la gnyan sman rigs phran tsam las ma btang bar cha 'phri ba lta bu/ yang na nad gzhi bye brag pa so sor rgyud chen ltar dang nyams yig gzhan rnams ltar sdeb sbyor bcas byas na/ nye lam spyi mthun du bzos pa'i sbyor ba de dag las kyang phan nus legs par 'byung ba gdon mi 94

st+waṃbardu'i010sprukau 0ba 116khurdu3ba krodzipya1010khuza bas/ nga tshos rgyun bkol gyi sman rdzas a ru dang se 'bru/ dzā ti sogs sna sum brgya bzhi brgya tsam so sor phye mar bzos nas snod rer blugs yod tshe dus thog gso bya'i khams kyi dgos mkho ltar sdeb sbyor byed thub/2 dpal 'byor tshong ra'i 'dun pa skong ched nga tshos mig rgyang ring por bskyed nas gna' bo'i phyag len bco brgyad kyi steng sman sbyor gyi las bsnon dang bzo dbyibs sogs kha bsnon bya dgos/ da lta nad thog lag len steng spyod bzhin pa'i sman rdzas mang che ba phye ma dang ril bu gnyis yin pas phye ma las khag cig 'thung khag po yod pas de rigs spyin shubs su blugs rgyu/yang na cong zhi 'phrul thal lta bu 'thung tshe gso bya'i kha nang du rma bzo nyen che bas spyin shubs su blugs na kha lce mi bsreg par 'thung bde po yod/ da dung bod sman gyis sman khab bzo rgyu dang grungs chu bzo rgyu/ pags nad rigs la byugs sman bzos nas tshad ldan gyi sman rdzas gang mang zhig la rgyal khab dang zhing chen rim pa'i chog mchan ang grangasu༈tsherha)blangs shing spus legs kyi shun pags bskon nas dpal 'byor tshong rar 'grim ci thub bya dgos/ spyir bzo grwa zhig gi tshe srog gi 'phar rtsa gtso bo bzo grwa rang nas bzo bzhin pa'i bya dngos de'i spus kar rag las yod pa dang / spus ka de yang bzo grwa de'i dpal 'byor dang mi snar rag las yod pas/ tshad ldan gyi bod sman bzo grwa khag nas kyang shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu shin tu gal/95

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabazhi ba/ dug 'don tshad ldan dang sbyor ba tshad ldan bya dgos don bshad pa/de yang lag len gces btus las/ gsum pa sman rigs thams cad 'dul thabs bshad// dug ces srog 'phrog nus pa ma yin kyang // zungs ngan sman rtsub dpyad log srog 'dor byed// phan las gnod che rtsub pas zug gzer ldang // pho ba'i me gsod mig 'grib rtsa sgo 'gag / rno ba'i nus btul nad slong yi ga 'gag / bshal skyug go zlog la sogs nyes mang skyed ces gsungs pa ltar zhi byed dang sbyongs byed bcud len ro tsa sogs kyi skabs rang rang gi lugs dang mthun par dug bton bya rgyu gtso bo yin/dug phral ba'am tshad ldan ltar dug 'don byas zin pa'i sman rdzas la yang de las/ dug phral 'atul bas rno 'jam nus bcud ldan// ro nus zhu rjes sbyor ba tshad du smin// de phyir 'dul ba'i las la brtson par rigs ces gsungs pa ltar snang bas/ nga tshos do snang bya rgyu zhig ni a ru lta bur mtshon na zhi byed skabs kyi 'dul lugs dang sbyong byed skabs kyi 'dul lugs/ bcud len skabs kyi 'dul lugs bcas tha dad du 'dug pas de bzhin 'dul rgyu gtso gal che/ gzhan cong zhi lta bur mtshon na zhi byed skabs su'ang 'dul lugs mi 'dra ba yod pa ni cong zhi rgod btul dang snyoms 'dul grang 'dul/bcud 'dul/ 'phrul thal che 'bring chung gsum/ tsha btul lta bu mang mod/ kha cig gis zhi sbyangs gang gi skabs su'ang a ru rang sor gtong ba'am 'bras bu'i rigs kyi rus pa dang bcas gtong / yang kha cig gis 96

st+waṃbardusmo010pokau 0ba 116༷rdu30 krokhuzu1dzu1badzicong zhi snyoms 'dul gyis 'phrul thal ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi tshab byed bzhin pa'am sman rdzas gang zhig gi khaṇḍa dgos pa'i rigs la sman rdzas de nyid rang sor gtong bzhin pa sogs ma dag pa'i phyag len gang mang zhig spel bzhin pa'ang bdag gi mthong thos kyi yul tu gyur/ da dung kha cig gis me tog dgos pa'i rigs la rtsa lo me 'bras bcas gtong bzhin pa'am me tog dang lo ma lhan cig gtong bzhin pas ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi phyag len 'di ni rtsam pa za mkhan zhig la nas kyi rtsa lo 'bras bcas phye mar bzos nas za ru bcug pa'am/ sil tog za mkhan zhig la sil tog dang sil sdong gi rtsa ba sdong bo yal ga bcas za ru bcug pa/ yang na sha za mkhan zhig la phyi'i spu dang pags pa/ nang sha dang rus rkang / rgyu ma dang long sogs su yod pa'i brin bcas za ru bcug pa las gnyis su med pas/ nas kyi snye ma'i mgor smin pa'i 'bras bus gang zag mi'i lto ba 'grangs par byed thub pa las/ snye ma'i rkang dang rtsa ba sogs la de'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ yang na sil sdong gi mgor smin pa'i 'bras bu'i ro mngar skyur lta bu yin tshe sdong bo'i ro mngar skyur min par bska ba lta bu/ gzhan 'ol mo se'i 'bras bur dug shas med par bya rigs dang mi'i rigs kyis zos chog kyang rtsa bar dug shas shin tu che/ lcum gyi rtsa bar 'khru bar byed pa'i nus pa yod kyang lcum sdong dang yal rkang la de'i nus pa med pa sogs kyis gzhung du rtsa lo me 'bras gsungs med pa'i rigs la de ltar byed mi rung ba'i ra sprod thub/ de na gzhung du sbyor ba thams cad la utpal gyi me tog dgos kyang da lta phal che 97

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabs rtsa lo me 'bras su gtong bzhin pas bdag gi bsam gzhigs su sman sna 'di rigs rtsa lo me 'bras su btang nas rgya grangs 'dang bar byed pa las/rgya grangs ma 'dang yang me tog kho na nyung tsam 'phang na sbyor ba de'i phan nus gzhung ltar med kyang nus pa gzhan du 'gyur mi 'gro bas de ltar byas na legs snyam/lnga ba/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rang nyid kyis bdag dam bya dgos don bshad pa/spyir bod lugs gso byed pa zhig gi dmigs bya gtso bo ni gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam gtso bor bzung nas/ nyams thag nad pa'i lus sems kyi na zug dang sdug bsngal zhi thabs bya rgyu de yin mod/ da lta bod sman bzo grwa mang che bas dpal 'byor tshong rar 'grim thabs byas nas khyod pham nga rgyal gyi tshong don kho nar dmigs bzhin pas/ dam pa gong ma'i gzhan phan gyi mdzad bzang la'ang lan rer phyir mig re ltos na legs snyam/ lhag par bzos grub zin pa'i sman sna'i shun pags steng bod yig gi sman ming tsam yang med par tshang ma rgya yig gis bris 'dug pa ni rta lpags pa'i sbyor ba dang sro lo dmar po'i sbyor ba lta bu/ sbyor ba de dag gi steng du rgya yig gi gsal bshadapaṃzlo0mmu’ṇḍaṃtstshatshokhyopu ’7ṣṭhahūṃphramme ’rtaṭwāṃtshiṣṭhanyazloskyaṭā//lkoyikhra 'di 'dra brgyab 'dug spyir bod sman ni bod mi rigs kyi rig pa'i rtsal las 'khrungs pa zhig yin pas bod mi rigs kyi mtshon byed gtso bo bod yig 98

st+waṃpardusmo010sprukyā 0ba 116dzi(3sa krokhuzu101bakhusteng bkod rgyu gal/ gzhan kha cig gis bod sman gyi sbyor sde'i sman ming dang so so'i rgya tshad srang tshad/ dug 'don bya thabs bcas gzhan mi rigs kyi yig rigs su bsgyur ci thub bya bzhin par ma zad/ dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i mthong brgyud kyi phyag len yang phran tsam re bsgyur zin pas/ 'di ltar mngon lkog med par pha rol bor bshams ston byas tshe dus gang tsam zhig 'gyangs rjes gong gi sdeb sbyor byed bzhin pa'i sman sbyor dang bsgyur zin pa'i sbyor ba de dag bod mi rigs kyi red zer srid dam/ dper na sog rigs kyis dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang gling sgrung sogs sog yig tu bsgyur bas da lta sog po'i rgyud bzhi dang sog po'i gso rig sog po'i gling sgrung bcas zer bzhin par ma zad rgyal khab kyis kyang sog po'i gso rig ces sna gcig tu rtsis yod pa lta bu/ spyir nga tsho'i bod mi rigs ni gzhan rigs kyi legs cha tshur bsdu byed mkhan gyi mi rigs shig yin pa las rang rigs kyi gces nor phar btsong mkhan gyi mi rigs shig min pas pha bzang bus srol bzang gi goms gshis brgyud 'dzin bya rgyu yang ches gal gnad zhig tu snang /da lta bod sman bzo grwa tshang mas6lo2tshad gzhi brtson len byed bzhin pas/ 6lo2ni nub lugs gso rig gi bzo stangs dang de'i dgos mkho'i cha rkyen la gzhigs nas tshad dang mthun pa'i sman rigs thon skyed kyi spus tshad do dam zhes a me ru khas1963lor gsar du gtan 'khel byas pa zhig yin/ spyir gtsang sbra'i thad de'i tshad gzhi dgos kyang phyag len gyi thad rang mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gzhir bzung nas dug 99

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska'adon tshad ldan dang sbyor ba tshad ldan sogs bya rgyu gal che bas bod sman sdeb sbyor byed stangs kyi phyag len rnams bskyur nas de'i rjes 'brangs na shin tu mi 'tsham/ 'on kyang legs cha'i rigs tshur bsdu bya rgyu gong brjod ltar dang yod tshad de'i rjes su 'brangs na nub lugs kyi ril reb rigs bzo skabs de mkhregs po ma yin par 'ju bde ba'i sob sob yin dgos mod/ bod sman gyi ril bu bzo skabs nad rnying rigs la sman nus yun ring lus kyi rtsa lam nas sdod dgos phyir 'dam btags yun ring bya dgos shing / rjes nas bzos grub zin pa'i ril bu yang shin tu mkhregs/ 'on kyang kha cig gis ra mgo lug sbyar gyi tshul tu6losbyi'am nub lugs gso rig gi dgongs don ltar bod sman ril bu sob sob tu bzos nas der tshad ldan gyi ril bu zer bzhin pas/ skye bo 'di rigs la blun rmongs pa'i sdeb sbyor mkhan zhes brjod na mi chog pa med/ mdor na brgya bshad stong bshad kyi gnad don gtso bo da lta nga tshos bod sman sman sbyor shig la chog mchan ang yig cig len dgos tshe/ ka kha'i mgo rting mi shes pa'i skye bo tshos krung lugs dang nub lugs kyi tshad gzhir gzhal nas gnang bzhin pas/ de dag gi dri mas gtso bor bag bzhin 'dug de na nga tsho'i bod sman gyi tshad gzhi ni sbyor ba de'i sman rdzas so so'i ro nus zhu rjes dang spyi'i gtsang sbra/ nad thog lag len steng gi phan 'bras/ sbyor tshad bcas la gzhigs nas byed rgyu dang /chog mchan ang yig len dgos tshe bod kyi gso rig la gces sems che ba'i bod sman ched mkhas mi sna'i dpung khag cig sgrig 'dzugs byas nas de dag 100

st+waṃbardusmo010pyi| 0ba 116dzirdumi0 grakhuspu1010khugis mngon lkog gi bya ba ci yang ma sgrub par gnang na rang mi rigs kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs la rang gis bdag dam bya thub pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos kyang yun ring rgyud 'dzin byed thub mod/ bdag gi thengs 'di'i rmi lam 'di mngon 'gyur bya rgyur yang 'gal rkyen mang po zhig yod pas/ nga tshos dka' gnad kyi 'gag phreng so so brgal ci thub bya rgyu ni skabs 'di'i brjod don gtso bo lags/ de na nga tshos thog mar gong rim la bod sman gyi tshad ldan sbyor ba'i tshad gzhi bod rang gi rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang bstun nas gtan 'khel bya rgyu'i re 'dun dang chab cig chog mchan ang yig kyang bod sman la 'dris goms yod pa'i bod sman ched mkhas mi sna'i dpung khag gis gnang dgos pa'i re 'dun bcas zhu rgyu'o//drug pa/ mjug bsdu ba/bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i snying gtam 'dir nor 'khrul gyi cha re mchis tshe blo gzi bor gnas pa'i dam pa tshos skyon brjod dang dag bcos ci rigs bya rgyu gal/ gong gi gnad don 'di rigs dus rabs kyis nga tshor sprad pa'i dus thung ngu'i nang thag gcod bya rgyu'i dri ba re re yin pas/bod lugs gso byed mi sna kun gyis 'di dang 'di lta bu'i dri ba rer thugs nyams 'jog rgyu shin tu gal che'o//101

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskarngabs rwa dang zangs bum la thog ma'i dpyad pa na mnyam dgyes pa'i 'phrin bzang /rang re'i pur rgyal ljongs 'dir mi na ba gnas par byed cing na ba gso bar byed pa'am gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gso ba rig pa 'di nyid dar yun ring zhing / lhag par na ba gso bar byed pa'i zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi'i ya gyal dpyad kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i cha byad kyi phyag len gang mang zhig dmangs khrod du'ang sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur 'dug skabs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i rngabs rwa dang zangs bum gyi phyag len lta bur mtshon na phun sum tshogs pa'i myong goms 'di dmangs khrod nas dar che yang de dag yi ger bkod pa shin tu nyung / dper na dpal ldan rgyud bzhir/ rngabs rwa dpangs su sor lnga kha sor gsum// rtse bug yungs kar shong bas chu ser drang // bum pa 'khyud 'khor sor ni bco brgyad la// srid sor bcu gnyis kha zlum sor bzhi ba// phyi skran 'ju zhing 'dren la sbyor bar bya// zhes tshig rkang lnga las bstan med/ spyir g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i srol gtod pa po ston pa gshen rab kyis nyid kyi bka' bsdu ba bo dpyad bu khri shes la dug bcos g.yung drung 'khyil ba dang sman gzhung 'bum bzhi sogs yi ger bkod 102

st+waṃ0rdusmo010spru| 0ba 116khurdumis 7khuzu1khu7dzidu bcug pa ni sa la'i sman ljongs 'dir 'tsho bzhugs byed pa'i gangs can pa rnams kyis gdod ma'i spyi tshogs nas pha tsha bu rgyud bzhin bsags pa'i dug gsum gyis rgyu byas pa'i nad rigs sna tshogs kyi ngos 'dzin dang der phan pa'i sman gyi ngos 'dzin sogs nyams myong rnams phyogs sdom byas te rgyud rim ldan pa'i ngang yi ger bkod pa de yin/ de'i snga rol tu snang gshen mi rigs kyis da lta bkol bzhin pa'i dbyibs gzugs yi ge der bkod yod tshod 'dug mod/ 'di'i skor dpyad rtsom gzhan zhig tu cung gsal bor 'khod yod pas 'dir gong tsam gyis chog par bya/ gong gi de rnams ni bod kyi gso rig 'di gzhung lugs shig tu grub pa'i ru rtsi kho na yin/ phyi sdod pa mkhas dbang nam mkha'i nor bus ston pa gshen rab gyis bon gyi bstan pa spel nas da lta'i yun bgrang bya sum stong brgyad brgya lhag 'das song bar gsungs 'dug pas der gzhigs na nga tsho'i bod kyi gso rig la'ang bgrang bya de'i yan gyi lo rgyus ldan pa smros med yin/rngabs rwa dang zangs bum sogs kyi phyag len yang gangs ljongs gso rig gi dbu brnyes pa dang lhan du nar son pa kho na yin/ de ni tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi gso rig yig cha bdam bsgrigs las myi zhig smon khrag byung ste bcud du mi rung ba la bal thag gis 'jing ba dang mthe bong cha nu gnyis dam du bkyig ste ltag pa'i kung kung du mchil mas btab ste/ sngabs rus btsugs na rtsi(rngabs rwa brgyab na phan zhes pa'i don)zhes dang / yang na bod rgyal nyer dgu ba 'brong gnyan lde'u btsan gyi sras dkon pa bkra ni 103

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabatsas ma thag nas spyan gyis mi mthong zhing mig nad bar 'grib kyis zin pa zhig yin rkyen/ yab rjer chu ser nag po'i nad byung bas phyi rabs rje 'bangs rnams la de ltar mi 'byung phyir khong dang btsun mo bcas gson dur du bzhugs skabs/ nyid kyi sras dkon pa bkrar zhal chems su/bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste// bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin zhes nyon// ngan pa rnams kyang me dang 'dra bas gsos// mi chos rtog pa yin gyi rnam rtog skyungs// zhes dang / gnyan po gsang ba ri la mchod pa bya ba dang 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos la mig phye zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo smad tsong kha'i yul gyi bye brag rgyal phran 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa mkhas pa zhig spyan drangs nas rgyal bu'i mig gser thur gyis phye zhing / khong gis thog mar skyid shod stag mo rir gnyan 'dug pa gzigs pas mtshan du stag ri gnyan gzigs su thog pa sogs la gzhigs na/ rang re'i yul 'dir bgrang bya stong phrag 'ga'i sngon nas cha byad kyi phyag len dar yod par ma zad/dus de nas gzhi brtan po tshugs yod pa'i bden dpang byed thub/ nye lam gzi byin gyi 'od snang 'bar ba'i bod mi rigs kyi gces nor 'dir kha shas kyis ham sems kyi 'gram chu ldag bzhin kha brgya mig stong gis lag len byed pa'am rang rtsom du yi ger bkod pa/ kha shas kyis ra mgo lug sbyar ltar kho tsho'i gzhung dang bsres nas bris shing khungs lung med par bgrang bya stong phrag 'ga'i sngon nas dar yod pa'i gleng mol byed pa dag ni sa bon med par 'bras bu gleng ba ltar du mchis/ gnas tshul de'i dbang gis rang 104

st+waṃsardusmo010sprukau 05 116rdurdu2sa sdedzizu1khu1sakhurigs kyi gces nor rnams rgyud 'dzin dang rngog 'don bya rgyu yang gal che ba zhig tu snang bas/ de ring phran gyis 'dir rngabs rwa dang zangs bum gnyis kyi rgyu dang dbyibs/ phyag len byed srol/ thun mong ma yin pa'i phan nus/nyes skyon dang de'i log nus kyi myur skyob byed thabs sogs gzhung dang dmangs khrod kyi phyag len gnyis zung 'brel byas shing / der rang nyid nas lo du mar bsags pa'i nad thog nyams myong gis zur brgyan pa'i tshul tu 'dir cung spel ba ste/dang po/ rngabs rwa dang zangs bum gyi rgyu dang dbyibs bshadapa/nga tsho'i rlabs chen gyi mes po tshos thog mar rngabs rwa ni sems can gyi rwa las bzos pas ming du rngabs rwa zhes thogs/ yul kha shas su smyug sbubs dang shing gis bzos pa'ang 'dug spyir mdzo dang g.yag ba glang / rtol/ma he sogs sems can pho'i rwas bzo dgos shing / phyi nang mi sgrib pa'i ched sems can de dag gi rwa dkar po las bzos na legs/ dbyibs ni gzhung las/ rngabs rwa dpangs su sor lnga kha sor gsum// rtse bug yungs kar shong bas chu ser drang // zhes gsungs 'dug kyang de'i che chung la nges pa med/ dper na mdzum tshigs na ba sogs su gzhung ltar gyi rngabs rwa 'jog mi thub pas 'jog gnas der bstun pa'i chung ngu re bzos na legs/zangs bum bzo spyad kyi rgyu ni thog mar zangs yin la/ de ni bod rgyal btsan po rnams kyi skabs su ljongs 'dir zangs kyi thon khungs phun sum 105

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskatshogs pa dang / lcags rigs lta bu dkon pas skabs de'i 'tsho ba'i rgyun bkol gyi yo byad phal che ba zangs las bzos shing zangs bum yang de dag dang mtshungs par zangs las bzos pas ming du zangs bum zhes thogs/nye lam shel gyis bzo bzhin 'dug de'i dbyibs ni rgyud las/ bum pa 'khyud 'khor sor ni bco brgyad la// srid sor bcu gnyis kha zlum sor bzhi ba// zhes dang / de'u dmar ba'i gso rig gces btus rin chen phreng ba las/ me bum gdabs pa'i thabs ni me bum ni// dpangs sor bcu gnyis 'khyud 'khor sor bco brgyad// kha zheng sor bzhi rim gzhol mgul sor do//srab la dwangs pa lto ba rlung gseng ldan// zhes gsungs 'dug mod/ da lta nad thog lag len du bkol bzhin pa ni zangs bum gyi 'khyud 'khor du sor bco brgyad dang / kha zheng du sor bzhi dgos pa sogs ni gzhung dang mthun yang / dpangs su sor bcu gnyis dang mgul du sor do sogs gzhung dang lag len khrod kyi zangs bum gnyis kyi dbyibs tha dad du 'dugaganyis pa/ spyi'i phan nus dang phyag len byed srol/1 rngabs rwa ni yan lag bzhi'i tshigs mtshams dang sgal tshigs/ ske tshigs sogs su khrag ngan chu ser rgyas nas na ba'am/ yang na grang grum dang tsha grum/ dreg nad sogs kyis yan lag gi tshigs na ba dang 'khyog por gyur bar rwa rgyag rgyu ste/ lag pa'i gru tshigs kyi phyi rol dang mkhrig tshigs kyi rgyab/mdzub tshigs kyi rgyab dang 'gram gnyis/ rkang ba'i pus mo'i mdun ngos 1slo

st+waṃbardusmo010spru5 0ba 116dzirdu2ba graXzu1dzu10khubacas su rwa rgyag pa las/ mkhrig tshigs nang ngos sogs su rgyag mi rung /de ni gnas de ru rtsa dkar dang khrag rtsa'i rigs mang bas nyen che/ rwa rgyag skabs thog mar na yul steng dug sel ma mog gis dug sel legs par byas shing de'i steng rwa'i che chung 'tsham pa zhig rgyag rgyu/ dper na mdzub tshigs su der 'tsham pa'i rwa chung chung re rgyag dgos/ rwa brgyab nas chu tshod skar ma bco lnga tsam bzhag rjes gzhogs gcig mdzub mos mnan la dal gyis blangs/rgyag shul tu khrag ngan chu ser rgyas nas sha mdog log pa'am/ 'then shugs kyis sbos che ba bcas byung na gtsags bus cung gshags te slar yang rwa brgyab nas khrag ngan chu ser rnams 'don/2 zangs bum ni lus kyi stod na ba dang / dbugs 'tshangs pa/ khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad/ mkhal 'grams kyi nad/ grib skyon/ snying 'phyos dang snying gzer nad bcas la phan che zhing / gzhan kha zas kyi dang ga 'gag pa dang pho ba'i 'ju stobs zhan pa/ bad smug mo nad rlung tshabs dang khrag tshabs bcas la'ang phan/ zangs bum rgyag skabs lus kyi rgyab ngos nas khrag don chog pa las/ pho gsang dang brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams sogs su rgyag dgos byung na lus kyi mdun ngos kyi gnas de dag tu rwa rgyag pa ltar gtsags bus gshags nas khrag dbyung mi rung / zangs bum rgyag stangs ni/ thog mar rgyag gnas su dug sel ma mog gis dug sel legs par byas shing de nas shog bu zhig la me sgron nas zangs bum du g.yug thog rgyag gnas steng glan/ chu tshod skar ma bco lnga tsam nas phyir blangs/107

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakhrag dbyung dgos pa'i rigs la rwa rgyag pa ltar gtsags bus gshags nas slar thengs gcig rgyag dgos/rngabs rwa dang zangs bum rgyag mi rung ba'i rigs ni rgan pa dang byis pa/zungs zad/ sbrum ma/ rkang 'bam gyi nad bcas yin/ gal te sbrum mar rgyag dgos byung tshe snying gi rgyab mdun dang lto ba/ rgyu zhabs/ nu ma'i 'gram bcas su rgyag mi rung / gzhan pags pa'i 'bras skran dang khrag ril dkar po'i nad bcas la gtan nas rgyag mi rung /gsum pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i phan nus dang phyag len byed srol/rngabs rwa dang zangs bum gnyis kyi phan nus mang che ba gcig mtshungs su snang zhing / so so'i thad nas thun mong ma yin pa'i phan nus re yang thon gyin 'dug gzhan de gnyis kyi phyag len byed srol yang phal cher 'dra/ nga tshos dpyad mchog 'di gnyis lag len byed skabs rigs mi 'dra ba gsum gyi sgo nas byas na chog ste/ rigs gcig ni gna' bo'i phyag len byed srol ltar bya rgyu dang / rigs gcig ni me btsa'i gsang dmigs dang de'i phan nus su gzhigs nas nad gzhi gang la gang phan gyi dmigs su rgyag dgos/rigs gcig ni rtsa'i rgyu lam dang bstun nas yar mar 'gul skyod sgos rgyag rgyu/ rgyu lam 'di rtsa dkar gyi khrod nas 'tshol ba zhig dang rtsa nag gi khrod nas 'tshol ba zhig bcas gnyis su snang / rtsa dkar gyi rgyu lam ni yan lag phyi 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa drug gi rgyu lam mam dra ba de yin la/ rtsa de drug po 108

st+waṃ0(smo010spru| 0ba 116khu(mis hphukhusku1dzukrodzini sbu gu can gnyis dang / 'ja' byed gnyis/ ratna gnyis bcas yin/rtsa rgyud 'di drug po'i rgyu lam ni rgyud las/ sbu gu can de ltag pa'i sdud sgor don// an stong g.yas g.yon mtshon re thad kar 'grims// tshigs pa lnga nas gzhung pa'i rtsa dang 'brel// bcu gnyis pa nas bsam bse'u mkhal mar 'brel// gzhug chung dpyi leb mtshams brgyud dpyi mig don// brla sgang pus tshigs ngar gdong thur bar 'grims// pir mgor 'brel nas gong dang rkang mthil 'dus// 'ja' byed ltag zur spu 'khyil gnyis su don//an stong 'gram nas phrag brgyud dpung sog mtshams// dpung 'dzum tshigs dmigs lug gzhug phyi mchan 'grims// gru mo'i tshigs bskor lag pa'i mtheb mor 'brel// ratna rtse mgo rna shal 'og tu thon// sgrog rus nang nub gru mo gzhu mchog bar// thur bar 'grims nas lag pa'i srin mtheb 'brel// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbu gu can de gnyis klad snying las byung zhing ltag pa'i sdud sgor don/ de nas an stong tshigs pa dang po'i g.yas g.yon du tshon re'i thad kar 'grims te tshigs pa lnga ba nas 'dus pa gzhung pa'i rtsa dang 'brel/ bcu gnyis pa nas don te bsam bse'u dang mkhal mar 'brel/ de nas mas kyi gzhug chung dang dpyi leb mtshams rnams brgyud nas dpyi mig tu don/ de nas byin pa dang brla sha'i phyi sul brgyud de sre long dang phyi long gi bar gong mtheb brgyud nas nang ngos rkang mthil du 'gro/gnyis ni tshigs pa bcu bzhi'i thad nas gyes te dpyi steng don/ brla sgang nas gnyan gong brgyud pus mo'i tshigs dang rkang ba'i ngar gdong thur bar 109

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakhrag rlung stod 'tshangs sam khrag shed mthon po'i nad/ brgyal gzer dang mgo yu 'khor ba/ grib skyon gyis lus kyi gzhogs gcig gi bya las dang tshor ba nyams pa'am lus yongs kyi bya las dang tshor ba nyams pa/ rlung nad kyis shing ltar rengs pa'am gzhu ltar gug pa/ ngan khrag rgyas nas mgo bo na zhing mig rab rib byed pa/ bad rlung mgo 'khor gyi nad bcas la phan/ gser khab dang dngul khab gnyis kyi so so'i phan yon ni khrag mkhris shas che bar gser khab dang bad rlung shas che bar dngul khab brgyab na phan/ pho la gser khab dang mo la dngul khab brgyab na phan/ 'on kyang phan tshun gyi tshab kyang byed nus/do snang bya dgos pa'i rigs ni gser khab gting du 'gro che tshe klad skyi rdol nyen che zhing gza' gdon phog pa lta bu'i nad slong bas gzab dgos/gso bya 'gar gser khab rgyag skabs brgyal 'bog tu gyur 'gro ba dang yang na snying g.yug che zhing dbugs stod du 'tshangs ba bcas kyi log nyes 'byung bas/ de rigs la brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams dang rgyab gsang dang po/drug pa dang bdun pa bcas su phur mnye bya rgyu'am hor me gdab rgyu/ yang na mkhrig ma'i nang log gi gnyer ma yod pa nas gyen du rang sor gsum gzhal mtshams kyi dkyil ngos dang sna rtse'i 'og gsham bcas su sor rtse yis gnon btsur bya/ gzhan man rgyud du 'bog yun ring na sor mo nyi shu bsreg ces pa ltar yan lag gi sor mo nyi shu'i rtse bsreg pa'am sor mo kha shas kyi rtse bsreg srin mdzub kyi rtse bsreg na sor mo gzhan las nus pa che/ brgyal 122

st+waṃ0rdusmo0109kau 0ba 116dzirdumis krokhuzu1khu1bakhu'abog tu gyur bar brang gzhung du chu lcag rgyab kyang phan che/ da dung do snang bya dgos pa zhig ni/ tshes gcig drug dang bco brgyad nyer gnyis sam//nyer bzhi nya stong gtar bsreg gnyis ka spang zhes pa ltar gong gi tshes grangs 'di dag tu rten pho mo gnyis la spang dgos zhing / gzhan mtsho drag skyon dang de nyid phyi// klu tshes lag mig bug zung snga zhes pa ltar rten phor tshes bzhi dang bcu gcig bco brgyad/ bco lnga bcas bzhir phyi dro me khrag spang dgos/ rten mor tshes brgyad dang bco lnga/ nyer gnyis/ nyer dgu bcas bzhir snga dro me khrag spang dgos/ da dung bla srog gshed gzar brtag nas gshed gza'i skabs me khrag spang / zla gcig gi yun bla gnas 'khor bskyod byed bzhin pa ni skyes par tshes gcig g.yas nas brtsi zhing / bud med tshes gcig g.yon nas brtsi sogs dang nyin gcig la bla gnas mgo nas mar phyogs su 'gro bzhin pa bcas la gzhigs nas bla gnas spyi gtsug tu bab yod tshe gser khab gdab mi rung ba bcas so//bdag gis nad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i gso bya bco lnga tsam la spra ldan gser khab brgyab mod/ phan med gcig kyang mi 'dug cing mngon drag gi tshad kyang mtho bas/ 'dir ches mdor bsdus sgos gso bya gnyis kyi dpe mtshon nad deb tsam 'god pa ni/ dper mtshon ka ba/ ming྾ ྾ ྾/ mo/lo46yin/ sdod gnas klu chu'i lha mo zhang 'phags ge sde ba/ gser khab gdab pa'i dus tshod ni spyi lo1996lo'i zla8pa'i tshes3nyin/ gso bya'i nad rtags ni mgo yu 'khor zhing mgo bo na ba dang mtshan gnyid yer ba/123

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskamig rab rib byed pa bcas la gser khab gdab rjes kyi chu tshod skar ma sum cu tsam gyi rjes nas mgo yu mi 'khor zhing mgo bo'ang sngon ltar mi na ba/mig rab rib kyang mi byed par gyur/ dper mtshon kha ba/ ming྾྾྾/mo/ lo63yin/ las khungs klu chu'i ma nge zhang srid gzhung / gser khab gdab pa'i dus tshod ni spyi lo1997lo'i zla12pa'i tshes 3nyin/ nad rtags ni gso byar khrag shed mtho nad dam khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad gzhi byung nas lo bcu tsam son zhing dus rtag tu khrag shed170(110kro7kha6tsam gyi yas mas yin/ 'das pa'i nyim bcu'i sngon glo bur khrag shed sngon las je mthor gyur nas mgo bor gzer zug langs shing / mig nang nas khrag rdol ba bcas la rdzong mi dmangs sman khang gi nad sdod khang du nyar nas gso bcos byas shing dang thog khrag shed220(1407mchuyod pa bcas la nyin bdun ring gso bcos byas pas mig nang gi khrag bzhur mtshams chad mod/ khrag shed je dmar mi chags pas sman khang nas phyir bud nas bdag la ston du 'ongs/ skabs der khrag shed210mo140gra7ṣṭhayin/ na lugs dang nad rtags su mgo bo na zhing mig rab rib byed/snying g.yug che zhing dbugs hal ba bcas la bdag gis spyi gtsug tu dngul khab gdab pas/ nyin gsum gyi rjes nas rim bzhin khrag shed mar chags nas170(100gragra la son/ mgo bo mi na zhing snying khams kyang je bder song ba bcas so//124

st+waṃ0(smo010pyi| 0ba 116rdurdu30 krodzizu1'u7dzigasum pa/ mjug bsdu ba/thog ma'i 'char gzhi ni dpyad rtsom 'di'i hor me'i skabs su dpe mtshon gyi nad deb 'bri rgyu dang spra ldan gser khab rgyag skabs do snang bya rgyu'i skor du nyin gcig dang zla gcig sogs so sor bla gnas 'khor skyod byed pa'i re'u mig dang bcas 'bri bar 'dod mod/ sngon bla brang gi btsun pa zhig gis rtsom yig cig bris nas dge bshes shig la bstan zhor/ bdag gis bris pa e legs zhes dris tshe/ dge bshes kyis khyod kyi rtsom nang du sa sle bo gang yod pa de mar pho zhig ces lan btab pa'i rjes su 'gro bar dogs nas ma bris lags/ skabs 'di'i dpyad rtsom 'di ru nor 'khrul gyi cha sogs mchis che gzir gnas mkhas dbang rnam pas skyon brjod dang dag bcos bya rgyu gal/125

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagrub pa lus kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dam 'dzin byas te mu mthud du 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos pa'i skor phran tsam gleng ba/'dzam gling gso rig gi kha phyogs ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lus kyi gnas lugs gsal rtogs thub rgyu dang der 'du ba ma snyoms pa'i nad byung tshe gso bcos bya rgyu/ nad med rigs yun ring gnas thabs bya rgyu de yin/ de bzhin du bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs pa yang de las ma 'das pa ni rtsa rgyud las mi na ba gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o zhes dang / bshad rgyud las/ mi na gnas dang na ba gso ba dang // tshe ring chos nor bde ba sgrub pa'i phyir// gso ba rig pa'i don rnams mdor bsdu na// zhes gsungs pa dag gis gsal/ de na bgrang bya sum stong dgu brgya lhag gi lo rgyus yod pa'i bod lugs gso rig gis 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lus kyi gnas lugs la ji lta bu'i rtogs 'jug thub 'dug zer na kha cig nga tsho gang zag phal ba'i blo yul las 'das shing dus rabs 'di'i tshan rig dang 126

st+waṃb(smo010spru| 0ba rwa16khurdumib kroX61'u1sarngubasdur na he bag ha cang che/ kha cig gzhung du bkod pa lag len khrod ngos ma zin pa dang gcig gyur gyi 'grel tshul med pa'i skyon mchis pas/ gsham nas thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs dam 'dzin bya rgyu'i skor dang rjes lus sam 'grel ma thub pa'i rigs je gsal sogs su gtong rgyu'i skor dpe mtshon gnyis kyi sgo nas brjod pa la/ dang po/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dam 'dzin bya rgyu'i skor/lus khams chags pa'i rgyu'i skor la deng rabs gso rig gzhung du pha ma gnyis kyi khu khrag skyon med de kho na yin par bshad cing / ke la sha yis bskor ba'i rang re'i bod lugs gso gzhung du pha'i khu ba dang ma'i khams dmar/ bar ma do'i rnam par shes pa bcas lhan cig tshogs dgos par gsungs/ bcings grol byas rjes rnam shes zer tshe rmongs dad du brtsis shing nang bstan shes rig tshang mar rmongs dad kyi ming btags nas lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i mjug tsam du lus/ lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i mjug dang dgu bcu ba'i mgor nang bstan shes rig ni tshad ldan rig gnas kyi grub cha zhig tu brtsis pa ma zad/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i mgor slob grwa che khag dag nas khrid byar bzhag gnas tshul 'di ni dga' 'os pa'i bgyi ba zhig tu mchis la/ yod tshad mig lam nas ra sprod byed dgos pa'i rmongs dad las thar mgo brtsam pa'i mtshon rtags shig kyang yin/ rang re'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi srol gtod pa po bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo las kyang 127

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska'ajig rten gyi dbyibs ni zlum gzugs shig yin zhes snga mo nas gsungs yod pa dang / 'jig rten nam go la'i rgya khyon dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu dang/ mtha' skor du rgya tshad sum 'gyur/ lhun po'am go la'i 'phang du dpag tshad khri nyi shu tham pa/ de dang zla ba'i bar la dpag tshad bzhi khri nyis stong ngo zhes gsungs par/ da lta'i tshan rig dag gi brtag byed 'phrul chas dang 'phur grus tshod dpag dngos su byas pa ltar na ni/ go la dang zla ba'i bar du spyi le khri53 7000lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang stong tsho bdun yod/'di dang nang ba'i chos gzhung nas bshad pa'i dpag tshad bzhi khri nyis stong rtsis grangs brgyab na tag tag red ces rgyal spyi'i tshan rig shes bya'i rgyang bsgrags le tshan du phyi lo2000lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes8nyin bshad pas tha mal ba'i skye bo su zhig gi rna lam du phyogs tshe ha mi las sam/ sku zhabs sung krung hran gyis kyang ‘‘sangs rgyas chos lugs ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma yum yin/tshan rig gzhan gyis ma rtogs pa'i stong cha rnams de yis gsab thub’’ ces gsungs shing / de bzhin du sku zhabs gro pho'i khro yis kyang ‘‘sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pas ches gting zab kyi shes rab cig sbrum 'dug la/ de yis 'dzam gling mi rigs la gsal rtogs dang / mi'i rigs la rjes dpag gis rang skyon rang brtag mtshan nyid la dbye zhib byas pa bcas la gting zab cing thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i rigs lam zhig go’’ zhes gsungs 'dug tshan rig gis ma rtogs pa tshang ma rmongs dad la ye nas brtsi mi rung / rang re'i nang bstan du gsungs pa'i shes bya rnams 128

st+waṃb('i010spruto 00 116dzirdutshis krodzi61dzu1gordugadod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi skabs nas da lta'i yun mi rnams kyis 'grel ma thub pa'i rigs la lhas bskrun pa red zer ba'am tha na mi'i las dbang yang 'gran bral gyi lhas bkod 'doms byed pa red zer ba'i rmongs gtam zhig min par dngos don gyi bgyi bar gzhi bcol nas ches mtho sa'i tshan rig gi lta ba zhig yin pa ni krung go'i gsar brje ba dang bsam blo ba/ rtsom rig pa chen mo sku zhabs lo'u zhin gyis sangs rgyas chos gzhung mang por gzigs rjes rang gi grogs po zhi'i hreg khrang la bshad don/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ni dngos gnas mkhyen dpyod chen po dang thams cad mkhyen pa rang red/nga tshos rtag tu bgrod dka' ba'i mi tshe'i dka' gnad mtha' dag khong gis snga sa nas gsungs 'dug ces gsungs pa'ang bden don med pa'i smyo gtam zhig gtan nas min/ gzhan en ke si yis rang byung rtsod sgrub smra ba ru bshad don/ ‘sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi khyad chos ni mi'i rigs kyi rtsod sgrub rig lam gyi cung mtho sar slebs 'dug 'jig rten lta bar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis ches rlabs chen 'gran bral gyi lha zhes khas mi len pa dang / bya dngos la mgo dang mjug mtha' bcas med par rgyu 'bras kyi dra bar gnas 'dug ces gsungs pa dag gis rang re'i nang bstan shes rig ni tshan rig gi zhing sa nas 'khrungs pa'i bla med dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhig yin pa rtogs sla/ bdag gis 'di ltar brjod don ni rang re'i bod lugs gso rig gzhung du lus chags pa'i rgyur khu khrag sems gsum 'dzoms dgos/ rnam shes ni ches lkog gyur zhig yin pas 'di zhes ston rgyu med pa 129

tsho bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasogs kyi rkyen pas dngos gco'i lta bas rnam shes zhes pa zhig yod par khas mi len/ don ngo mar nga tsho dgod pa'i gdong la bstos nas dgod pa dang /ngu ba'i bzhin la bltos nas ngu ba lta bu'i kha phyogs med pa zhig gtan nas byed mi rung / nga tsho'i grub pa lus kyi skabs su bkod pa'i rnam shes dang bdun phrag so brgyad por rlung mi 'dra ba so gnyis kyi byed las su brten nas lus 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rig pa 'di da lta'i tshan rig gis rtogs ma thub pa'i tshan rig cig yin pas/ go la zlum po 'dir lan gsum bskor ba brgyab kyang rnyed dka'/ de'i rkyen gyis rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'di dag dam 'dzin byed dgos/gnyis pa/ gzhung tshig 'grel ma thub pa'i skor mu mthud 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos pa'i skor/spyir bod lugs gso rig dbu brnyes pa dang lhan du mi'i lus kyi grub char zhib 'jug legs por gnang ba ma zad bod rgyal bcu ba e sho legs kyi skabs su rus skyon bcad cing sha skyon gshags pa dang / pags ral btsems pa bcas kyi phyag len rgya cher spel ba ni dar lding gi gshen ston ye shes blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rma bcos 'chi sos la chu'i zhal gdams las gsal zhing / lhag par dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang skyabs rje g.yu thog rnying ma chen mos bdud rtsi snying bo'i gzhung mdzad cing kha che rgyal bo'i blon po seng ge sbas pa'i mgo bor rus tshab gzhug pa ni nye lam nga tsho'i rmi lam du 'byung 130

st+waṃbardusmo010spruto 0ba 116dzi(mis 7rduzu1dzu1sakhudaka' ba'i 'char snang zhig tu gda'/ gzhan dus rabs der byung ba'i gson thig dang ro thig ro bkra thu gu dgu sbyor/ ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long sogs ni mi'i lus la zhi 'jug byas pa'i rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi'i grub 'bras yin/de'i rjes bod kyi bsam blo ba chen mo bcu'i ya gyal ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma dur khrod mang por zhabs kyis bcags nas mi'i phung bo'i grub cha'i gnas lugs la gom gang mdun spos kyis gsal rtogs thub pas phung bo zan bskyur gyi rnam bshad ces pa'i bka' rtsom mdzad/ gzhan brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed kyis byang khog thig 'grems gsal sgron zhes pa'ang mdzad/ lhag par du dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang mi dbang paṇḍi ta sde srid mchog gis sngar yod sman dang ro bkra'i 'dra dpe rnams 'tshol bsdu byas mthar bod sman gzhung hril bo'i nang don dang 'brel ba'i sman thang don dgu gsar bzheng gnang / gnad che ba 'ga' zhig lho brag bstan 'dzin nor bus mi ro dngos la gshags las byas nas lus kyi gnas lugs ci bzhin thang gar bkod/ gong gi 'di dag ni kha sang gi lo rgyus deb ther ngos su bkod pa'i bla med rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes dang rjes rabs nga tshor bzhag pa'i mdzad med kyi beerya'i nor bu lta bu ru zad mod/ rgyud tshig 'ga' shas la rjes 'jug pa'i lta bar gcig mthun ma byung bar 'grel tshul tha dad du byung ba'am/ yang na rgyud du grangs tsam bkod par 'grel ba rnams su grangs ka de dag re re'i ngos ma bzung bar rang sor grangs tsam bkod nas bzhag yang na gzhung 'grel rnams su gnas sogs legs par bkod pa'i 131

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagatar rtsa don bdun po'ang da lta ro bkra dang mi'i lus steng nas tshang ma ngos 'dzin mkhan med pa'i gnas su gyur 'dug pas/ 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul mang du lhag tshe dpal ldan rgyud bzhi yang shog bu'i phung bo zhig tu 'gyur nyen che/ de na grub pa lus kyi skabs 'dir nga tshor nye bar mkho ba zhig ni mi'i lus kyi cha shas rnams la ming re btags nas mdzub mo ri ston gyi tshul tu gtan la dbab rgyu de yin/thabs lam 'di las sla bo las kyang khag po zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang thog mar grub pa lus kyi grub char mkhas pa'i dge rgan chen mo rnams lhan gcig tu 'dus nas mtshon khra dang ldan pa'i ro bkra'i steng nas rus rigs sum brgya drug cu dang rtsa dkar nag gi nang gses dbye ba'i ngos 'dzin sogs mdor na lus yongs kyi grub char bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung nas ngos 'dzin bya rgyu dang / de nas deb gcig tu bzos nas dpe skrun byas shing bod lugs gso rig slob grwa so so'i zur lta'i khrid bya byed rgyu/ deb 'di 'dra zhig bzo skabs rgyud dang nyams yig rnams su yod pa'i ming gtso bor bzung nas bkod dgos/ dper na/ pho ba'i 'og tu yod pa'i sha men der nub lugs gso rig gis dbyi zhan(ltalkoṣṭhaṭwā)zer zhing / a mdo'i yul skad du sha men dang mnga' ris yul skad du sha sha men bu zer ba 'di dang gso dpyad rgyal bo'i dkor mdzod du bsam bse'u'i skor bshad skabs/ kha cig na re sha sha rmen bu yin yang zer zhes pa der ming mtshungs pas rjes sor de'i ming du sha sha rmen bu zhes brjod na 'tsham/ gzhan long mgo'i rgyu chung 132
