st+waṃbardusmo010sprusnga 0pa 116dzi(mi0 7khuzu1khu7khuder dmangs khrod du rgyu lhag zer zhing da lta gso byed pa tshos kyang bsam blo ci yang mi gtong bar rgyu lhag zer bzhin 'dug mod/ don dam du der bod lugs gso rig gzhung na ming med pa zhig dang ma'i lus su dgos mkho med pa'i snod lhag ma zhig yod pa gtan nas min/ de ni bshad rgyud kyi mchan 'grel du/ rgyu ma drang srong sa 'og bum gter 'dra// de la thog mar gnyan gyi phung bo bshig / de rjes tsha 'jam gang sbyong rig pas 'phrul// zhes gsungs 'dug pas/ snod chung der rgyu ma drang srong zhes brjod na 'tsham/gal te rgyud dang nyams yig sogs su ma mchis pa'i rigs la dmangs khrod kyi ming gis kha snon rgyag dgos/gzhan yang rgyud las so brgyad mgo mjug log ste mngal nas thon zhes gsungs par snga 'grel thams cad du de'i sngon mngal gnas kyi mgo bo gyen la bstan nas gnas yod cing / skabs der thog pa'i rkyen zhes pa'i rlung gi byed las kyis mgo mjug sgyur ba'am log ste mngal gyi phugs nas phyir 'byin cing btsa' ba la mngon du phyogs par 'gyur zhes bkod 'dug deng skabs2sgra rlabs sogs kyis brtag skabs mngal gnas nyid thog ma nas mgo bo mar bstan nas gnas 'dug pas gnas tshul dngos dang mi mthun pa 'di rang re'i bod lugs gso gzhung du bkod pa de nor ba yin nam dpal ldan rgyud bzhi rtsom gnang mdzad skabs mngal gnas kyi mgo bo gyen du bstan yod cing / da lta mi rnams kyi zas spyod dang phyi rol gyi gnam gshis 'gyur bas thog ma nyid nas mngal gnas kyi mgo bo mar bstan pa 133

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskayin/ yang na gzhung tshig der rjes 'brangs rnams pas 'os 'tsham gyis 'grel ma thub pa yin/ dper na phyi rgyud rtsa mdo ru snying gi rtse mo de ltar gnas pa'i phyir zhes pa'i tshig ris tsam la brtag tshe pho mo'i snying rtse 'khor phyogs tha dad yin pa'i snang tshul zhig 'char yang / don ngo mar de bzhin ma yin par skyes pa pho mo'i snying gi gnas stangs la khyad par med pa dang /skyes pa'i snying yid 'jug bu ga'i rtsa'i rtse mo lus kyi g.yon ngos su kha gtad nas gnas shing bud med kyi snying yid 'jug bu ga'i rtsa'i rtse mo lus kyi g.yas ngos su kha gtad cing gnas par dgongs nas gsungs pa ni gsang tig sgron me dang gong sman pa'i dris lan rab gsal me long las gsal ba ltar skabs 'dir yang lkog gyur gyi don zhig tu dmigs nas gsungs pa yin/yang na dpal ldan rgyud bzhi thengs bcu bzhi tsam par du btab pas skabs shig tu bcos nyes sam brko nyes byas pa yin/ yang na sman gyi thang ga ru snying rtse gyen du bstan nas bris yod pa'ang bod sman pas snying gi gnas stangs ma shes par de bzhin bris pa min pa ni gong sman pa'i dris lan rab gsal me long las/ byang khog yul thig 'chad pa'i skabs// snying rtse gyen du bstan pa ni// kun rdzob blo yi snang ngor dang // bstun nas rten 'brel dbang du gsungs// gzhan du pho mo khyad med par// snying rtse lus g.yon thur du bstan zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'dir yang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis mngal gnas kyi mgo bo gyen du bstan yod ces bris nga/ yin/bdag gis gzhigs na gzhung tshig der rjes rabs pa tshos 'grel ma thob 134

st+waṃsardu'i010spru| 00 rwa16khurdumi0 grarduzu1010khupa'am rten 'brel gyi dbang du gsungs pa gnyis kyi gcig e yin bsam/gang ltar yang gnas tshul 'di'ang nye lam thag gcod dgos pa'i gnad don zhig tu snang /mdor na gong gi gnad don gnyis po dpe mtshon tsam du bkod pa las/'di dang 'di lta bu'i rigs grub pa lus kyi skabs su ha cang mang bas nga tshos cis kyang rang nyid kyis thag gcod thab pa'i rigs rang nyid kyis thag ༄gcod byed dgos so// 135

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabad kan mgul 'gags dang smyag po pho bar babs pa gnyis la brtag bcos byas pa'i myong tshor phran bu/o ā tha/ skye 'gro kun gyi skyabs mgon sangs rgyas sman gyi bla dang bde gshegs g.yu thog gsar rnying bcas la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skal ba ma stong bar du bdag rjes su 'dzin par smon/skabs su babs pa ni bad kan skya bo rigs drug gi nang tshan mgul 'gags dang smug po rang gnas pho bar babs pa gnyis kyi bcos thabs gtso bor bzung nas brtag bcos tsam bkod pa la/dang po bad kan mgul 'gags kyi brtag bcos/thog mar nad gzhi 'di'i rgyu ni bad kan tha mal mtshan nyid kyi zur bdun dang ldan pa der/ slong rkyen ro mngar zhing nus pa lci ba dang bsil ba snum pa bcas bsten drag pa'am kha zas snga ma ma zhu bar phyi ma zos pa/ gro sran sogs gsar thog gi 'bru dang rul ba'am sungs pa/ ma tshos pa dang tshig po 'khregs po sogs zos rkyen slong par byed pa dag bad kan spyi'i slong 136

st+waṃsardu'i010smya5 00 116dzi 3sa 7khuzu101badzirkyen dang 'dra la/ sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo las kyang bad kan spyi'i slong rkyen ni/ 'grangs dang brlan la 'dug pa dang // ma zhu ngal dub bcud can zas// chu'am chang mang 'thung las byung zhes dang / mgul 'gags dmigs bsal gyi slong rkyen ni gong rnams kyi steng phan bde nor bu'i snye ma las/ byis pa dar mar byung ba dkon// gsungs kyang deng dus ma nges so//ja chang kha zas spyod drags sam// zhe sdang 'khon 'dzin mya ngan ches// rkyen las nad 'di byung ba mang zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//mgul 'gags kyi rtags ni man ngag lhan thabs las/ bad kan 'gul 'gags zhes bya pho ba dang // brang dang glo bar bad kan rgyas pa yis// bad kan rlangs pa glo yu mid par chags// dper na mdong mo'i logs la 'o chags 'dra// 'di la thog ma bar dang tha ma'i rtags// dang po gre ba tsha la mid pa dang // brang dang ske stong lten sna tshigs pa na// zas dang skom sogs mid pa dka' snyam byed// bar du zas dang skom gnyis mid pa dka'// gre ba na la lud pa ljan ljin mang // mid pa log cing bya rog mig gnyis gzer// dbugs rngub dka' nyams sha skam lus stobs 'chor// tha ma gre ba tsha skam zas mi thar// thar kyang pho bar mi phebs brang du sdod/ zos dus glo langs skyug cing skyigs bu 'byung // dbugs 'tshub ngar sob che la mid pa 'gags// thog ma bar gyi nad rtags mkhas pas 'tsho// tha ma'i rtags kun tshang na 'chi bar 'dug ces gsungs pa'i nad rtags rnams dang deng rabs gso rig gi mid pa'i khwayi nad rtags gnyis shin tu mtshungs/ de ni deng 137

bod lugs gso rig gi dargyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskarabs gso rig tu mid pa'i dūyi slong rkyen gtso bo ni 'khor yug dang mi rgyud las byung bar bshad/ mid 'chuspumid pa'i dū)'byung mang ba'i yul khams nas brtag dpyad byas pa ltar na rgyun ring tsha drag dang mkhregs po/ rul skyur sogs kyi kha zas brten pa'am/ yang na rgyun ring tha mag 'then pa dang a rag btung pa bcas kyis mid pa'i nang ngos kyi skyi pags la gnod skyon phog par 'brel ba che/ srog chags la tshod blta byas pa'i dpyad 'bras su sngo tshod yun ring bsnyal nas skyur por bzos pa'i khu bas byi ba dkar po'i mid pa dang pho ba'i ngos mthug por chags shing rim bzhin nu rdotshinu rtse)lta bu'i skran chags/ mjug mthar gnas de ③ru 'gyur 'gro bar bshad pas/mid pa'i ③ni bod lugs gso rig gzhung nas chang dang rul skyur mkhregs po'i rigs kyis bad kan mgul 'gags slong bar byed cing mthar zas mi thar ba sogs dang gcig mtshungs su 'dug de ni deng rabs gso rig gzhung nas mid pa'i ③la nad gzhi'i 'phel rim sgos dus rim gnyis sam gsum du dbye zhing / dus rim dang po'i skabs su lan rer brang 'og tu cung na snyam byed pa'am tsha shar tsam gtong ba las dmigs bsal gyi nad rtags med/ dus rim gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i skabs su mchil ma dang kha zas mid dka' zhing / lan rer ye nas mi thar/ lu sa po'ang rim bzhin skam 'gro zhing zungs khrag zad pa/ 5glog 'od dang bhu1sogs kyis brtag tshe mid pa'i gnas su skran rdog mchis/ der brten bod lugs gso rig rigazhung du gsungs pa'i bad kan mgul 'gags nad phal che ba deng rabs 138

st+waṃs(smo010spru5 0ba rwa16dzishumi0 hphukhuskye101godzigaso rig gi mid pa'i dūyin 'dug 'on kyang bod lugs su dbye ba'i dus rim gsum po 'di deng rabs gso rig gi dbye stangs dang mi 'dra/ de ni deng rabs kyi dus rim dang por dmigs bsal gyi nad rtags med pa dang /skabs 'dir sman bcos dang gshags bcos byas tshe cung bcos skyed mchis shing ches tshad mtho'i bcos tshad lo lngar 'tsho rgyu de yin/ bod lugs su dbye ba'i dus rim gsum po deng rabs kyi dus rim gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i khongs su 'dus shing / dus rim 'di gnyis kyi skabs ni sman bcos dang gshags bcos gang gi thad nas bcos 'das kyi dus su ngos bzung 'dug pas bod lugs kyi dus rim dang po nas bcos 'das kyi khongs su bgrang 'dug mod/ rang re'i gzhung lugs rnams su de ltar ma yin par dus rim dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs su sman pa mkhas pas gsos na 'tsho thub par gsungs shing nad gzhi 'di'i nad las grol byed kyi sman dpyad sngags sogs mang du bkod 'dug pas kyang rtogs sla/ gre thog dang pho thog mid mchus gol ba rigs dgu sogs mgul 'gags nad 'babs sa'i dbye ba'am nad rtags kyi khyad par tsam las ngo bo mgul 'gags rang yin pa phan bde'i snye ma sogs su gsal/ mid pa'i dūgang mang zhig kyang thog mar gnas de ru skran chags shing rim bzhin ngo bo③ru 'gyur bzhin pas/mid pa'i ngos su skran rdog chags na gnas de'ikhwayi rtags ston/ nad thog lag len skabs mgul 'gags kyi nad rtags shar tshad mid pa'idūru ngos 'dzin mi rung /139

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskand gzhi 'di'i bcos thabs thad gzhung dang nyams yig sogs su mang du gsungs mod/ de dag phal che ba phran gyis nad thog steng bkol myong med pas 'dir shus med/ lhag par man ngag lhan thabs su bkod pa'i sbyor sde rnams su bltas tshe ci 'dra'i phan pa'i snang ba zhig shar zhing / rgya gar sman rtsis khang gis bzos pa'i thun gsum cha mnyam ril bu yang shin tu phan par bshad kyang sbyor sde de dag rang yul na med pas de dag gi phan nus la dbye zhib bya rgyu'i skal ba yang ma ldan/ spyir nad gzhi 'di mid pa'i ngos su skran gyi rnam pa chags pa zhig yin pa ni phan bde'i snye ma las/ mgul 'gags gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs pho ba'i stod// bad kan rgyas pa'i rlangs pa mgul bar chags// mdong mo'i logs la zo sha chags pa 'dra zhes dang / g.yu thog khyung pos kyang / bad kan skya bo'i nang tshan gyi// mgul 'gags zhes bya'i gdug can nad// brang dang mid pa gre ba'i gnas// ma zhu'i rlangs pa chags pa yin// de nyid yun lon skran du 'gyur zhes gsungs pa dag gis gsal/ nad gzhi 'di gzhom byed du bdag gis rigs mi 'dra ba'i sbyor sde gsum bsten pa yin/ sbyor sde de dag las rigs gcig ni cong zhi 'phrul thal steng 'gron thal bsnan pa yin/ de ltar byed don mjug don gyi le'ur skran nad kun la 'phrul gyi thal sman mchog ces dang / ril bu'i le'u ru 'gron bu'i thal ba bsdebs pas skran rnams bshig ces gsungs 'dug pas yin/ sbyor sde 'di spyin thum nang bcug nas btung na legs/ sbyor sde rigs gcig ni phag mo grub pa'i sbyor ba yin zhing / phag grub las cong zhi 1slo

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprukyā 0sa rwa16khurdumib hphukhu71dzukrokhuni mang che bas nas 'bru gsum gyi tshos tshad tsam la lcags slang du ngo blangs shing der chang blugs nas ngad rlangs sgor shor du ma bcug par 'dul ba de bkol bzhin pa dang / kha cig gis ro tsa dang lus stobs rgyas par phan phyir cong zhi bcud 'dul byas pa'ang bkol bzhin pa/ bdag gis cong zhi gong gi 'dul lugs gnyis po ltar ma byas par thog mar che chung nas 'bru tsam du brdung zhing de ze tsha'i chur legs par btsos/ de bkru bshal yang yang byas mthar nyi mar skam/ de phye mar bzos pa lcags slang nang dmar por ma song bar ngo blangs shing ngad ma bsad par grang du bcug pa de bkol ba yin/ sbyor sde 'di yang rab yin na spyin thum du bcug nas brlan dang ma phrad par btung / phye mar btung tshe sman dang lhan du chu phran tsam las ma btung na legs/ sbyor sde rigs gcig ni mkhas mchog mdzod dge nyi ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag rin chen ril bu zer ba de yin/ gong sman rigs gsum las phag grub kyi sbyor ba de gtso cher bzung nas bkol bas/phan skyed kyang shin tu che zhing gso bya khag gcig gi nad rtags med par gyur nas lo gnyis gsum tsam song mod/ phyi'i nad rtags mgul 'gags ltar 'dug pa lasasnuglog 'od dang dzu1sogs kyisadūru ngos bzung 'dug par yang phan skyed thon bzhin pa ni dper na/ stag tshang lha mo'i rgad po zhig labhu1yis brtag tshe mid pa'i ngos su skran rdog gsum mchis shing de mid pa'idū tha ma'i dus su slebs 'dug ces ngos bzung / nad rtags su zos tshad phyir skyug cing mi thar ba dang yang na zug gzer che ba bcas la gnyen 141

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskapo gong ltar bzos pa'i phag grub lo phyed ring btung du bcug pas/ nyin zhig rgad por zas dang bcas kha nas sha 'dzer gnyis phyir skyug cing / shin tu bde snyam gyi tshor snang zhig byung bar ma zad kha zas kyang phal cher rgyun ldan ltar za thub par gyur/ de nas sngon ston sa'i ka cu'i dmag sman khang gidzu1yis brtag tshe da lta skran rdog gcig las med pas de gshags bcos byas na nad gzhir phan skyed che zhes lab mthar gshags bcos byas mod/nyin bco lnga tsam gyi rjes tshe las 'das/ gso bya 'di las ra sprod byed thub pa zhig ni thog mar deng rabs gso rig gi dus rim gsum par slebs pa zhig dus rim dang po'i rtags ltar gyur thub pa dang / gso bya nyid la'ang rgyun ldan ltar kha zas la yi ga yod pa/ skran rdog gnyis phyir skyug pa bcas la gzhigs na phan nus nges can zhig thon song ba mngon thub/ gzhan ka cu'i kha che rgad po zhig la mid pa'idūbyung nas nad sdod khang du lo gcig lhag tsam bsdad kyang mjug mthar nyin bzhin na zug je che dang lus stobs je rid du gyur bar/ zhogs par man ngag rin chen ril bu re dang phyi dro 'phrul thal la 'gron thal bsnan pa spyin thum gnyis re bcas nyin nyi shur bsten du bcug pas/ na zug je chung dang kha zas la yi ga'ang cung je cher 'gro bzhin par bshad/ 'dir gsal bshad bya rgyu zhig ni gong gi phag grub kyi sbyor ba dang 'phrul thal la 'gron thal bsnan pa gnyis yun ring btung na gso bya'i bshang ba skam por chags 'gro bas/ bshang ba skam pa'i rtags shar tshe zhi drug gam zhi drug gi sbyor bar lcum rtsa mang tsam bsnan pa gso bya'i 142

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprukyā 00 116rdu(tshi0 krodzizu1ku1sakhulto ba sra snyi ltar sprod dgos/gnyis pa/ sgrug po pho bar babs pa'i brtag bcos/nad gzhi 'di'i rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kan khrag bcas yin zhing / de slong bar byed pa'i rkyen ni 'grams khrag lhag pa dang mtshon khrag lus pa sogs tsha rkyen dang / 'ju dka'i zas dang mi 'phrod pa'i zas sogs bsten drags pas pho bar ma zhu bar gnas shing de ru be snabs kyi cha cher 'phel ba sogs grang rkyen bcas gnyis mchis/ nad gzhi 'di'i ming gi thog mar bad kan bzhag pa las rlung dang mkhris pa khrag bcas mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ rgyud chung las/ bad kan rgyus bskyed khrag mkhris rlung dang bsdongs zhes dang / karma nges legs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'grel las/ nad 'di thog mar chu'i khams 'phel te ma zhu ba shas cher las 'byung ba'i phyir zhes gsungs pa dag las gsal ba ni gong gi rgyu bzhi bo las thog mar bad kan gyi cha 'phel ba las 'byung bzhin pas na ming yang de bzhin btags/ ming gi mjug tu smug po zhes brjod don ni nad 'di'i rgyu rlung gi rang mdog sngon po dang /mkhris pa'i rang mdog ser ba/ bad kan rang mdog skya bo'am dkar po/khrag gi rang mdog dmar po bcas yin zhing / kha dog de bzhi lhan du ngo bo dbyer med 'dres na smug por chags 'gro bas de bzhin brjod/ spyir nad 'dir gnas dang dus rigs bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba mang mod/ skabs 143

sabardusmo0109snga 00 116khurdukrus 7khusku1dzu10khupas 'bru dang shun pags gnyi ka se 'bru'i tshad ltar bsdebs na e 'grig snyam/ de ltar byed don ni smug po pho bar babs nas chu skyur skyug pa rnams pho skyur gyi cha 'phel drag nas 'byung bzhin pas/ de rigs la gong sman se 'bru'i sbyor ba dag sprad na cung mi 'tsham snyam/ de ni se 'bru'i nus pa dro ba sogs kyis bad kan grang bar phan yang ro shin tu skyur ba dang nad 'di'i 'byung rkyen yang pho skyur(ṣṭhatsho〉77)gyi cha 'phel drag nas skyed bzhin pas/ 'di lta bu'i dog slong zhig mi gleng ga med byung / 'on kyang gso bya kha shas la thog ma'i dus nas chu tshan bro ba med pa'am yang na cung tshwa dri can skyug pas de rigs la gong sman se 'bru'i sbyor ba rnams sprad na legs/ de na thog ma nas chu skyur skyug rigs la dang thog cong zhi drug pa dang zhi drug sprad na 'tsham/ yun lon rjesasnuglog 'od sogs kyis brtag na pho ba'i ngos su rma yod par gong gi bad kan 'gul 'gags skabs kyi phag grub kyi sbyor ba de dang cong zhi 'phrul thal gnyis bsten na shin tu legs/ bdag gis nad thog skabs pho ngos su rma yod pa'i gso bya sum bcu tsam la gong sman gnyis nyin30nas 50bar bsten du bcug pas deng rabs gso sman༅lkotstsha1dang khriyīkhu1skelkosogs dang bsdur na phan nus myur zhing phan skyed che ba bcas kyi dge mtshan ldan/ gong sman gnyis btung srol ni zhogs par lto stong du 'phrul thal spyin thum gnyis re/ nyin gung dang nub phag grub thun che ba re'am spyin thum gsum re bcas bsten du bcug pa yin/ pho ngos kyi rma cung che tshe 'phrul thal 'thung nas skar ma bcu tsam gyi rjes su pho ba'i nang nas 145

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskacung gzer zhing lus rngul phran tsam thon/ phag grub 'thung tshe dang thog gso bya re gnyis cung gzer/ 'phrul thal 'thung nas gzer srol ni 'thung rjes kyi chu tshod phyed ka nas gcig tsam gyi yun gzer zhing de nas gzer zug yal ba dang rim bzhin bde snyam byed/ de ltar mu mthud nyin bco lnga yas mas su gzer zhing nyin ltar gzer zug je chung nas je chung du 'gro/ zla gcig nas nyin lnga bcu tsam la btung rjes chu skyur skyug cing / 'grangs ltogs grang dros sogs kyi skabs na ba'i nad rtags cha tshang yal 'gro/ lhag par gso bya pho smug rdol ba zhig la thog mar khrag nag kham do tsam skyug cing de'i rjes nas khrag dmar mang tsam skyug pa khyon bsdoms khrag2slokro sbyitsam skyug par/dang thog kha gur dang dom mkhris phran tsam re bsres nas btung du bcug zhor gong sman gnyis sprad/ nyin bcu gnyis kyi rjes nas kha gur dang dom mkhris gnyis btung mtshams bzhag cing gong sman gnyis mu mazud zla gnyis yun bsten pas zas spyod gang la yang 'dzems mi dgos par rgyun ldan ltar gyur/gsum pa/ mjug bsdu ba/bad kan mgul 'gags dang smug po pho bar babs pa gnyis la rang nyid kyis gso bcos byas pa'i rgyud rim tsam bris pa 'di gzhung dang lag len gyis phyug pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pa'i spyan lam du phyogs tshe 'phya ba'i gzhir gyur 'dug na thang mod/ gong nad gnyis la deng rabs gso rig gi sman 146

sa0lkusmo010spru〉 0ba 116dzirdumi0 krodzisku1khu1smokhurdzas las bod sman gyi phan nus legs pas de tsam gsal bshad dang rang nyid kyi nad thog lag len tsam po 'di na mnyam las dang po ba tshor e phan snyam nas ngo sprod kyi tshul tu lhago bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgos bris pa 'di bstod mi shes pa zhig gis bstod pa las/ smad mi shes pa zhig gis smad na legs zhes pa'i rjes su song yod tshe/ mkhyen dpyod kyi gshog rtsal rab tu rgyas pa'i bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pas dag bcos dang mdzub ston gang mang gnang rgyu gal/147

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakhu lung srog chags dang ed tsi'i nad gnyis la bod lugs gso rig gi steng nas ches thog ma'i bgro gleng blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde migadang po/ khu lung srog chags bshad pa/spyi lo1997lor dbyin ci'i tshan rig pas ches thog mar ma mo zhig gi lus steng nas srin phung(lkoṭha)zhig blangs nas khu lung byas te ma mo nyid dang mtshungs pa'i mo lug cig bzos/ mo lug de'i ming du to li(7011smo)zhes btags/ 'phrin gsar 'di gang sar khyab rjes yul khams so so'i tshan rig pa tsho'i gdeng 'jog chen po thob cing / sems can zhig gi lus grub dgos tshe pho mo gnyis lhan du 'dus pa las byung ba'i khams dmar dang khams dkar 'dres dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang med par bshad/ khu lung zer ba'i sgra don 'di rgya bod tshig mdzod kyi khrod nas 'tshol mi thub cing dbyin yig gi(dzu10sgo)ces pa'i sgra sgyur yin/ khu lung srog chags ni pha ma gnyis lhan gcig tu 'dus pa'i khu khrag las grub pa zhig min par sems can pho mo gang rung gi lus steng nas blangs pa'i srin phung zhig yin pa ni/ma mo zhig gi lus steng nas blangs pa'i srin phung gcig ma mo gzhan zhig gi 148

st+waṃb('i010spruta 00 116dzi(skya0 krodzizu1dzu1sadzimangal nas blangs pa'i khams dmar srin phung dang 'dres sbyor byas/ 'dres sbyor byas yod pa de ma mo gsum pa'i mngal tu bcug nas 'tshar skyes byung du bcug cing de nas rgyun ldan gyi lu gu ltar btsa' ru bcug de ltar btsa' ru bcug pa'i sems can de gong gi srin phung len sa'i sems can dang ches mtshungs pa zhig yin/ to li lug 'jig rten du thon rjes rgyal khab so so nas byi ba dang zog phag spre'u sogs khu lung byas nas bzos/ krung go'i rgyal khab nas kyang spyi lo2002lo'i zla dang por khu lung byas nas be'u zhig bzos shing de'i ming du khu khu zhes btags/ 'di ni krung go'i rgyal khab nas bzos pa'i ches thog ma'i khu lung srog chags yin/spyir nub lugs gso rig gi dgongs pa ltar na skyes pa pho'i khu ba'i srin bu gcig gi nang du rang nyid kyi rigs brgyud spel byed rigs mi 'dra ba nyer gsum yod pa dang de ni dper na gnyen sgrig ma byas pa'i pho rkyang nyer gsum lta bu yin/ de bzhin skyes pa mo'i mngal gnas khams dmar srin phung gcig tu yang rigs brgyud spel byed rigs mi 'dra ba'i mo rkyang nyer gsum yod/ de gnyis lhan du 'dus pa las cha re byas pa'i cha nyer gsum grub pa lhan gcig tu 'dus nas lus grub byed kyi thog ma'i sa bon du gyur/ de'i rkyen gyis 'gro ba mi'i pho'i khams dkar ram khu ba dang mo'i mngal gnas khams dmar srin phung ma gtogs lus kyi gang sar gnas pa'i srin phung re'i steng na gong gi ya zhe drug cha re byas pa'i cha nyer gsum yod/ 'dir gsal bshad bya rgyu zhig ni sems can gzhan pa'i khams dkar dmar gyi 149

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad sto gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskanang du rigs mi 'dra ba nyer gsum re med par bshad/ de yang pho rkyang mo rkyang so sor bral ba lhan du 'dus pa las rigs brgyud spel thub na/ de gnyis thog ma nyid nas lhan du 'dus pa'i srin phung gis dus da lta'i yun spel mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhes par/ tshan rig pa tshos de ni srin bu gnas sa'i yul gyi khyad par tsam yin pa las rigs brgyud spel thub pa ni khu lung byas nas bzos pa'i srog chags lta bu yin zhes lan btab/de na nga tsho'i bod lugs gso rig gis pho mo gnyis lhan gcig tu ma 'dus par byung ba'i khu lung srog chags la ji 'dra'i go ba len rgyu dang lhag par sems can pho'i rigs mi dgos par mo'i rigs kyi lus steng nas blangs pa'i srin phung zhig gis mngal chags pa'i rgyu byed thub don ci zhes brjod na/ ngas rang blos dpag tsam gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i bod kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang lhag par dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i dgongs don la gzhi bcol nas skabs bab 'di lta bu'i lan zhig 'debs rgyu ste/ spyir gang zag sems can rnams skyes gnas chen po bzhi'i gang rung zhig brgyud nas 'jig rten 'dir thon dgos shing / de las mngal skyes dang sgong skyes gnyis kyi sems can phal che bar pha ma gnyis 'dzoms pa las byung ba yin mod/ dmigs bsal gyi dbang gis bya phos sgong nga gtong ba dang grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mos mngal sbrum pa'i gnas tshul yang yod pas bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang las kyi rnam par smin pa sa mi khyab ces gsungs 'dug pas mngal skyes dang sgong skyes yin tshe pha ma 150

st+waṃ0rdusmo010spru| 0go 116khurdumi0 hphukhusku1dzu10khuganyis ka 'dzoms dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang med/ drod gsher las skyes pa dang brdzus skyes gnyis la'ang pha ma zhes mi 'dug pa ni sgra don gyi steng nas rtogs sla/ gzhan bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs pa ltar na skyes pa pho mo su yin rung rang rang gi lus steng na khams dkar dmar gnyis ka'i cha yod de/ de ni skyem pa tshe dbang gi brtsams pa'i 〈rgyud bzhi'i rnam bshad〉 du bud med bcu gnyis lon pa phan chad lus kyi stobs rdzogs nas lnga bcu'i bar du lus zungs kyi dwangs ma las byung zhing / mdangs kyi snyigs ma'i khams dkar dmar gyi cha gnyis yod pa las/ dmar cha bsam se'u nas brgyud de mngal tu zla ba rer zhes dang / yang de las khu ba khu ba'i me drod kyi smin cing dwangs snyigs phyes pa las dwangs ma mdangs su gyur/ snyigs ma mngal 'dzin pa'i sa bon dkar dmar du gyur/ bud med la dkar cha 'o mar 'gro bar bshad ces gsungs 'dug pa sogs kyis gsal/ yang na rgyud sde rnams su lus zungs bdun gyi phyi ma khu ba dkar dmar ram khams dkar dmar gnyis las dkar cha'i dwangs ma dbu ma'i yar sne smin mtshams su hūm̐ gi rnam pa dang / dmar cha'i dwangs ma dbu ma'i mar sne lte ba'i 'og tu a'i rnam par gnas pa de gnyis kyi cha shas lus kun la khyab par gsungs/gzhan skyes chen rnams dgongs pa rdzogs skabs kha cig thugs dam du bzhugs pas/ thugs dam bzhugs yun gyi ring rnam shes rtsa dbu ma nas sgor ma bud par khong na bzhugs 'dug thugs dam grol skabs sna khung g.yas g.yon gnyis nas khams dkar dmar gnyis kyi cha sgor 'bud cing 151

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadus de nas rnam shes kyang rtsa dbu ma brgyud nas sgor bud 'gro ba sogs la gzhigs na sems can pho mo su yin rung rang rang gi lus na khams dkar dmar gnyis ka'i cha yod pa ni cung rtogs par 'gyur/ de na rten gang zag gcig gi lus steng na khams dkar dmar gnyis ka'i cha yod tshe 'gro ba'i lus 'di yang bar do'i rnam par shes pa dang pha ma gnyis ka'i khams dkar dmar lhan du 'dres pa'i sa bon las grub pas/ khu lung srog chags kyang gang zag gcig gi lus steng nas khams dkar dmar gnyis lhan du 'dres pa'i sa bon blangs nas bzo bzhin par sa bon nas las 'bras bu nas 'byung ba las/ sa bon nas las 'bras bu gro thon pa mi yin par ya mtshan skye rgyu chen po zhig med/ de na nga tsho'i bod lugs gso rig gis gang zag gcig gi lus steng na lus grub byed kyi sa bon ste khams dkar dmar gnyis ka'i cha yod pa ni gdod ma nas gsal rtogs thub 'dug pas der su zhig ya mtshan mi skye'am/ 'on kyang nga tshos yod tshad nga tshor yod ces lab nas dal cag ger 'dug don gtan nas med/ nga tshor yod pa'i rin bral gyi nor bu nga tshos bkol spyod byed mi shes shing mdor na bdag gis gong du smras pa dag kyang kha bshad tsam du zad pas der rtog zhib bya rgyu dang lag len bya rgyu ni gnad dam pa yin/gnyis pa/ ed rtse'i nad bshad pa/ed ci'i nad(7kro) ni myodug srin 'gos khyab byung nas dus rim 152

st+waṃ0(smo010sprusnga 0sa 116khu(mis likhuzu101sakhutha ma'i dus la zer zhing / nad gzhi 'di byung tshe lus kyi sngon 'gog gi cha rnams med par gyur 'gro bas sngon 'gog bral ba'i 'dus nad(894ngakhuzu 1krogra goskurdu(101ḍūsgosmo snyekho 0smre) ces pa'i bsdus ming yin/ bdag gis de ring 'dir ed ci'i nad kyi rgyu rtags sogs 'bri don ni nye ba'i lo shas yun go la zlum po'i steng na 'tsho bzhugs byed mkhan gyi 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho gnas la thugs khur mdzad mkhan gyi tshan rig pa gang mang zhig gis ma 'ongs par sa'i go la'i steng gi mi'i rigs med par bzo mkhan ni ed ci'i nad dam rdul phran mtshon cha/ dug rdzas tha mag sa'i go la'i drod tshad je mthor song ba bcas bzhi las sna gcig yin pa thag gis chod ces gsungs bzhin pa dang / spyi lo1997lor krung go'i hi nan sa khul gyi grong gseb zhig nas khrag btsong mkhan mi lnga brgyar ed ci'i nad yod med zhib brtag byas rjes/ de dag las mi154la ed ci'i nad 'gos 'dug pas/ tshad gzhi 'dir gzhal na nye sngon 'gos nad rigs nyung ba'i gser gyi sa gzhi chen mo zhes pa'i krung go'i sa khul kha shas su'ang ed ci'i nad gzhi byung tshad ha cang mthon por 'dug de ni bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed kyi skabs 'dir phyi mi nang du 'ongs shing nang mi phyir 'gro mkhan mang ba dang / smad 'tshong gi don gnyer mkhan yang je mang du song 'dug pa sogs kyi rkyen pas gso bcos kyi khrod na stong char lus pa'i ed ci'i nad kyang dar zhing mched par gyur zhing 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi tshe srog la myur par dpung 'jug byed mkhan gyi gshed ma drag po 'di nga tsho'i gam du'ang slebs 'dug pas/ nad gzhi 153

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska'adi thog mar 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen dang nad kyi rtags rnams cung 'god par byas na skye 'gro gang mang zhig la phan par snyam nas bris pa lags/1 nad gzhi 'di 'byung pa'i rgyu rkyen sogs bshad pa/ yidug srin ni hphe gling sa khul tu yod pa'i spre'u rigs kyi lus steng na lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu zhig yin zhing / srin bu de ma 'khrugs pa'i skabs srin bu gzhan dang 'dra bar zas 'ju ba dang mdangs skyed pa'i grogs byed/ hphe gling sa khul 'di nas spra rigs dang mi gnyis 'thab 'dzing yang mang du byed pas mi'i lus kyi rma steng sogs su spra khrag 'gos pa dang chab cigagayidug srin 'gos par gyur/ yang na spra dang mi gnyis 'khrig pa spyad pas 'gos par yang bshad/ mi'i lus steng nas phan tshun 'gos khyab tu 'gro sa'i rgyu lam gtso bo ni myodug srin 'gos 'dug pa'i nad can mi'i mchil ma dang khu ba/ mig chu/ nu zho/ zla mtshan dkar dmar/ rngul chu bcas yin/'gos khyab 'gro sa'i rgyu lam 'di dag las 'khrig sbyor byas nas 'go bzhin pa ni70 phroyan zin/ zungs khrag blugs pa sogs khrag gi steng nas17 lkoyan zin/ gzhan khong gnas kyi phru gur 'gos pa'am dus rdzas 'then mkhan gyis phan tshun gcig nas gcig tu bgos pa sogs10phrotsam zin/2 nad gzhi 'di'i spyi bye brag gi nad rtags sogs bshad pa/ spyi rtags ni lus kyi rmen bu rnams cher rgyas shing lus la tsha rgyas pa/ dus yun thung ngu'i nang lus stobs bri zhing grod pa 'khru/ ed ci'i nad byung mang ba'i yul khams shig nas gal te dus yun thung ngu'i nang rgyu rkyen gsal bo med par 154

sa0rdusmo010spru| 00 116khurdu3sa 7khuzu1khu1sardulus kyi ljid tshad kyi10phroyan je nyung la song ba dang / grod pa 'khru nas zla gcig yan song ba/ lus la tsha rgyas nas zla gcig yan song ba bcas gsum las sna gnyis tsam 'dzoms tshe zungs khrag tu myodug srin yod med zhib brtag byed dgos/bye brag gi rtags las/ nad gzhi 'di phog nas dus rim dang po'i skabs ni 7dug srin 'gos nas gza' 'khor2nas6bar yin zhing /skabs 'dir lus rngul mang zhing sgyid pa skyur ba/ mgo bo dang mid pa na ba/skyug med langs shing kha zas la yi ga med pa/ grod pa 'khru zhing yan lag gi tshigs mtshams dang sha gnad rnams na/ lus kyi men bu che gras khag skrangs pa/ pags steng du sib 'brum ltar 'brum pas g.yog pa/ nyin shas song rjes gong gi nad rtags rnams ye nas med 'gro/ dus rim gnyis pa'i skabs ni myodus srin 'gos nas lo2nas 10bar yin zhing / skabs 'dir zungs khrag tu brtag tshe 7dug srin yod pa las na zug dang nad rtags ci yang med/ dus rim gsum pa'i skabs ni sne sa khud kyi rmen bu gnyis ka ma gtogs lus kyi rmen bu che gras rnams cha re byas nas skrangs shing cung mkhregs por gyur ba dang der gnon zug ye nas med/ men bu de rnams phan tshun 'gul skyod che/ de ltar byas nas zla gsum nas lo gcig tsam song rjes men bu rnams kyi skrangs pa zhi 'gro zhing / de nas cung 'gor rjes slar yang sngon ltar rmen bu rnams cher rgyas shing kha cig skran du gyur 'gro/dus rim bzhi ba'i skabs ni lus la tsha rgyas shing lus rngul mang ba dang 155

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed sto gces btus 'a dgyes pa'i zla zeskasgyid pa skyur ba/ lus stobs bri ba/ rgyu rkyen gsal bo med par grod pa yang yang 'khru zhing sna khrag dang mngal khrag sogs lus kyi gang rung nas khrag mang don pa/ mchin mcher dang rmen bu rnams cher rgyas pa/ dus mi 'gyangs par shi 'gro ba bcas so// nad gzhi 'dir phyi nang gi bod lugs gso byed pa tshos lhan skyes srin bu 'khrugs pa'i nad ces brjod bzhin par blo zhib mos bsam gzhig re btang tshe de ni cung 'os 'tsham gyi gtam zhig min par snyam/ ci'i phyir zhe na5yidug srin ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs skyes ma thag nas lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin bu zhig min par reg dug ltar gcig nas gcig la 'gos khyab tu 'gro ba'i nad cig yin pas na'o// kha cig gis nad gzhi 'di ma 'khrugs pa'i skabs su lhan skyes kyi srin bu de bag tu nyal nas bsdad yod cing skabs der 'phrul chas kyis rtogs mi thub ces brjod na/ spra rigs kyi lus steng naṣṭhayidug srin lhan skyes su yod cing de 'phrul chas kyis brtag thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ yang kha cig gis spra dang mi'i lus mi mtshungs pas spra rigs kyi lus steng nas mthong yang mi'i lus steng nas mthong thub pa'i nges pa med ces brjod na/ 'grim 'grul stabs bde ba'i skabs 'dir nad gzhi 'di hphe gling sa khul nas rim bzhin yul phyogs gzhan la 'gos khyab tu 'ongs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci dang hphe gling sa khul ma yin pa'i yul khams gzhan du dus da lta'i yun ma byung ba'i gsar dar gyi nad cig min par gna' snga mo nas nad gzhi 'di yod dgos pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig gis 'gos khyab tu 'ongs pa'i myoreg dug gi srin bu 'dis rgyu byas 156

st+waṃgordusmo01sgrospru| 0ba 116dzi(mi0 7khuskye1dzu1godzinas lus la lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu gzhan rnams kyang 'khrugs par gyur bas ming du de ltar brjod pa yin zhe na/ cham rims shig phog na lhan skyes kyi srin bu rnams 'khrugs bzhin pa dang mda' rdo sogs kyis brgyab nas lus la rma bzos tshe lhan skyes kyi srin bu rnams 'khrugs bzhin par ma zad/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'am nad kyi rigs su gyur ba'i nad rnams kun yang thog ma nyid nas lhan skyes su yod pa'i srin bu rnams rang gnas nas log lam du ma zhugs pa dang / rang gi ldang tshad las ma nyung zhing ma brgal ba/ rang gis bsgrub dgos pa'i bya ba rnams bsgrub cing srin bu de dag gi rten gzhi lus su phyi rkyen brdab mtshon sogs kyis ma gtses pa'i skabs ni nad med tha mal gyi skabs yin pas nad kyi rigs su gyur ba kun la'ang lhan skyes kyi srin bu 'khrugs bzhin pa sha stag tu snang / de na ed ci'i nad la lhan skyes srin bu 'khrugs pa'i nad ces brjod tshe phyogs gcig nas 5reg dug gi srin bu de lhan skyes srin bu zhig min pas mi 'tsham pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas ed ci'i nad la nad ces ming btags pa las gnyis su med par ma zad/ tha na tsha grang gang gi khongs gtogs yin pa'ang mi shes pa'i gnas shig tu gyur 'dug pas mi 'tsham mo// bdag gi bsam gzhigs su nad gzhi 'di reg dug gi nad cig tu ngos bzung na legs snyam/de yang nad gzhi 'di gcig nas gcig tu 'gos shing mched pa'i brgyud rim yang reg dug ltar pho mo gnyis kyi sbyor ba'am pho yis pho dang / mo yis mor log g.yem byed par brten 'gos khyab tu 'gro/ spyir rgyud du gsungs 157

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad sto gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskapa'i reg dug ni bse mog reg dug gtso bor bzung nas gsungs shing /bse mog reg dug gi rgyu ni bse shing la dkar nag gnyis yod pa las bse dmar ram bse nag ces pa'i shing de la dug yod pa de yin zhing / rkyen ni gna' dus rgya bal mon yul sogs su ches dar zhing dug de lus kyi phyi nang gang du reg na skrangs par bshad kyang deng dus tshong 'dus sogs mi tshogs 'du long che ba'i yul tu dug rigs de mtshan mar 'gos pa'i pho mos 'dod pa spyad pas gcig nas gcig la mched par gyur ba'i nad cig yin pa ni/zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes mdzad pa'i man ngag bye ba ring bsrel gyi bse mog gi bcos ma hū gru ṇa'i zhal gdams las/ rgyu ni reg dug las byung bas// pho mo 'du 'phrod spyad pa'i dus// skye bo mi srun tshogs rnams kyis//ngan sems rdzas sbyor byas nas byung // dang po mtshan ma g.yas g.yon la//'brum bu dmar po mgo dkar 'byung // grangs med chu ser 'dzag pa yin//za 'phrug zug gzer skra smin 'byi// rma ni byi bas zos pa 'dra// chu ser wu can rgyun du bab// rtsa ni 'thing zhing gting na grims// pho la byung na mo la 'phros// pho mos sbyor ba byas na 'gos// mo la byung na de bzhin no// zhes dang / man ngag lhan thabs las/ ngo bo se shing dug las gyur ba ste// rgya gar bal mon yul du ches dar zhing // gang reg skrangs par bshad kyang deng dus su// tshong 'dus 'du long yul du pho mo yis// 'dod spyod mtshan ma reg nas mched pa mang zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nad gzhi de gna' nas dar khyab che ba zhig yin 'dug 158

st+waṃ0spyosmo010poshā 0sa 116khu('i0 7dzizu1dzu1bakhuthengs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i myoreg dug ni gna' snga mo nas dar khyab byung ba zhig min zhing / nad 'di'i rgyu yang bse nag nas thon pa min la/ gong smras ltar spra'i lus steng gi yidug srin mi'i lus la 'gos pa'i nad cig yin/ 'on kyang nad gzhi 'di phog pa'i brgyud rim sogs reg dug gi brgyud rim dang ches mtshungs pas/ yireg dug ni reg dug gi nang gses shig tu dbye na 'os 'tsham yin pa las bse mog reg dug tu thad kar ngos bzung na mi 'grig3 nye sngon gso bcos las 'das pa'i nad gzhi 'di'i bcos thabs skor gyi bsam gzhigs tsam 'god pa/ gso bcos kyi khrod na stong char lus pa'i ed ci'i nad la spyi lo 2002lo'i zla dang po'i tshes nyer gcig dang nyer gnyis kyi dgong mo'i gsar 'gyur mnyam sgrog nas a ru'i tshan rig pas myodug srin la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'gog rdzas shig gsar du rnyed 'dug cing / 'gog rdzas de khab tu bzos nas myodug srin 'gos 'dug pa'i gso bya'i lug gzhug tu brgyab na phan 'bras chen po 'dug ces 'chad bzhin pas/ de ni myoreg dug nad kyis mnar ba'i gso bya dang nad gzhi 'dir 'thab 'dzing byed mkhan gyi gso byed pa tshor mtshon na rma byas 'brug skad thos pa lta bu'i gtam snyan zhig yin par ma zad/ gong gi stong cha de yang zab thub rgyu'i re 'dun gyi gom pa dang po yin/ spyir nad gzhi mtha' dag gi bcos thabs su rang re'i bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs pa ltar na 〈dpal ldan rgyud bzhi〉 las/ thabs dang thabs byung 'brel ba ci ste 159

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskamed// 'gro ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub// gso bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed// gnyen po'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo nyid//lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel// zhes gsungs pa ltar gang gso bar bya ba'i yul 'gro ba'i lus 'di ni 'byung ba bzhi'am lnga las grub cing / gso bya'i nad kyang de bzhin 'byung ba bzhi'am lnga yis bskyed la/gnyen po'i sman yang 'byung ba bzhi'am lnga'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir na lus dang nad dang gnyen po gsum ni 'byung ba bzhi'am lnga'i ngo bor bdag nyid gcig par 'brel bas nad gzhi 'dir yang bcos pa'i thabs med pa mi srid/ der brten spyi lo2002lo'i zla11pa'i tshes nyer gsum gyi dgongs mo'i gsar 'gyur mnyam sgrog nas nye lam si tan(lo9)nas 5reg dug gi dug srin gsod thub pa'i sngo sman zhig rnyed 'dug cing / sngo sman 'di hphe gling gi yul lung kun na skyes 'dug thog mar sman pa tshosargumyoreg dug 'gos yod pa'i gso bya gsum la sngo sman 'di zla gsum rer bsten du bcug pas gso bya de dag gi lus kyi 7dug srin gyi drug cha'i lnga bsad 'dug 'on kyang sngo sman 'di nad thog lag len gyi steng bkol spyod byed par dus nges can zhig dgos ces bshad pas so//mjug mthar 〈dpal ldan rgyud bzhi〉 las/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhin// rgyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil gnon// zhes pa ltar bod lugs gso rig gi dgongs pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas shing dar bar gyur cig160

st+waṃgordu'i010spru| 0ba 116dzi(mib ⑪dzi61khu1zhwakhubod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyi byung 'phel dang de'i khyad chos tsam brjod pa log smra'i smra sgo gcod byed seng ge'i nga ro/kha cig gis bod rgyal so gsum pa srong btsan sgam po'i sngon bod la yi ge med pas dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyud tsam las gso rig gi rkang chen po chags mi thub pa dang / thon mi a nu'i bus yi ge mdzad rjes snga rjes su rgya nag gi sman rtsis gzhung gang mang bod du bsgyur nas bod lugs gso rig gi gzhi rtsa byas pa red zer ba'am bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyang rgya nag gso rig gi rtsa brtag rig par gzhi bcol nas bsgyur gnang mdzad pa red 'dug zer/ lhag par du sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo'am so ma rā dza ni rgya nag gi sman gzhung zhig yin zhing / ljags rtsom de'i nang du rtsa brtag thabs kyi don lnga'i rig gzhung gsungs lngod pa phud/ da dung grang tsha'i rtags dang rtsa'i 'phar tshul/ rtsa brtag pa'i dus dang gnas bcas gleng nas tshon dang /kan/ chag bcas rtsa brtag thabs gsum dang / mthun dang 'dril/g.yeng / grangs/ 'khyig zhan/ bying / zhar sogs rtsa rtags kyang bton nas gsal 'byed byas yod/ nang don 'di tshang ma krung dbyi 〈khong nad 161

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskarig pa〉 dang / (dka' mdo〉 / (rtsa mdo〉 bcas kyi thog nas blo sgo phye nas shes rtogs byung ba yin pa gsal zhes dang / bod lugs gso rig las rtsa blta skabs sman pa'i mdzub mo dang gung mo/ srin lag gsum la tshon kan chag gsum zer ba'ang krung lugs kyi nad pa'i blta gnas tshun dang / kan/khri gsum gyi sgra gdangs dang ches nye bas bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs ni krung dbyi nas thon pa mtshon zer/ya mtshan skyes dgos pa zhig ni lung dang rigs pa ci yang med par ra ro ba'i smyo gtam bzhin pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal rabs ma btsugs gong du'ang krung dbyi ni bod du dar khyab chen po byung yod zer bzhin pa'i gtam brjod gang mang zhig 'dug par/ lan rer ltos na lo gsum byis pa'i 'chal gtam las ma 'das pas dgod spro ba'i snang ba re thon mod/ blo zhib mos bsam gzhigs re btang tshe smyo lab mkhan de tshor 'os 'tsham gyi rgol lan re ma ster tshe/ nga tsho'i dwangs gtsang gi gso rig bzhin ras su 'dam bag g.yos pa dang gnyis su med pas/ bdag gis lung dang rigs par gzhi bcol nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i snga rol bod du dbyibs gzugs yi ge dang zhang zhung gi yig rgan sog/sa yod pa'i skor dang / yi ge der brten nas bod rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i gso dpyad kyi bstan bcos sogs mang du thon pa'i skor/ bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa'i nying bcud rgya nag sogs yul khams gzhan du dar tshul/ sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo dang de'i mdzad pa po sogs kyi skor/ rtsa brtag thabs ni bod rang gi blo 162

sab(smo0102snga 0spu 116dzi(mi0 krodzi61khu10khugros kyi rtsal kho na las 'khrungs pa'i skor/ bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos skor/ mjug bsdu ba bcas sa bcad chen po bdun du dbye nas bkod par bya'o//dang po/ chos rgyal spong btsan sgam po'i snga rol bod la dbyibs gzugs yi ge dang zhang zhung gi yig rgan sogs yod pa'i skor bshad pa/spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs rgyud kyi thog ma ji ltar byung ba'i thad la mi rigs la las lha'i dbang bos bskrun pa dang yang na 'jim bzos kyi mi las mched pa yin zer ba sogs bshad tshul sna min re 'dug cing / rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i blta ba khyab brdal du song rjes/ mi'i thog ma ni gna' bo'i spra mi las rim bzhin du 'gyur yong ba'i bshad tshul de 'thad ldan du bzung /rang re'i bod pa rnams kyis nga tsho'i mes po ni spre'u las 'gyur yong ba yin zhes dus snga mo nas ngos zin thob yod par ma zad/ bod rang sa rtsed thang nas byung ba'i rnam dkar gzhan phan gyi las la brtson zhing blo rig gi gshog rtsal rgyas pa'i pha spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin 'dus pa las bod mi bu gdong drug gi rus rgyud 'phel zhing rgyas pa sogs deb ther dang chos 'byung rnams su gsal por bkod yod/ de na nga tsho'i bod mi'i thog ma ni dus nam zhig la byung zer na/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i deb ther sngon po las/ bod kyi yul 'di yang rgya gar dang 'dra bar/ yul 163

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang mi la sogs pa gnas pa'i bskal ba nas byung bar byas na lung dang rigs pa'i gnod pa med ces gsungs 'dug pas gsal la/ bod ljongs gso rig slob chen gyi dge rgan chen mo sman rams pa bsam gtan gyi gsung rtsom du 'dzam gling gi 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi mes po ni bod ljongs sa mtho nas yin 'dug ces pa'i gtam zhig mchis pa bcas la dpyad na nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di rgya gar nag li yul sogs kyi snga rol tu chags pa'am yang na dus mnyam du chags pa las de dag gi rjes su chags pa'am mi rigs gzhan zhig nas 'gyur 'ongs pa'i mi rigs shig min pa sha stag tu snang /de na gdod ma nas yul 'dir gzhis sdod byed mkhan gyi nga tsho'i mi rigs 'dir dus nam zhig nas yi ge byung ba yin zhe na/ nye lam nga tshos spyod bzhin pa'i yi ge 'di chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring thon mi a nu'i bu rgya gar du phyin nas rgya gar gyi yi ger dper byas nas bzos pa yin pa ni/deb dkar las gang ltar yang thu mi de rgya gar na gubha'i rgyal rgyud dag gis srid skyong ba'i skabs su byon pa yin zhing / shin tu ngo mtshar ba ni/ thu mi dang dus mnyam pa'i rgya gar gyi rgyal po har dang / ku ma ra kubha(gzhon nu sbas pa)dang surya wa rman(nyi ma'i go cha)sogs kyi dus su byung ba'i zangs kyi glegs bu la sogs pa da lta'i bar rgya gar gyi yul so sor yod pa dag la/ yi ge bkod pa rnams bod yig dang ha cang 'dra che zhing / cung zad rgyang nas bltas tshe lag mi mkhas pa zhig gis bod yig bris sam snyam pa 'char yig 'bru phal cher ma bslab kyang thor re ba zhig klog thub par 'dug ces pas 164

st+waṃbardusmo010spru〉 00 116khurdumi0 krodzizu1dzu1bakhugasal mod/ bdag gis 'di ltar 'bri don ni nye lam mi re gnyis kyis nga tshos spyod bzhin pa'i yi ge 'di thon mis gsar gtod mdzad pa min zer ba'am mi gcig thog mar rgyus med kyi yul du phyin nas skad rigs mi 'dra ba'i khrod nas yi ge sbyangs shing de nas der gzhi byas nas rang gi yul skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge bzo dgos pa sogs gtan nas 'grub thabs mi 'dug zer ba'i gtam sna tshogs shig 'dug pas yin/ spyir thon mi ni 'jam dpal gyi sprul ba yin pas blo rig gi dpyad 'bras gang zag phal ba kho tsho'i blo dang bsdur nas bshad par tshad mar 'dzin rgyu'i 'bras bu spu tsam yang med mod/ skye ba snga phyi'i 'brel ba sogs khas mi len pa'i dbang du btang na go la zlum po'i steng 'dir glog dang rdul phab mtshon na/ glog klad bcas kyang mi re gnyis kyis gsar gtod mdzad pas kho tsho'i grub 'bras de dag la sngon nas da lta'i bar kho tsho'i grub 'bras ma red zer mkhan mi 'dug pas/ log smra mkhan khyod tsho'i blo rig dang bsdur na gnam sa'i khyad par che bas 'di lta bu'i grub 'bras la khyod tshos ci lta bu'i sdom tshig re 'jog rgyu/gal te khyod tshos kho tsho'i grub 'bras de dag khas len srid tshe 'dzam gling yul gru gzhan du sngon med gsar gtod mkhan gyi skye bo byung srid chog na nga tsho'i bod pa'i yul khams nas byung mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/'on kyang yul kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir mkhas mchog thon mis yi ge 'di gsar gtod ma mdzad pa'i sngon rol tu da lta'i yi ge 'dir bris gzugs sogs phyogs gang thad nas 'brel ba med pa'i zhang zhung gi yig 165

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskargan dang 'jang gi dbyibs gzugs yi ge dar yod/ zhang zhung gi yig rgan 'di bgrang bya sum stong dgu brgya lhag gi sngon bod rang sa nas 'khrungs pa'i ston pa gshen rab mi bo che yis stag gzig gi spungs yig bya bar ltos nas zhang zhung gi yig rgan bzos/ de smar brag tu bsgyur/ yig gzugs 'dir brten nas ston pa gshen rabs kyi bka' bsdu ba bo rnams kyis khong gi gsung rnams yi ger bkod/ skabs 'dir nga tshos bsam gzhig gtong dgos pa zhig ni bod la sngon yi ge yod bzhin du srong btsan sgam pos bod la yi ge med zer don ci zhe na/ bod ces pa'i mi rigs 'di yang rje gnya' khri btsan pos thog mar dbang bsgyur gnang sa'i bod kha nya drug gam bod kha g.yag drug ces pa'i rgyal phran nas tsho ba chen po de'i ming gi thog ma pur rgyal bod kyi btsan po rim byon gyi mnga' 'og tu 'dus pa'i bod mi rigs spyi'i ming du thog pa ni tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha'i 〈rgyal rabs rim byung gi ming〉 zhes bya ba'i le'ur/ 'o lde spu rgyal te gnya' khris rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis dbang du bsdus rjes bod ka g.yag drug gi rjer gshegs so zhes dang / rgyal po bka'i thang yig tu'ang de nas ma sangs spun dgus dbang byas te:yul ming bod khams g.yu drug bya bar btags:zhes pas gsal zhing / srong btsan sgam po'i sku che'i stod la khong gi chab 'og tu bar dbus gtsang las stod mnga' ris ste zhang zhung gi yul dang smad mdo khams kyi sum bha dang 'a zha sogs tshud med pas bod ces pa skabs der bar dbus gtsang gi yul du go dgos pa dang gcig rus rgyud 166

sab(smo010sprukau 0sa 116dzi(tshis krokhuskye1dzu1sakhudang yul skad gcig pa'i zhang zhung gi yig rgan la bkol spyod mi bde ba'i skyon cha sogs ldan pa dang gnyis kyi sgo nas khong gis de ltar gsungs pa yin/khong gi sku tshe'i bar stod tsam du zhang zhung sogs mnga' 'og tu bsdus tshul ni dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i deb ther dkar po las/de'i 'og tu (rtseng sku'i bya)myang mang po rje zhang snang gis/ sum pa mtha' dag dmag byed ma dgos par sgyu'i sgo nas/ khyim grangs ma shor bar 'bangs rnal mar bgug go/ de'i 'og tu btsan po zhabs kyis btsugs te/ dmag ma byung ma drangs par/ rgya dang a zha dpya' bcad do zhes dang / yang de las rgyal bo 'di'i ring la/ zhang zhung lta bu gnyen mdzad nas kyang btul lo// thabs kyis kyang rgal te/ zhang zhung bdag mdzad du/ (rgyal po'i sring mo)btsan mo sad ma kar lig mi rgya la chab srid la gshegs so//('di bag mar btang ba yin 'dug cing lig mi rgya ni zhang zhung gi rgyal bor mngon)zhes pas gsal/gzhan ston pa gshen rabs kyi sngon rol tu'ang nga tsho'i bod yul 'dir 'jang gi dbyibs gzugs yi ge dar zhing dus da lta'i bar 'jang yul tu dbyibs gzugs yi ge de bkol spyod byed bzhin 'dug 'jang gi dbyibs gzugs yi ge 'di rgya nag gi rus brkos dbyibs gzugs yi ge las kyang snga bar byung ba sha stag 'dug ces brjod na mi chog pa med par snang / de ni 'jang yul la da lta na zhis mi rigaskalko.ayoṣā)su 'bod cing / 'jang zhes pa'i ming 'di yang deb dkar las/ bod kyi yul de rgya'i rgyal sa cang ngan 167

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskanas le bar stong brgyad kyi sa na yod/ yul de la sngon hān gyi gong ma dag gi dus su nub kyi 'jang zhes 'bod ces par gzhigs na 'jang yul ni bod kyi khongs nas yin pa shes shing der na zhis mi rigs zer don yang bon por rgyu'i bon bzhi dang 'bras bu'i bon lnga bcas dgu yod pa las snang gshen zhes pa'i sgra zur chags pa yin par snang / yul 'dir ston pa gshen rabs kyi g.yung drung bon kyi lta ba dar khyab che zhing yul 'di'i rig gnas kyi cha shas su'ang gyur 'dug pas der deng sang ston pa'i rig gnas zhes skad grags kyang chen po 'dug yul 'di'i yul mi cho༅re chos lugs kyi cho ga'i khrod du g.yung drung bon gyi lta ba las gzhan pa'i brdol bon gyi dmar mchod rigs kyang mang bas yul 'di'i shes rig kyang ston pa gshen rabs kyi sngon rol nas dar ba gdon mi za/ de bzhin yul 'dir spyod bzhin pa'i dbyibs gzugs yi ge yang gna' snga mo nas yod 'dug zer na shin tu 'os 'tsham gyi gtam zhig tu snang ngo //gnyis pa/ zhang zhung gi yig rgan dang 'jang gi dbyibs gzugs yi ger brten nas bod rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i gso dpyad kyi bstan bcos sogs mang du thon pa'i skor bshad pa/de yang thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i thu'u bkwan grub mtha' las/ bod yul mun par dam chos nyi ma'i 'od// 'char ba'i lam 168

st+waṃb(smo010sprukau 0so rwa16khurdumi0 7dzizu1khukrokhuyangs 'cha' bar gshen lugs kyi// skya rengs pho nya sngon du 'ongs pa dang //bon zhes grags pa'i grub mtha'i byung ba gleng zhes gsungs pa ltar mnga' ris zhang zhung yul ni bod gdod ma'i chos lugs dang shes rig gi 'byung khungs yin la/ bgrang bya sum stong dgu brgya lhag gi sngon rol tu 'khrungs pa'i ston pa gshen rabs kyis sngar yod brdol bon gyi bstan pa rnams cham la phab ste g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa gsar gtod byas shing / bod yul stod smad bar gsum na khyab pa'i shes rig gi nying bcud rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas khong gis bka' bsdu ba bo rnams la yi ger bkod du bcug gso rig gi phyogs la mtshon na khong gi bka' bsdu ba bo dpyad bu khri shes yin la/ dpyad bu khri shes sogs kyis bsdus pa'i gso rig 'bum bzhi yang da lta si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis lcags par du btab 'dug pa dang / gzhung 'di'i zhu ba bo dang gsungs pa po tsam gyi khyad par las brjod bya'i nang don dang tshig gi sdeb sbyor sogs90phroyan dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang 'dra bas/ bdag gi bsam gzhig tu sngar yod 'bum bzhi'i steng dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i legs chas kha snon mdzad nas grub pa yin 'dugader ni bon la bsgyur bon zhes pa zhig kyang mchis shing / bsgyur bon de gsum las tha mar bsgyur ba ni glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes bon rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' mang po bon tu bsgyur te/ yum rgyas pa la kham chen dang / nyi shu rtsa lnga ba la kham chung zhes ming btags pas 'bum bzhi 'di de ltar byas nas grub pa min mod/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i legs 169

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskachas zur brgyan pa sha stag tu snang / gal te ston pa gshen rabs kyi dus su byung ba'i glegs bam ngo bo ma 'gyur ba zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na brda rnying rigs mang drag pas nga tshos 'don khag po 'dug de ni dus rabs brgyad pa dang dgu bar bris pa'i tun hong yi ger bltas tshe mang che ba'i ha legs por go mi thub pas kyang gsal/ gzhan si khron du glog par btab pa'i bon po'i bka' bstan du dpyad 'bum dkar khra gsum sogs 'dugagong gzhung de dag ston pa gshen rabs kyi skabs su zhang zhung gi yig rgan gyi gzugs su bkod nas gtan du dbab cing / rjes nas thon mis mdzad pa'i yi ge 'di'i gzugs su bkod par snang / ston pa gshen rabs kyis sngar yod 'jang yig tu bkod pa'i legs cha'i rigs rnams tshur bsdu dang zhan cha'i rigs rnams rgyang du dor zhor rang nyid kyis gsal rtogs thob rigs dang dmangs khrod kyi shes rig gi nying bcud bcas gsog 'jog byas nas g.yung drung bon gyi lta ba dar bar bsam/gsum pa/ bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa'i nying bcud rgya nag sogs yul khams gzhan du dar tshul gyi skor bshad pa/shar rdza bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i legs bshad rin po che'i gter mdzod las/ stag gzig 'ol mo'i gling nas rgya gar dang rgya nag dang zhang zhung du dar la/ de gsum nas bod yul du dar zhes zhang zhung shes rig yul gru gzhan du dar tshul legs par gsungs/ ji ltar dar zhing dar 170

sa0(smo010spru| 00 116khurdu'igo krokhuzu101sarduba'i dus sogs ni gzhung de las/ 'ol mo'i gling du ston pas gsungs pa'i bka' rnams dang / bsgrags pa gsum gyi bon sde zab mo rnams rang rang gi yul du drangs nas so sor skad du bsgyur nas dar bar mdzad do// lo tsā ba drug ni/ mdo 'dus dang rtsa rgyud nyi sgron mthun par/ gdung sob mu chos shes pa'i rgyud sbyangs shing / mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa'i lo tsā ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs dang ldan pa stag gzig gi lo tsā ba dmu rtsa tra he pe/ zhang zhung la khri thog spa tsa/ sum pa la gu hu lo spar legs/ rgya gar la lha bdag sngags dro/ rgya nag la legs tang smang po/ phrom la gser thog lce 'byams dang drug go zhes bsgyur ba bo'i mtshan yang legs par bkod/ lhag par ston pa sangs rgyas gshen rabs mi bos kong tse 'phrul rgyal gyi tsha bo 'phrul bu chung la gab tse sum brgya drug cur bstan pa rnams ma 'ongs par rgya nag gi yul du dar bar 'gyur ba lung bstan pa ni/ dri med las/ khrus bdag sbang la gnam gshed khyod// 'di nas 'dzam gling shar phyogs kyi// ga cu rgya yi rgyal sa ru// cu tse 'phrul gyi rgyal por 'khrungs// bdud rgyal 'khor bas bsgyur ba yi// mi mthun log pa'i rtsis sbyor la// gtsug lag 'khrul gyi gab rtse bsgyur zhes gsungs 'dug par gzhigs na zhang zhung yul du sngon rtsis kyi ma lag cha tshang ba zhig dar yod pa ma zad/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab rgya nag yul du'ang de dar yod pa mtshon/ sme ba spar kha'i gling skor rgya nag nas bod du dar ba yin zer mkhan rgya bod mkhas pa mang mod/ bod gdod ma'i rtsis rig las snang mthong rtsis kyi skor du gab rtse 'phrul gyi me long dang /171

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaspar kha sme ba'i gling skor/ 'byung ba dus kyi 'khor lo/ ju zhag rten 'brel las rtsis bcas bzhi 'dug pa sogs zhang bod gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus las gsal bas der gzhigs na thog mar nga tsho'i cha tshang ba'i rtsis kyi ma lag rgya nag tu bsgyur zhing gnam ri srong btsan dang srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la de'i skor gyi cha shas tsam rgya nag nas bod du bsgyur bar bsam/ gzhan nga tsho'i yul khams 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar rjes de sngon bod rang sa nas dar ba'i gzhung rnams dma' 'bebs byed pa'i srol zhig chags yod pas sme ba spar kha'i gling skor zhang zhung gi gzhung nas thad kar bsgyur ba yin rung yul gzhan nas bsgyur ba yin zhes ma brjod tshe skabs de'i spyi tshogs steng dar khyab 'gro bar 'gog rkyen mang po yod pas yin/dper na/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi zhang zhung gso rig gzhi rtsar bzung zhing legs sbyar gso rig gi legs chas zur rgyan nas rje g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pos gsar rtsom gnang ba yin rung / rgyud bzhi bka' yin pa'i tshul tu gzhan la kha 'phangs te rtsom dgos pa'i gnad don yang der thug yod pa ma zad/ bod mi rang gis brtsams pa'i brtsams chos las rgya dkar nag gi gzhung la tshad mar 'dzin pa'i srol zhig kyang gnas 'dir rgyun 'byams su chags yod pas yin/gso rig gi skor nas bshad na skal bzang 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi gso rig byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus las/ da lta rgya nag gi gna' bo'i sman dpe nang bod kyi gur kum sogs las byung ba'i sman sna ci rigs shig gi 172

st+waṃs(smo010spru5 0sa rwa16rdu(mis krokhuzu1dzu1bakhuming bkod yod pa ma zad/ sga dang lcum rtsa sogs thog mar bod nas dar/gzhan yang thang rgyal rabs kyi dus su son su ma'o yis brtsams pa'i lha lcam zur sdeb ces par bod kyi lugs na zhes pa sogs bod sman gyi lta tshul kyang mang dag cig bkod 'dug pa'ang mchis zhes bkod 'dug par gzhigs na nga tsho'i gso rig gi shes bya rgya nag tu dar khyab chen po byung ba mtshon thub/sog yul du sman rtsis rig pa dar ba'i skor gzhung gzhan rnams su ha cang gsal bas 'dir bkod med do//bzhi ba/ sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo dang de'i mdzad pa po sogs kyi skor bshad pa/skabs 'dir sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo'i skor phran tsam zhig 'bri dgos don ni mi re gnyis kyis dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ni sman dpyad zla rgyal gzhi byas nas brtsams shing / zla rgyal ni rgya nag gi gzhung zhig yin 'dug par ma zad gzhung 'di'i nang gi rtsa brtag pa'i gnas dang dus dang brtag thabs bcas rgya nag gi gzhung 'ga'i dgongs don dang 'dra zhes dus deb sogs kyi steng 'khod 'dug pas yin/ kho tshos de ltar bshad don yang nye lam bris pa'i bod lugs gso rig lo rgyus kyi dpyad rtsom re gnyis su zur mkhar bas mdzad pa'i shes bya spyi'i khog dbubs las so ma rā dza ni klu sgrub dang 'jam dpal gyi gsungs ma yin te/ rgya nag gi sman pa mkhas pa zhig gis brtsams pa yin kyang 'gyur shin tu mi legs pas nongs zhes gsung 'dug ces log 173

bod lugs gso rig gi dargyad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagatam gyi long zhig bkod yod pa dang / gzhan gzhung 'di 'jam dpal gyi gsungs rgya nag tu bsgyur zhing de bod yig tu bsgyur ba yin zer ba'i srol zhig kyang rang cag bod na yod pas yin/ zur mkhar ba'i khog dbubs su gong ltar brjod med par der bkod pa'i tshig don dngos ni khri lde srong btsan mes ag tshoms kyi dus su sras 'jang tsha lha dpon gyi jo mo la rgya nag nas gyim shang kong jo blangs/ des rtsis dang sman dpyad mang po khyer ba de ha shang ma hā gyin da dang / rgya phrug gar mkhan dang / khyung po tse tse/ khyung po dam tshugs/ cog la smon 'bar zhes bya ba rnams kyis so ma rā dza le'u brgya bco lnga bas gtso byas mang du bsgyur zhes 'khod 'dug pa las/ gzhung de'i mdzad pa po sogs bkod med/spyir gzhung 'di'i mdzad pa po'i skor la rang re'i yul 'dir bzhed tshul sna tshogs shig mchis la/ dper na/ blon po bka'i thang yig tu klu sgrub kyis mdzad par gsungs shing / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog gis klu rgyal gab pa'am wang thes zhus te 'jam dpal gyis gsungs par bzhed/kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos mkhas mang bgros pa'i so ma rā dza zhes ha shang dang khyung po sogs mkhas pa mang po bgros nas gso dpyad gsar 'gyur rnams kyi don snying bor blangs pa so ma rā dza zhes pa'i gzhung chen brtsams zhes dang / chos skyong dpal bzang gi gso rig chos 'byung las stag gzig dang / rgya nag bal bo bcas kyis mnyam du brtsams zer ba sogs mang la/de na nga tshos gong gi brjod tshul rnams las gang zhig 'thad ldan du 'dzin 174

st+waṃbardusmo010spru| 0ba 116khurdumib krodzisku1dzu1pakhurgyu zhe na/ thog mar brjod gzhir gyur ba'i gzhung 'di'i mgo rting bar gsum du rgyus mnga' yod par byas nas rang gi lta tshul tsam 'god rgyu de yin/gzhung 'di'i nang du'ang bod lugs gso rig gi gzhi rtsar gyur ba'i rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gtso bor bzung nas gsungs shing / sman rdzas kyi skabs su ro drug po yang bod bzhin bkod yod par ma zad/ rgya nag gi gzhung du mthong dkon pa'i brtag thabs dang sman sbyor/ zas rigs mang po yod cing brjod gzhir gyur ba'i gzhung lugs kyi rtsa ba'ang krung lugs gso rig dang tha dad du snang bar gzhigs na gzhung 'di rgya nag nas min par ma zad/ 'jam dpal gyi gsungs rgya nag la bsgyur zhing de bod yig tu bsgyur zer bar bden don ye nas med/ gal te gzhung 'di sngon rgya nag tu bsgyur yod na rgya nag gi yi ger bkod yod pa'i gna' dpe so ma rā dza zhig nga tsho'i mig lam tu lhag rgyu med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ bdag gi bsam gzhigs su gzhung 'di mes ag tshoms kyi ring yul so so'i mkhas pa rnams kyis sngar yod bod lugs gso rig gzhi rtsar bzung nas kho tshos brtsams pa yin par bsam pa'am/ yang na byang chub kyi skye bu klu sgrub bam 'jam dpal gang rung zhig gis gdul bya bod kyi dgongs don du dmigs nas bod kyi yul bab dang gnam gshis sogs la bstun pa'i sgos/ sngar yod bod lugs gso rig gi rig pa'i gzhi rtsar gzhi bcol nas gsungs shing / dus phyis kyi mkhas pa tshos bod yig tu bsgyur ba'i gzhung zhig yin par bsam/175

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskalnga ba/ rtsa brtag thabs ni bod rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i skor bshad pa/gong smras ltar bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bod rang gi rtsal las 'khrungs pa'i gso dpyad kyi gzhung mang du dar yod/ reg pa rtsar brtag thabs kyis bod lugs gso rig gi brtag thabs rig pa'i khrod na med du mi rung ba'i go gnas nges can zhig bzung yod par ma zad/ bod lugs gso rig dang lhan du bod mi'i blo gros kyi rtsal las rim bzhin nar son pa zhig kyang yin/ de ni stag tshang lo tsā bas/ rtsa chu'i sgo nas nad ngos 'dzin pa ni/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na bshad pa med/ bod kyi sman pa byang chub sems dpas mdzad ces gsungs 'dug pas gsal mod/ sngon gyi lo rgyus mang che bar bod rgyal nyer bdun pa lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang bu dga' lha mdzes gnyis rgya gar shar nub dang li yul/bal bo rnams su phyin nas gso dpyad kyi bstan pa spel/ skabs shig de gnyis bod du phebs shing bod rgyal gyis bi byi dga' byed la lha lcam yid kyi rol cha btsun mor phul bas der sras dung gi thor cog can zhes bya ba 'khrungs/ sras de nar son pa na reg pa rtsa'i mdo sogs sman dpyad 'tsho ba'i mdo lnga ba dang 'grel bshad/ khog dbubs bcas lag len dang bcas pa gnang nas mkhas par gyur zhing dus de nas bod lugs gso rig gi dbu brnyes zer bas/ bod lugs gso rig gi thog ma'i 'byung khungs phyi yul nas dar yong bar gzhi bcol/ de ltar byed don ni rang re'i yul 176

las smo010posmo 00 116dzi(tshis 7rdu61khu10dzi'adir chos lugs kyi phyogs zhen chen po zhig gis yod tshad bon khungs nas mgo phyung ste rgya gar sogs bstan pa'i 'byung gnas la mgo khungs gtug pa'i srol zhig chags yod pas skabs der gso rig gi dbu brnyes zhes brjod pa yin la/ don ngo mas bshad na zur mkhar blo gros rgyal bos kyang lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la gso dpyad kyi dbu brnyes zer ba de'ang ma nges te/ bod la brten pa'i gso dpyad ji snyed cig yod ces gsungs pa ni blo gzi bor gnas pa'i gtam zhig go/ bod lugs gso rig gi snying bo gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di yang sngar yod 'bum bzhi sogs gzhir bzhag steng dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa sogs rgya gar gzhung 'gas zur brgyan nas grub pa yin mod/ rtsa'i brtag thabs la mtshon na de ltar ma yin par bod mi rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal las 'khrungs pa sha stag yin/ de ni dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa sogs su rtsa'i brtag thabs gsal bo med pas mtshon thub/mi re gnyis kyis bod kyi sman pa'i mdzub mo/ gung mo/ srin lag gsum gyi sor rtse'i mdun ngos la tshon kan chag zer ba'i sgra 'di rgya nag gi nad pa'i blta gnas tshun kan khri gsum gyi sgra gdangs dang ches mtshungs par ma zad/ krung lugs kyi 'byung lnga rig pa'ang rtsa'i brtag thabs su yod pa dang /blta dus sogs kyang mtshungs pas bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyi 'byung khungs krung lugs yin zer bzhin par bdag gis 'di lta bu'i lan zhig 'debs par 'dod ste/ dang po bod lugs sman pa'i blta byed 177

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskamadzub mo rnams dang krung lugs kyi nad pa'i blta gnas kyi sgra gdangs 'dra ba tsam las gcig khungs gcig tu bsdu bar bya na/ bod skad kyi pha ma gnyis kyi ming yang rgya nag gi pha ma gnyis kyi ming gi sgra gdangs dang ches 'dra bas bod skad kyi 'byung khungs rgya nag yin zer rgyu yin nam rgya nag skad kyi 'byung khungs bod skad yin zer rgyu/ gzhan bal bo rnams kyi skad du mig la mig sna la sne bo/ lag pa la lag sogs zer zhing / bod dang 'bar ma'i skad du'ang 'di 'dra'i 'dra mtshungs mang pas de rnams la ci lta bu'i lan zhig 'debs rgyu/ spyir tshon kan chag gsum ni bod gna' bo'i zhang zhung skad kyi mdzub gung srin gsum gyi mdun ngos ming yin pa nam mkha'i nor bu'i gsungs las gsal zhing / nga tsho'i mes po rnams kyis ming tshig 'di bkol nas gso bya'i nad pa'i nad ngos 'dzin bzhin pa'i skabs rgya nag gzhung du rtsa'i brtag thabs kyi gzhung zhig med/ de ni spyi lo'i dus rabs gsum par slebs skabs/ krung dbyi sman pa wang hru'u ho(rwa.oṃyolkekhu)yis brtsams pa'i rtsa mdo(lkoṇḍaṃrmyu)zer ba de krung lugs rtsa brtag rig pa'i khrod kyi phyogs bsdoms rang bzhin ldan pa'i phyag rtsom thog ma yin zhing /gso rig 'bum bzhi ni bgrang bya sum stong dgu brgya lhag gi sngon 'khrungs pa'i ston pa gshen rabs kyi skabs su khong gi bka' bsdu ba bo gshed bu khri shes sogs kyis bsdus nas grub pa gong smras ltar dang / 'bum bzhi'i rtsa mdo'i nang dzu tshon kan chag bcas bkod yod pas kyang gsal/ de na gzhung lugs 'di gnyis las rtsa'i brtag thabs ni bod lugs gso rig tu 178

st+waṃ0(smo0102| 00 116rdurdumis krorduzu1dzu1sakhudar snga zhing tshon kan chag gi ming 'di yang bod lugs gso rig gi khrod nas bkol spyod byed snga ba yin mod/ tshig gi sgra gdangs 'dra ba tsam gyis ngas rgya nag gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyi 'byung khungs bod lugs gso rig yin zhes gtan nas mi zer/ sgrub byed 'di tsam la brten nas gcig khungs gcig tu bsdu ba ni lo gsum byis pa'i gtam tsam las ma 'das pas yin/ gnyis pa rtsa mdo'i ma bu dgra grogs kyi skabs su shing me sa lcags chu lnga bkod par gzhi bcol nas bod kyi rtsa brtag thabs krung lugs red 'dug zer bar bden don khab rtse tsam yang ma mchis te/ spyir krung dbyi gzhung lugs kyi mgo rting bar gsum du gdags sribs dang 'byung lnga'i rig pa bkol 'dug kyang / shing me sa lcags chu bcas lnga bo gna' nas da lta'i bar bod lugs sman rtsis ma zad/ de ma yin pa'i khrod du'ang dar khyab chen po 'dug pa ste/ gong smras ltar krung dbyi rtsa brtag rig pa'i gzhung med pa'i ston pa gshen rabs kyi dus dang de'i sngon bcas su bod yul 'dir bsang mchod byed pa'i srol dar zhing / ri mtho sa nas gzhi bdag rnams la bsang mchod byed skabs rlung rta skyod pa'i srol yang dus de nas dar 'dug pa dang /rlung rta'i ngos kyi stag seng khyung 'brug rta bcas kyis gong gi 'byung ba de dag mtshon 'dug pa bon gzhung rnams su shin tu gsal/ gzhan rtsis rig pa'i khrod du'ang gong gi 'byung lnga ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin zhing /gshen rabs kyi lung ltar bod kyi rtsis rig pa rgya nag sogs su dar ba'ang sde tshan gong ma rnams su bkod zin pa ltar lags/ gsum pa/ rtsar brtag 179

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadus krung dbyi'i bstan bcos gong ma'i khong nad rig par (trulkoskerdzo3)gsungs pa'i dbugs grang mo ma 'gul ba (khra'ilko7) / dron mo ma shor ba (༅dalkoṣṭha) / khazas ma zos pa (ṇa/ṭwāṃndhalkokṣu) sogs dang dpal ldan rgyud bzhir gsungs pa'i nang dbugs dron mo phyir ma rgyus pa dang //phyi dbugs grang mo nang du ma shor ba// mal nas ma 'gul kha zas ma zos pa'i// gdags sribs dbugs snyoms rtsa mal gnas dus blta// zhes pa sogs 'dra mtshungs su 'dug pas kyang bod kyi rtsa'i brtag thabs krung lugs las thon zer ba dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i tshig gi go ba len ma thub pa'i skyon yin/ gong ma'i khong nad rig pa ru gsungs par gong ltar tshig gi ngo bo tsam las go ba len rgyu med mod/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhir gsungs pa'i gdabs sribs dbugs snyoms rtsa mal gnas dus blta zhes par tshig gi ngo bo'i go ba las gzhan krung lugs kyi gzhung du tshig gi zur tsam yang med pa'i bod lugs gsang sngags dang gso rig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos da bu rkyang ro gsum las tsha grang ngam ro rkyang gi phyogs su ma lhung ba'i dbu ma stobs su gyur ba'i dus der ngos 'dzin dgos/ mdor na krung dbyi dang bod lugs gso rig gnyis kyi rtsa brtag thabs ni bod lugs sngon la byung ba dang 'byung lnga rig pa'ang sngon bod du dar zhing de rgya nag la bsgyur/ rtsar brtag dus su'ang tshig 'dra yang rgya nag la gting zab kyi go ba len rgyu med pa bcas la gzhigs na/ bod kyi rtsa brtag thabs 'di rgya nag gzhung du phar dar khyab chen po byung ba ma zad krung dbyi gso rig sngar yod kyi rmang gzhi'i 180

st+waṃb('i0102snga 00 rwa16dzi(mi0 krokhuskye101sadzisteng 'thus sgo je tshang du btang par byas rjes chen po bzhag 'dugadrug pa/ bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa brtag thabs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos skor bshad pa/de yang dpal ldan rgyud bzhir rtsa'i brtag thabs 'di sa bcad chen po bcu gsum gyi sgo nas bstan yod cing / gso rig 'bum bzhir sa bcad chen po bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan yod pa'ang sa bcad kyi dbye srol tsam las brjod bya'i don 'dra mtshungs su chags 'dug nad pa dang sman pa'i bar na don ma nor bar phan tshun go brda sprod pa'i 'phrin ba'am pho nya ba dang 'dra ba'i rtsa brtag thabs 'di ni sman pa'i sor mo'i reg par brten nas gso bya'i nad pa'i lkog gyur gyi nad rnams shes par byed pa'i thabs shig yin pas/ brtag thabs kyi rig pa 'di gzhan lugs gso rig 'ga'i khrod na'ang mthong rgyu yod mod/ bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa'i brtag thabs su gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos mang du mchis/ de ni ju zhags lugasi kyi mdud pa dang nag rtsis lugs kyi gab rtse rde'u/ gzhan yang mo phywa pra sogs la ma ltos par nad med la rtsar ltos pas rang dang rang gi nye ring gi bya ba 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i legs nyes sogs nges shes 'drongs pa'i lung ston nus pa'i ngo mtshar rtsa bdun gyi brtag thabs dang / rtsa rgyud 'gyur ba dang don rnams kyi rtsa rgyud ma tshang bar 'phar ba/ rtsa rgyud lan rer mi 'phar bar sdod pa sogs la gzhigs nas 'chi byed nad kyi ngos 'dzin pa 181

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang 'chi ba'i dus sogs shes pa'i 'chi rtsar brtag pa/ rtsa rgyud g.yas g.yon stod smad don snod sogs mi snyoms shing 'gyur ldog mang ba dang /skabs su grangs nges med sdod 'then dang lcam dral tu 'ongs par gzhigs nas gdon gyi ngos 'dzin pa'i gdon rtsa brtag pa/ gru khud kyi a so'i 'og tsam nas gyes te mar zur chu rgyus kyi gseb tu rgyu ba'i rtsar brtag pas gso bya rang nyid kyi tshe'i ring thung dang gnyen nye'i nad gzhi'i lci yang ngam 'tsho 'chi'i kha dmar gdags pa dang / srung ma dang lha klu gnyan gsum gang gis gnod pa byed pa sogs brtag pa'i bla rtsar brtag pa bcas ni/ nye lam kun gyis cung mthong chen byed bzhin pa'i krung dbyi lta bur mtshon na de'i khrod na grib gzugs tsam yang mi 'dug gzhan mdzub mo'i 'og nas nad ngos ju 'dzin tshul yang krung lugs dang tha dad du 'dug pa sogs mang mod/ skabs bab gong tsam gyis chog par bya'o//bdun pa/ mjug bsdu ba/gong smras ltar bod lugs gso rig gi rtsa'i brtag thabs 'di bod rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa zhig yin yang / lan rer nga tsho'i bod khams 'dir grub mtha'i phyogs zhen gyis bod rang sa nas spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya dang bcu bdun tsam la 'khrungs pa'i bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po yang spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo nyis stong brgya tsam gyi dus su skya seng bu lnga dang sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thab pa na rgyal po ru ba ti zhes pa 'khor dang 182

sasardusmo010spru| 00 116khurdu2ba 7khuzu1dzu1bakhubacas bod du bros 'ongs shing / bod pa rnams kyis ru pa ti'i skad ma go bar gnam nas 'ongs zer bar 'dod de/ de gnya' bar btegs nas rjer mdzad du bcug pa yin zer ba'am/ sngon gyi bod mi'i mes po'i ngos 'dzin tshul de yang ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ma 'ongs lung bstan du mchis tshul/ rje g.yu thog pas mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi yang sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin tshul rnams kyis dwangs gtsang gi lo rgyus kyi bzhin ras su rab rib grib mas g.yogs pa dang 'dra bas/ lan rer nga'i lag gi gser gyi phor ba 'di khyod kyi yang mes tshos nged tshang la g.yar ba red zer ba dang gnyis su med/ yang lan rer bltas na nga'i a pha'i bya spyod cung rtsub pas de nga'i a pha ma yin zhing nga'i a pha dngos ni khyod kyi a pha de red zer ba dang 'dra bas/ pha rol bas kyang khyod kyi gser phor nga'i yin dang khyod kyi pha dngos ni nga'i pha yin zer ba'i 'khyog gtam dag thon pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis nga tsho don ngo ma'i gnas lugs shig la kha phyogs nas rang nyid kyi gser phor bdag po rang nyid bya rgyu dang rang gi a phar a pha zer rgyu de yin/skabs 'di'i brjod bya gtso bo ni nga tsho'i nang pa tshos gdod ma'i bon po'i bya spyod spel dgos zer ba min par mes po'i 'byung khungs bon po nas thon pa khas len rgyu dang / bon la brten pa'i rig gnas kyi ma lag cha tshang ba zhig kyang dar yod pa bcas khas len rgyu de yin/ 183

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskad rgan nad kyi brtag bcos bla ma'i dgongs rgyan/nga tshos nad gzhi gang 'dra zhig gso bcos bya skabs/ thog mar nad skyed byed kyi rgyu gang la rkyen gang dag phrad nas nad de slong bar byed bzhin par dbye zhib byed rgyu ni/ bod lugs gso rig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin zhing / mtha' mjug gi 'bras bu smin par brtson pa'i gom pa dang po'ang yin/ rgyu rkyen der brten nas 'bras bu'i nad kyi na lugs dang nad rtags thon zhing / nad thog skabs 'bras bu'i snang tshul de mngon pa las thog ma'i rgyu rkyen gnyis mi gsal mod/ skabs der rang blos dpyad cing gso bya'i ngag la nyan pa sogs kyis rgyu rkyen gang dang phrad 'dug par dpag rgyu ni shin tu gnad/ de yang rgyud las ci'i phyir rgyu las 'bras bu 'gal mi srid ces dang / yang de las/ rgyu ma bcos par 'bras bu gso 'dod pa// dug rtsa ma phyungs lo ma bcad skyur 'dra// zhes gsungs pa ltar sa bon gang btab na 'bras bu de smin pa bzhin nad kyang de ltar mchis shing / nad de gso bar rtsom tshe de'i rgyu ma bcos par ngo bo'am 'bras bu gso bar 'dod pa ni dug gi rtsa ba ma phyungs par lo ma bcad nas bskyur ba'am bzhag pa dang 'dra bas so//184

st+waṃ0('i010sprusnga 00 116rdu(3sa 7khuskye1khu7rngudang po/ da rgan nad kyi rgyo rkyen dang gyur tshul/thengs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i da rgan nad gso bcos bya dgos tshe de'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yin par dpyad rgyu ni spyi 'gros shig tu 'khum/ da rgan nad 'di rlung nad kyi khongs su bgrang ba zhig dang mkhal nad kyi khongs su bgrang pa zhig bcas gnyis su mchis mod/ de gnyis kyi nad rgyu rlung yin kyang 'bab gnas kyi dbang gis gong bzhin dbye/ de'i phyir dgye dang nang gug gnyis re mchis/ ske tshigs dang an stong tshigs pa rnams rkyen gang dang phrad pas phyir dgye ba'am nang du bkug par dpyad tshe/ mkhal ma da rgan lta bur mtshon na mkhal ma yod sa'i tshigs pa gang rung la'am tshigs pa bcu bzhi ba lta bur mi theg bzhin gyen la 'degs pa'am rgyab tu 'khur ba/yang na gnas der rdo dbyug sogs kyis brdung ba/ yun ring phyir dgye ba'am nang du bkug nas bsdad pas/ mkhar bar du yod pa'i rgyus pa dang khrung rus sogs phyi nang gang rung du ded par ma zad/ mkhar khung du'ang btsur srid pas/ mkhar khung du gnas pa'i rtsa dkar la btsur gnon thebs na mkhal 'grams gyi rtags thon/ brdab 'grams dang btsur gnon thebs sa'i mkhar bar der rlung zhugs nas tshigs de'i 'gram phyogs kyi rtsa rnams 'khum zhing de'i ldog phyogs kyi mkhar bar rang bzhin gyis cher rgyas pa dang de ru khrung rus chags pas thon/ yang na chu yi las mang byas pa'am brlan la bsdad drag pas/ mkhal ma sa chu'i rang bzhin can de'i grang ba'i 185

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskacha 'phel drag par rlung ni nyi mar ldan na bsreg pa'i grogs byed cing / zla bar ldan na bsil ba'i grogs kyang byed pas rlung dang bsdongs nas mkhal gsang gi mkhar bar du nad 'gyur byung nas khrung rus chags/ spyir rus pa dang tshigs pa ni rlung gnas yin pas 'di ltar thon pa'i nad kyang rgyu rlung dang bral thabs med/ rlung nad da rgan gyi rkyen yang gong rnams las ma 'das/ nad 'di'i gyur tshul ni mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis da rgan gyi nad mang che ba tshigs pa phyi nang gang du 'khyog yod pa de'i rgyab phyogs kyi tshigs pa'i rtsa rnams 'khums pas gzhogs de'i mkhar bar je srab tu song zhing /'bur yod pa'i gzhogs de'i mkhar bar rang bzhin gyis je cher gyur bas de'i bar du khrung rus chags nas byung bzhin mchis zhes gsungs pa yang gong nas rkyen bshad pa'i skabs kyi gyur tshul brgyud rim dang gnyis su med/gnyis pa/ da rgan gyi tshig don/da rgan zhes pa'i brda don ni snga 'grel rnams su gzhung mang phan tshun bsdur dpyod ma byas tshe thad kar mi gsal mod/ mkhan po tshe rnam tshang gis da rgan zhes pa ni bod skad de zur du don pa'am rang gnas las gzhan du song ba'am gtso bo dang shugs drag po sogs kyi don yin zhes 'grel zhing /snyingalo bsdus par/ phyi yi de dang 'dra ba la// lus ni phyir dgye byed pa dang // mgo bo rgyab tu 'dren byed cing // de la brang ni shin tu 'bur//gnya' ba bcom pa ltar na zhing // so dang kha ni mdog mi sdug / rngul zhing 186

st+waṃs(smo010spru| 00 116khurdumi0 7rduskye1dzu10dzilus ni lhod par byed// phyir dgye gzhung rengs zhes bya zhing // de la shugs drag ces kyang bshad// ces dang / bu don ma las/ da rgan bshul sha tshigs khar na// tshigs pa 'bur zhing brdung na phan// mjug tu tshigs thon sgur bor 'gro// zhes dang / gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod las/mkhal ma da rgan zhes bya ba// tshigs dang bshul sha thams cad na//brdungs pa'am bcir na phan snyam byed/ skabs su rked pa na/ rgyab lag byas na bde ba snyam byed/ mjug tshigs 'thon nas sgur bor 'gro zhes gsungs pa'i da rgan gyi nad rtags dang ming gzhan dag la gzhigs na rang gnas las gzhan du song ba'am shugs drag po'i don rnams la 'jug pa gsal/gsum pa/ da rgan nad kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba/gang mang zhig— gis nad 'dir rus 'phel gyi nad zer zhing rus pa 'phel ba las byung bar 'dod mod/ phran gyis de ltar mi 'dod de/ mkhar bar du khrung rus chags pa de'ang gzhogs de'i mkhar bar je cher thon na sngar der yod pa'i khrung rus rang bzhin gyis je mthug tu 'gyur srid/ dper na rus chag byung nas chag mtshams legs por phrad med pa'i mtshams su'ang rus pa skye pa lta bu/ gnad mkhar bar du bsnad 'grams byung na de sos skabs khrung rus skye nas mthug por thon pa ni rus chag kyang rjes su sos tshe chag mtshams sbom por gyur 'dug pa lta bu/ rus 'phel nad yin tshe rgyab kyi tshigs pa 187

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskarnams ma zad yan lag gi tshigs mtshams sam tshigs mtshams ma yin pa'i gnas rnams su rus pa dang khrung rus skyes srid/ rus 'phel skabs skyes pa ni rkyen brdab 'grams ma yin/ 'on kyang rgyab tshigs 'bur po 'ga' rus 'phel bas thon bzhin pa'ang re gnyis mchis/ gal te rus pa 'phel ba las tshigs sgur bor gyur ba yin na nad de'i nad rgyu da rgan dang tha dad du 'dug pas/ gso byed gnyen po'i sman yang de gnyis tha dad yin/ spyir rten dang brten pa'i 'phel zad bcos thabs gcig ces gsungs pa ltar lus nad gnyen po thams cad 'byung ba lnga las grub rkyen/ rten lus zungs la sogs pa'i gnod bya rnams dang der brten pa'i gnod byed nyes pa rnams 'phel ba dang zad pa'i bcos thabs gcig pa ste/ dper na rten dwangs ma 'phel ba dang brten pa bad kan 'phel ba'i bcos thabs gcig la/ zad pa'ang de bzhin mchis/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i 'phel zad bcos thabs kyang de bzhin 'dug 'on kyang rten rus pa dang brten pa rlung gi 'phel zad de las ldog pa ste/ 'grel ba zla zer du gang rus pa 'phel bar byed pa'i sman snum pa dang mngar ba la sogs pa des ni rlung zad par byed pa yin la/ gang rlung 'phel bar byed pa'i sman rtsub pa dang kha ba la sogs pa des ni nyams dmad par byed pa smyung ba'i rjes su mthun pas ni/ rus pa zad par byed pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar rus pa 'phel ba ni rlung zad pa las byung zhing / rlung zad na bad kan 'phel rtags thon pas bcos thabs kyang bad kan 'phel ba'i cha drod rtsub sogs kyis gzhom par byed rgyu 188

st+waṃbardusmo010spru| 0ba rwa16༷(3so 7dziskye1dzu1sadzide yin mod/ da rgan nad kyi bcos thabs la rgyud las/ da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang // phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la// sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang // mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang // zhes rlung gi mtshan nyid rtsub g.yo'i cha rnams 'phel ba de 'joms par byed pa'i sman sbyor rigs gsungs yod pas kyang da rgan nad rus 'phel las byung ba min pa gsal/ de yang rgyab tshigs phyir 'bur ba'am nang du gug par rlung nad da rgan dang mkhal ma da rgan zhes tha dad kyi ming gnyis byung don ni an stong dang po dang drug bdun sogs stod du babs par rlung nad da rgan zer zhing / 'bab gnas de dag tu rlung gsang mang zhing rlung gsang rnams su gtso cher 'bab pas de bzhin brjod/tshigs pa bcu bzhi ba gtso byas pa'i smad du babs par mkhal ma da rgan zer zhing / 'bab gnas gtso che ba mkhal gsang yin pas so// de ltar 'dug pa ni rgyud las/ da rgan phyir dgye brang 'bur gnya' ba bstungs// ltag pa dgye la so 'cha' wu ba skyug/ mgo dang 'gram pa brgyab na skad mi phyin// mig har g.yal 'byung rtsib logs gnyis su zug / da rgan nang gug na tshul de 'dra la// ske bstungs brang du bsdus te ro stod 'bur// zhes rlung nad da rgan ni stod kyi tshigs pa rnams la nad 'gyur byung nas phyir dgye ba'am nang du gug pa'i rtags kho na ru zad/ mkhal ma da rgan ni bai sngon las/ da rgan ni tshigs pa bcu bzhi ba sogs phyir don te sgur bor 'gro zhes smad kyi tshigs rnams la nad 'gyur byung nas sgur por song ba gsal por bstan/ da rgan 189

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskand 'di deng rabs gso rig gi ngos nas bshad na mkhar mtshams 'bur nad(rnyeṣṭha/rigre྾༅tshelo)kyi nad de yin 'dug de ni mkhar mtshams 'bur nad kyi nad 'di'i rgyu rkyen gyur tshul nad rtags dang bcas pa da rgan nad las gnyis su ma mchis shing / dper na nad 'di'i rgyu rkyen yang rgyud las/rgyu ni brdabs dang mi theg khur dang bteg / rlan la 'dug dang chu yi las byas 'byung // zhes gsungs pa dang gcig mtshungs yin pas so//bzhi ba/ da rgan nad kyi nad rtags/nad 'di'i rtags su kha lce skam zhing mgo bo na ba sogs rlung nad kyi rtags gang mang zhig yod pa gzhir byas/ tshigs pa phyir don pa'am nang du gug pa'i gnas de ru gnon zug che zhing / glo dang sbrid pa byung skabs mkhar bar gyi rtsa dkar la bcir gnon thebs pas lhag par na/ bshang gcin shugs kyis bcir ba'am drag shul gyis las byas na'ang de bzhin na/mkhal ma da rgan yin tshe mkhal 'grams bar rgyas dang smad lhung gi rtags thon/ mkhal 'grams nad ces pa ni mkhal ma nyid la 'grams byung nas thon pa zhig dang mkhal gsang gi mkhar bar sogs su 'grams byung nas thon pa bcas gnyis su dbye chog mkhar bar du 'grams byung ba da rgan nad kyi rgyu rkyen yin pa gong nas bshad zin/ mkhal ma nyid la 'grams byung tshe der 'brel ba'i rtsa dkar dag la'ang nad 'gyur byung srid par brten/rtsa dkar de'i byed las nyams pa'i rtags kyang gong ltar bcir gnon thebs 190
