st+waṃgordusmo010spru| 00 116dzirdutshib 7khuzu1dzu10rdunas byed las nyams pa'i rtags ltar thon pas yin/ gzhan yang mkhal 'grams rnying ba da rgan du'ang 'gyur srid de/ de ni mkhal mar 'grams skyon shor bas der 'brel ba'i mkhal gsang sogs kyi rtsa'i byed las rim gyis nyams shing 'khums par gyur/ de rgyu rkyen skabs bshad pa ltar da rgan nad du gyur/ dper na rgyud las/ 'or nad rnying pa dmu chur 'gyur ba yod// ces gsungs pa ltar mkhal 'grams rnying pa da rgan du gyur ba'i skabs kyang yod/ gzhan nad rtags su rlung nad da rgan la mtshon na rgyud nas gsungs pa'i brang 'bur zhing gnya' ba bstungs pa sogs gang sar gsal bas 'dir bkod med/lnga ba/ da rgan nad kyi bcos thabs/mkhan po tshang gis da rgan gyi nad mang che ba tshigs pa phyi nang gang du 'khyog yod pa de'i rgyab phyogs kyi tshigs pa'i rtsa rnams 'khums nas thon bzhin pas der rtsa dkar gyi sman sprad na phan zhes rtsa dkar gyi sman sprod bzhin pas/ der phan 'bras kyang shin tu che zhes rgan mig dmar lags kyis rtag par gsungs/ kha shas kyis nad 'di'i 'bur gnas la me brgyab na phan zer ba bden don gyi gnas lugs cher 'dug de ni nad 'di'i 'bab gnas tshigs pa'i mkhar bar dang der khrung rus skyes bzhin pas/rgyud las/ de ltar zhugs nas gang du brten pa'i gnas// zhu ba'i gnas dang dpyi mig rus tshigs dang // reg bya rna ba rlung gi gnas yin te// zhes 191

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskatshigs dang rus pa gang yin rung rlung gi zhugs gnas yin zhing / tshigs la rlung zhugs na da rgan nad du 'gyur ba ni rgyud las/ tshigs zhugs stong sbos skrangs nas da rgan 'gyur zhes dang / bu don ma las tshigs zhugs da rgan nad du 'gyur zhes gsungs shing / der me brgyab na phan pa ni rlung gi nad la drod dang bcud kyis bcos dgos pa dang / lhag par rgyud las/ mdor na bad rlung las gyur grang ba kun// rtsa nad chu ser me yis bsreg pa bsngags// zhes gsungs pa sogs kyis yin/ gzhan khrung rus skyes bzhin pa de me yis bsreg na skyes mtshams 'jog par phan/ dper na yal ga mang ba'i sdong bo'i yal phran zhig gi rtsa ba bsreg tshe yal phran de rjes nas mi rgyas pa lta bu yin/ bdag gis nad thog skabs mang che bar mdzod dge nyi ma'i man ngag rin chen bkol zhing / re gnyis la lcags tel brgyab pa yin/man ngag rin chen sbyor ba 'di da rgan nad la phan pa thog mar rtogs mkhan ni bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo grags pa rgya mtsho yin zhing /khong nyid kyis nad thog skabs da rgan gyi gso bya sum brgya lhag la man ngag rin chen sbyor ba kho nar bsten nas bcos par/ de rnams kyi khrod na phan med phal cher mi 'dug cing drag skyed dang lhag par sangs drag gi tshad ha cang mtho/ dper na an stong tshigs pa bcu gsum dang bcu bzhi/ bco lnga bcas phyir don zhing gom pa rang 'gros mi thub pa'i rgya mi zhig kan su'u zhing chen dmag gi sman khang dang / zhing chen sman khang gnyis pa so so nas zla shas ring gso bcos byas kyang / phan 'bras ye nas ma byung stabs/ man 192

st+waṃgo(smo010spru7 0ba 116༷rdumib krokhuzu1khu1bakhungag rin chen sbyor ba zhogs par lto stong ril bu re bsten du bcug pa las gzhan gso sman gang yang ma bsten par bsdad pas/ sman bsten pa'i phyi nyin nas na zug rim bzhin je chung du gyur zhing zla gcig gi rjes nas gom pa rang 'gros thub par gyur/ zla gsum gyi rjes nas sngon ltar las gnas su bya ba sgrub thub par gyur/ gzhan a mchog nyi ma lung gi mi zhig la da rgan nad byung nas lus smad kyi tshor ba phal cher nyams shing rkang pa gnyis phran tsam yang 'gul mi thub par gyur nas lo gnyis son pa zhig la khong gis zla drug yun gso bcos byas rjes gso bya de yar langs thub par ma zad/ da lta phyugs rdzi byed bzhin mchis bcas khong gi lo rgyus bsdus pa zhig 'dug pa ru gsal/ gso bya der sprad pa'i sman yang man ngag rin chen sbyor ba gcig pu yin zhes khong gis gsungs/ bdag gis da rgan nad la gso bcos byas pa'i brgyud rim nang khong gi phyag len bzhin sbyor ba tshad ldan(man ngag rin chen sbyor ba)du bzos shing / de da rgan gyis mnar ba'i gso bya nyi shu tsam la sprad pas/ de rnams kyi khrod nas phan med gcig kyang ma mchis shing gso bya bcu bzhi sangs drag byung / man ngag rin chen sbyor ba 'di da rgan nad la gtong skabs nad gzhi'i lci yang ltar btung yun zla gcig nas gsum bar dang / der dmigs bsal gyi log nus med cing phan nus shin tu che ba sogs kyi dge mtshan bla na med pa mchis/mjug mthar phran gyis bla ma'i zhal lung ltar gso bcos byas shing gso yul nad la'ang rang blos dpag tsam gyis dbye zhib bgyi khul byas pa 'dis 193

skal mnyam dag la cung e phan snyam nas bris par/ gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan lam du phyogs tshe khrel ba'i gzhir gyur na thang mod/ bdag gi rnam dpyod rtsing po las thon pa 'dir nor 'khrul med pa mi srid pas/ 'brel yod mkhas dbang rnam pas skyon brjod dang dag bcos ci rigs bya bar smon//

sas(smo010po5 0sa 116khu(skyago 01khuskye1khu1badzigrum bu'i nad kyi ngos 'dzin dang bcos thabs tsam brjod pa nyi gzhon bsu ba'i skya rengs/grum bu'i nad kyi gros mgo tsam bton tshe gang mang zhig gi blo ngor tshigs dmigs su chu ser rgyas rkyen gnas der chag grum shor ba ltar na ba'i nad cig yin par ngos 'dzin gnang bar ma zad/ nad gzhi 'di nub lugs gso rig dgongs pa'i (yālo༅ mistsustso ྅)dang (lodku milkoyā'imilodkuglolko)sogs yin pa'am de dag las kyang grang grum ni(yālodkutshilko bo'i)yin par yang ngos 'dzin gnang mus su 'dug cing / de sngon rang nyid la mtshon na grang grum ni(skyulodkuṣṭhalkostso3 )yin zhing tsha grum ni(skyuloglesum̐)yin par ngos 'dzin byed mkhan gyi gras yin/ 'on kyang grum bu'i nad de'i rgyu rtags dang bcos thabs sogs la sngar las gom gang mdun spos kyi tshul du brtag tshe gong gi lta ba de cung mi 'tsham pa'i tshor snang zhig ster srid/ de ltar thon don ni dpal ldan rgyud bzhi gtso byas pa'i rang re'i bod lugs gso rig tu grum bu'i nad kyi skor gleng skabs nad de'i rgyu gang yin dpyad cing rgyu de rkyen gang dag dang phrad nas slong bar byed/ mthar lus kyi gnas gang dang gang du nad kyi rnam 'gyur ci lta bu thon pa sogs gcig med na 195

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskagacig mi 'byung gi tshul tu gong ma'i rgyu rkyen de dag 'dzoms pa las mtha' mjug gi nad de thon srid pa'i sdom tshig bkod/ 'di ltar bkod pa'i sdom tshig ni dpe sdong bo zhig gi rtsa ba nas bzung ste sdong bo de'i skyes dbyibs dang rtsa lo me 'bras/ yal ga bcas par rgyus lon byed pa dang yongs su mthun/ nub lugs gso rig gzhung du bkod pa'i(rsālodkuphrilkostso'i)dang (lolomilko3'i’lodkurṣa)sogs ni nad gzhi de dag gi rtags gang rung zhig gtso bor bzung nas rtags de'i gong du thon pa'i nad de'i gyur tshul dang rgyu rkyen rnams dpyad gzhir bzung / rtags de'i rjes phyogs su rtags gang dang gang thon zhing mthar bsdongs zla'i nad 'di dang 'byung bzhin mchis zhes bkod pa ni/ dpe sdong bo zhig gi yal ga nas bzung ste ldog 'gros kyis yal ga de'i rtsa ba sdong rkang gi phyogs su ji ltar gyes 'dug cing de'i steng du lo ma dang me tog 'bras bu gang dag smin bzhin par dpyad pa dang 'dra/ gnas tshul 'di'i dbang gis( yā'adkuṣṭharmastso3)dang(lodku mi〉྅྅’lodku7)sogs kyi thog ma'i rgyu dus da lta'i bar rnyed med/spyir bod lugs gso rig gzhung du gsungs pa'i grum bu'i nad dang nub lugs gso rig gzhung du bkod pa'i (lokhyospraṭhalo)gnyis 'dra ba'i cha mi nyung ba re mchis pa las/ (lotshoṣṭhaṭhalo)yinang gses(yā'adku spralkolto3)lta bu zhig grum bu'am grang grum lta bur thad kar ngos bzung na cung mi 'tsham snyam/ 'on kyang phyi ma ni yal ga bzung ste sdong bo de'i rtsa lo me 'bras bcas par sdom tshig bzhag pa dang 'dra bas der gsal cha dang rgyus ma lon 196

st+waṃbardusmo010sprusti 0ba 116༷rdu30 7rduzu1dzukrokhupa'i skyon mang du mchis/ 'jig rten 'di'i dge mi dge'i bya dngos gang rung zhig la gsal cha ldan pa'i zhib 'jug bya dgos na de'i rgyu gang yin shes rgyu ni g.yol thabs med pa'i gnas shig yin/ gna' mi'i kha dper ying /gyod rgya ma gnyis kyi rtsa ba shes dgos/ rnag chu ser gnyis kyi 'byung khungs shes dgos zhes pa'ang gnas tshul gang dang gang yin rung de'i rtsa bar rgyus mnga' bya rgyu'i gal che'i rang bzhin bstan pa de yin/ spyir bod lugs gso rig gzhung du bstan pa'i grum bu zhes pa ni nad rgyu bye brag pa zhig la brten nas byung ba'i tshigs dmigs rnams nad de'i 'bab gnas gtsor byas shing rnam 'gyur sna min ston pa'i nad rigs shig tu ngos bzung na legs pas/'di lta bu'i nad gzhi zhig nub lugs gso rig gzhung du bkod pa'i(cholodkumilkostso3)dang ye nas sbyar thabs med/ de ni mchin grum nag po dang mkhal grum gnyis kyang grum bu'i khongs su 'du zhing nad gzhi 'di gnyis kyi rgyu yang grum bu'i nad rgyu yin/ nad gzhi 'di gnyis grum bu'i nad khongs su 'du tshe mkhal grum gyi rtags su mkhal ma'i nad rtags mngon che zhing mchin grum nag po'i rtags su mchin pa'i nad rtags mngon che bas zhib brtag ma bgyis tshe tshigs dmigs na ba'i skor rnyed dka'/ de'i mi tshad sha trem gyi rtags su'ang tshigs dmigs na ba'i rtags rnyed dka'/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig lhag rkyen grang grum dang(rsālotsholhalkostso ྅)gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbyar thabs bral bas de'i skor cung zhib tu bkod na gsham ltar/197

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang po/ grum nad kyi rgyu rkyen la gzhi bcol te dbye zhib bgyis pa/spyir grum bu'i nad kyi rgyu rkyen ni rgyud kyi grum nad gso ba'i le'u ru rgyu rkyen rlan snum yul dang snum bcud zas// dwangs ma gnas su ma smin chu ser rgyas//sha rus rtsa rgyus la gnas grum bu skyed// ces gsungs pa ni grang grum nad la gtso cher dgongs te/ rgyud kyi bad kan gso ba'i le'u ru/ bad kan grum bu dkar po zhes bya ba// ma zhu rang gnas bad kan 'phel ba yis pho ba mchin pa gang yin cha med na// kha zas ci zos mi zhim 'khru skyug byed// nywa gzhi mig rus na zhing chu tshan 'byung // mjug tu yan lan la byer grum bur 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar kha zas gang zos pa zhig pho ba'i me drod gsum gyis 'ju ma thub par pho ba rang gi gnas su yun ring lus pas ma zhu ba'i nad du gyur/ rgyu der brten nas lus khams spyir gnas pa'i chu ser gyi cha 'phel zhing de dang tshigs dmigs su gnas pa'i bad kan 'byor byed gnyis bsdongs bas grum bu'i nad skyed par byed/ de ni gso rig kun 'dus las/ bad kan grum bu dkar po'i rtags ni/ gnyan tshad med par grang ba'i khams 'phel zhing nad 'jug ldog rgyu'i dbang gis grum bur 'gyur nyen yod pas grum bu dkar po bshad la nad de ma zhu rang gnas su rkyen gong bzhin bslangs pas bad kan 'phel nas pho mchin gang yin cha med na zhing kha zas gang zos mi zhim pa dang cha med du 'khru skyug byed pa dang / nywa gzhi dang mig rus na zhing chu tshan dang chu skyur 'byung ba mjug tu yan lag gi tshigs la byer nas grum bur 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa yang grang grum nad 198

sab('i010sprusmo 00 116༷rdu30 krokhuzu101padzikyi rgyu rkyen dang gyur tshul kho na ru zad/ tsha grum nad kyi rgyu rkyen ni byang ba'i yan lag brgyad pa ru/ grum bu'i nad rgyu tshad gzhug rlung gis bus// chu ser ldan pa rus la zhen pa'am// zhes tsha grum gyi rgyu yang chu ser yin zhing /skabs 'di'i chu ser ni rgyu gong ltar dwangs ma ma zhu ba las byung ba kho na min par/ thog mar cham pa dang rims sogs phog par de ma smin pa'i skabs su bsil bcos kyi gnyen po bsten sngas pa'am thal ba'i rkyen gyis pho ba'i me drod kyi nus pa nyams par brten/ rlung gis chu ser g.yos nas gtso cher rus tshigs su byer ba'i rigs shig yin/ gzhan yang man mag lhan thabs su/ de yang tshad pa'i nad rigs gang yang rung // bcud shor nyin gnyid gtar sngas drag shul gyis// tsha ba byer zhing phal cher smad du lhungs// chu ser bsdongs zlar bcas pa tshigs la zhen// sha rus rtsa rgyus la khyab grum bur 'gyur// zhes grum nad spyi'i rgyu rkyen du gsungs 'dug kyang tsha grum nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang mthun pas gtso cher der dgongs pa 'dra/ yang byang ba'i yan lag brgyad pa ru/ brlan grangs snum bcud kha zas ma zhu bas// dwangs ma gnas su ma smin chu ser rgyas// sha rus rtsa rgyus la gnas grum bu bskyed//ces pa grang grum gyi nad rgyur dgongs nas gsungs/ gzhan yang mkhas mchog zur 'tsho ba phyag rdor mgon pos mdzad pa'i rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i thugs bcud gces bsdus rin chen phreng ba ru/ rgyu la rnam pa gnyis yin ste// tsha ba skyed dang grang ba skyed// de la tsha ba skyed par ni// rims sam cham pa'i gzhug dag la// zas spyod nyes pa'i tsha ba bzhug / phyi'i sha 199

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad sto gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskadang rus la bab// rus la zhen na grum bur 'gro// gnyis pa grang ba'i skyed par ni// bad kan ldan pa'i tsha ba la// chang dang mar rnying sha rnying dang //thud dang bu ram la sogs pas// bad kan skyed pas bcud shor bas//bad kan tsha bas rus la zhen// lci ba grum bu nag po ste// tshab chung grang bas grum bu dkar// zhes tsha grum dang grang grum gnyis kyi thog ma'i rgyu rkyen gsal bor gsungs/ skabs 'dir gong gi tshad mar 'dzin rgyu'i gzhung rnams la gzhi bcol te dbye zhib tsam bgyis na thog mar nges shes rnyed pa ni tsha grum dang grang grum gnyis kyi rgyu tha dad du 'dug pa de yin/ de nas mu mthud dpyad khul tsam bgyis na tsha grum der yang rgyu tsha ba yin rung yams thabs su gcig nas gcig tu 'gos 'gro ba zhig dang 'go ba'i rang bzhin med pa zhig bcas rigs chen po gnyis mchis/ bal nad bcos nyes byer ba las thon pa'i rigs der grum gsar zer zhing nad 'di yams thabs su gcig nas gcig tu 'go bar byed/ de ni man ngag lhan thabs su/ grum bu'i nang gtogs grum gsar zhes pa'i nad// rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags bcos bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen tsha ba gsar la nyin gnyid log / bcud shor drag shul rkyen gyis byer ba dang // kha cig gtar sngas chang nad gdon gyis rkyen// phal cher bal nad bcos nyes byer las 'byung // de phyir nad 'di mched skyen la lar 'go// zhes dang / gso rig kun 'dus su'ang grum gsar ni bal nad bcos nyes byer ba las thon zhes gsungs/ grum gsar nad kyi rgyu bal nad yin tshe nad de tsha ba'i khongs su gtogs mod/ lhan 200

st+waṃ0rdu'i010sprushā 00 116rdu(mi0 krokhuzu1dzu1sadzithabs su der dkar nag gnyis su dbye 'dug ste nad kyi 'bab gnas dang bsdongs zlar dgongs pa e yin snyam/ de ni rgyud las/ ci'i phyir rgyu las 'bras bu 'gal mi srid ces gsungs yod pa'i phyir/grum bu'i rigs gang yin rung rgyu chu ser las ma 'das shing gom gang mdun spos kyi tshul du mu mthud dbye zhib tsam bgyis na/ chu ser gso ba'i le'u ru/ mdor bsdus chu ser 'phel bas nad 'gyur te// sha bkra glang shu srin thor khye ma dang // shu ba za rkong za 'phrug chu ser byed// 'or dang skya rbab dmu chu chu ser byed// sur ya me dbal dreg grum gag lhog dang //rnyogs pa'i tsha ba thams cad chu ser byed// mgo dang yan yag byang khog la sogs pa// rma yi nyes pa thams cad chu ser byed// 'bras dang mdze nad chu ser las 'byung bas// de phyir chu ser nad la bya ra gces// zhes dang /gso rig kun 'dus smad cha ru/ de yang chu ser 'di nyid 'phel bas nad gang du'ang mi 'gyur ba med de gang zhe na/ sha bkra dang / glang shu/ srin thor/ khye ma/ shu ba/ za rkong / za 'phrug rnams kyang chu ser gyis byed/'or dang / skya rbab/ dmu chu gsum rmeng chu ser gyis byed/ sur ya/ me dbal/ dreg grum/ gag lhog la sogs pa'i rma'i nyes pa thams cad kyang chu ser gyis byed/ 'bras dang mdze gnyis kyang chu ser las 'byung bas 'di la gso ba sgrims dgos so// zhes gsungs pa ltar grum nad ni grang grum la mtshon na ring rgyu'am brgyud rgyu dwangs ma ma zhu ba dang / tsha grum la mtshon na tsha ba'i nad la bsil bcos drag pa'am bsten sngas pas pho ba'i me drod 201

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad sto gces btus kunda dagles pa'i zla zeskabasad pa de yin/ de gnyis kyi nye rgyu ni gong gi ring rgyu der brten nas byung ba'i chu ser du nges/ 'di ltar brjod tshe re gnyis kyis grum bu'i rgyu chu ser yin na chu ser shar gram na sha trem yin dgos mod/ de ltar min pas mi 'gal lam zhe na/ bdag gis 'di ltar 'dod de/ skabs der nye rgyu chu ser dang lhan cig byed rkyen gtso bo tshigs dmigs su gnas pa'i bad kan 'byor byed gnyis bsdongs rkyen nyer len gyi grum pa'i rgyu dngos grub cing /rgyu de lus kyi gang sar byer na de ru nad kyi rtags thon/ de'i rkyen gyis grum nad kyi rgyur yang grum nad kho na skyed byed kyi rgyu bye brag pa zhig chu ser dang bad kan 'byor byed gnyis bsdongs nas grub bzhin par bsam/ gzhan chu ser gso ba'i le'u ru/ rus zhen rus pa lhang lhang na ba dang // tshigs dmigs na zhing brkyang bskum 'gro 'dug dka'// tshigs kha skrangs shing za la shu thor 'byung // zhes chu ser tshigs dmigs su byer nas nad du gyur bar grum bu'i nad zer ram mi zer zhe na/ der grum bu'i nad ces brjod chog la/ skabs der nye rgyu chu ser dang bad kan 'byor byed gnyis bsdongs yod pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar brjod tshe mchin grum nag po dang mkhal grum/ sha trem sogs kyang thog mar chu ser dang bad kan 'byor byed gnyis bsdongs ba'i nyer len gyi rgyu der brten nas byung ba yin nam zhe na/ spyir bad kan 'byor byed zhes pa ni rdzas bye brag pa zhig gam lus khams su lhan skyes su grub pa'i srin rigs bye brag pa zhig gi don min la/ 'byor byed kyi grub cha der lha'i mig gam phra mthong che shel sogs kyis brtag tshe de'i khongs su srin 202

st+waṃsardusmo010sprukau 0sa 116khurdu2sa grarnguzu101gordurigs bgrang gis mi longs pa zhig mchis srid/ de bzhin chu ser du'ang srin rigs bgrang gis mi longs ba re mchis srid/ gnas tshul 'di'i dbang gis bad kan 'byor byed du gnas pa'i srin rigs bye brag pa zhig dang chu ser kyi khams su gnas pa'i srin rigs bye brag pa zhig gnyis bsdongs bas grum bu'i nad rgyu grub cing / de nas gnas gzhan du byer bas mchin grum nag po dang mkhal grum sogs byung /gnyis pa/ grum bu'i nad kyi dbye ba dang nad rtags la gzhi bcol te dbye zhib bgyis pa/nub lugs gso rig gis 'dod pa'i (yā'adkuphyalkostso3)yi rgyu shes med pas rgyu der brten nas byung ba'i nad kyi rnam 'gyur la zhib 'jug bya skabs cha tshang ba zhig gam brgyud rim ldan pa zhig bgyi thabs bral mod/nad de'i rtags la gzhi bcol nas nad kyi rnam 'gyur tsam bkod par bltas na bod lugs gso rig gzhung gi grang grum gyi khongs su 'du ba las grang grum dang thad kar ngo 'phrod ces pa'i sdom tshig gtan nas 'jog mi nyan/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyud du grum bu'i le'u ru nad der rigs drug tu dbye zhing / sha trem dang rus trem rtsa trem bzhi bor 'bab gnas kyi dbang gis so sor thun mong ma yin pa'i nad rtags re mchis/ tsha trem dang grang trem gnyis kyi rgyu tha dad yin pas nad rtags kyang de bzhin du 'dug pa smros med yin/ gzhan grum bu'i skabs bkod med pa'i mchin grum nag po dang 203

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad sto gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskamakhal grum gnyis kyang grum bu'i nad khongs su 'du/ spyir grum bu'i nad ces pa ni rgyud du/ spyi rtags grang shum yun ring sha lpags brtse// gdong snum mgo bo rked pa dpyi mig zug / shed chung sgyid skyur sha 'bros rngul kha snyi//rus tshigs sha rus 'khol zhing chu rgyus gyong // 'gul tshe lhag par na zhing skad ngan 'chor// chu dmar rtsa 'khyug phra mgyogs gting na rgyug / ces dang / stag tshang lo tsā bas/ tshigs mig chu ser 'phel ba yis// 'byor byed byed las nyams 'gyur te// tshigs kun chags grum shor ba ltar//'gyur bas grum bu zhes su bshad// zhes pa ni nad kyi rgyu dang nad thog skabs mthong mang ba'i rus trem la gzhi bcol ste gsungs bar bsam de ni rgyud las/ rus trem rlung gi shas che skom dad che// rus pa tsha ba che zhing 'ju la skam// tshigs rnams gram zhing zug che 'gul mi nus// bsgul dang sgra cher mi bzod g.yang skyur sems// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ sha trem dang rtsa treem gnyis 'bab gnas dbang gis nad rtags su sha dang chu rgyus na ba las gong ltar tshigs dmigs rnams na ba'i rtags gtso cher min/ de ni rgyud las/ bye brag sha trem bad mkhris shas che ste// sha sbo mdog nag yan lag sbrid pa dang // glo snying mi bde sna khrag mang du 'dzag / sha rus 'byed snyam bem por byed pa yin// rtsa trem khrag gi shas che bkrag mdangs nyams// glo snying mi bde ltag sha chad snyam byed// rtsa rnams sbos shing sra la na ba yin// chu trem chu rgyus gyong 'dar rengs 'khums skams// zhes gsungs pa ltar grum nad kyis gnas gang 204

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprukyā 0sa rwa16khurduskya0 krodzizu1dzu1sardubazung na gnas der nad 'gyur thon pa'i rtags mchis pa gsal/ de bzhin mchin grum nag po dang mkhal grum gnyis kyi nad rtags su'ang mchin nad kyi rtags dang mkhal nad kyi rtags mchis pa las tshigs dmigs su chags grum shor ba ltar gyi rtags rnyed dka'/ de ni rgyud du/ mchin grum nag po lus kun brdungs snyam byed// rkang bshal 'gul na mi bzod sgur por 'gro// zhes dang / yang de las/ mkhal grum rked pa man chad thams cad na// glo dang sbrid pa byung tshe dpyi mig zug / sgal ba rengs shing mjing ba sgyur mi shes// nam stod na zhing nam smad bde bar tshor// chang dang drod bcud zos rjes tsha ba skye// zhes gsungs par thad kar ltos na tshigs dmigs na ba'i skabs shig med pa 'dra yang / gzhung 'grel mang por bsdur dpyod bgyis tshe nad gzhi 'di gnyis kyang grum nad kyi khongs su 'du ba ma zad/ rgyud du spyi rtags bye brag kun la khyab steng du zhes gsungs pa ltar tshigs dmigs na ba'i rtags kyang rnyed srid/ dper na/ bi ci'i po ti kha ser ram rgyal bo'i bla yig 'od 'bar du/ mchin grum nag po'i mtshan nyid ni/ lus po rtung rtung por 'dra'o// lus sgur sgur por 'ong zhing tshigs 'byung ngo// bkug na skad ngan 'ong ngo // drod che snyong snying 'dod/ skom dad che'o// rkang ba bshal zhing lhu tshigs na/ zhes gsungs/ des na dgongs don 'di dag la gzhi bcol te grang grum dang(rsālodku milkolta ྅)gnyis 'dra ba dang mi 'dra ba'i char bsdur dpyod sgos dbye zhib tsam bgyis na 'di lta ste/ nub lugs gso rig gis bzhed palīstsa'agletsho/tsholko༈yā)ni 205

st+waṃs(smo010sprushā 00 rwa16dzi('is 7rduzu1khu1sakhugasum pa/ grum bu'i bcos thabs la gzhi bcol te dbye zhib bgyis pa/khams gtsang 'brug rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i gso rig phan bde'i snye ma las grum bu'i bcos thabs su/ mkhal grum bre ga sug smel bsnan// glor babs a grong cu gang bsdeb// mchin babs gi wang kha che bsdeb// mtsher babs utpal ka ko la// mkhal mar dom mkhris bsdeb par bya// srog rtsar babs na li shi bsdeb// gang babs nad kyi yul dang sbyar// zhes gsungs par gcig nas nad 'di'i gang babs kyi sgos bcos gsal zhing / gnyis nas nad 'di gzhung gi dngos bstan du gsungs pa'i 'bab gnas bzhi las mchin pa dang mkhal ma glo ba sogs su'ang 'bab srid pa'i gnas lugs shig bstan 'dug 'dir ched du mchin grum nag po dang mkhal grum gnyis la dbye zhib tsam bgyis na gsham ltar te/ (1)rgyud kyi mchin grum nag po'i bcos su/ mchin grum nag po 'bras bu gsum thang btang // rngul dbyung rtse chung gtar zhing sngon bus sbyang // mar gsar so ma ra dza'i lde gu btang //rjes la sha srubs tshigs dmigs gar babs bsreg ces gsungs pa yang grum nad kyi spyi bcos su/ bad kan chu ser sbyang phyir 'bras bu gsum// zhes — gsungs pa ltar thog mar 'bras gsum thang bstan 'dug cing grum bu'i nad la thog mar bad kan dang chu ser gnyis sbyang dgos don nad 'di'i rgyu chu ser dang bad kan 'byor byed gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang / de nas rjul dbyung zhing rtse chung gtar ba sogs byas rjes 'dir ched du sngon bus sbyang 207

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskazhes sngon bu dang a ru mchu snyung / zangs rtsi/ rgun 'brum rnams sbyar ba'i sbyor sde 'dis kyang bad kan dang chu ser gnyis sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir yin/mar gsar so ma ra dza'i lde gu btang // zhes pa ni phyi rgyud du/ tsha sel so ma ra dza a ru ra// bsil gsum 'dam bu shing mngar lcags kyi phye// ka ra mar gsar lde gu byas pa yis// glo mchin tsha ba rnyings rnyogs sel bar byed//ces gsungs pa'i sbyor sde de yin zhing / skabs 'dir sbyor sde 'di bsten dgos don grum nad kyi 'bab gnas mchin pa yin pas na'o// rjes la sha srubs tshigs dmigs gar babs bsreg / ces gsungs pa ni mchin grum nag po'i rtags su nad— kyi rgyu tshigs dmigs su babs rkyen gnas der nad rtags mngon bzhin pa mtshon zhing skabs der rus trem ltar tsha ba'i sman dpyad kyis bcos dgos pa'ang mtshon pas mchin grum nag po yin tshe tsha grum kho nar ma nges pa'i bden dbang zhig kyang 'dir ma bcos lhun gyis grub/ gzhan yang sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal bo'i mchin nad bcos pa'i le'u ru/ smad grum rked na dpyi mig bshal// brla sgang pus mo na zhing 'thing /rgyus pa rtsa dag tsha phrengs phrengs// tshigs skrangs rkang pa 'khums pa dang //khyad par khrag wu rnag wu 'ong // khrag mdog nag la rme ba can// mcher khrag nag dmar kam kam po// shin tu dmar na sa bdag gnod// ser po grum bu dkar po 'o// 'bras bu gsum gyi thang btang zhing // rtse'u chung la sogs rtsa rnams gtar// ba le ka yi thang btang ste// bsreg pa dag ni spang bar bya//pho ba la babs me btsa' gdab// 'bras bu gsum gyi bshal btang ste// spyi 208

st+waṃ0(smo0102kyā 00 116khu(mib krorduzu1dzu1sadzizhur tsan dan dkar po dang // kyi lce ba yi grang thang btang // rked pa 'khor na dgab rtsa gtar// bol gong rtsa rnams gtar bar bya// grang ba'i grum bu dag la ni// bshal btang mi gtar me btsa' bya// zhes gsungs pa ru'ang mchin pa'i grum bur tsha grang gnyis mchis pa gsal bar ma zad/ de gnyis kyi thog ma'i rgyur dgongs nas bcos thabs kyi rtsa don yang tha dad du 'dug pa gsal/ (2)rgyud kyi mkhal nad gso ba'i le'ur/ mkhal grum sngon bulī.a ru rgun 'brum zangs rtsi)bshal btang chu lums bya//rtsa nas sbyangs nas seng ldeng (khanda dmar po bzhi chu ser sman gsum bong khrag sbrang sbyar ba'i)phye ma sbyar// bsil gsum zho sha gsum dang 'bras sna gsum// chu ser sman gsum gser gyi bye ma dang // sdig srin bre ga sbrang gi lde gu dang //bdud rtsi me tog 'bru sna'i rlangs lums bya// byin gzhug long rtsa khrag dang sbyar la gtar// tsha ba chog nas sbrang chang yongs rdzogs sbyar// seng ldeng sman mar sbrang dang sbyar la btang // chu ser 'or sgo kun tu me btsa' bsreg /ces gsungs pa yang grum nad spyi'i bcos thabs ltar thog mar rgyu bad kan dang chu ser gnyis sbyang bar bya phyir mchin grum skabs bstan pa'i sngon bu gtso byas pa'i sbyor sde de yis sbyang dgos la/ de nas nad 'di'i 'bab gnas mkhal ma yin zhing / mkhal ma nyid la rgyud las/ mkhal ma bad kan grang ba'i gzhi yin pas// zhes gsungs pa ltar der nad gzhi tsha grang gnyis kyi gang zhugs kyang grang rtags ston pa ma zad grang nad rigs shin tu phog sla phyir chu tshan du lums bya zhing / de nas rgyu chu ser dang bad kan gnyis phyi 209

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyegapa'i zla zeskargyud rtsa sbyongs kyi skabs ltar sbyangs dgos par gdams/ der gsham nas gsungs pa'i sman dpyad rnams su nad 'di'i 'bab gnas la dgongs nas mkhal mar phan pa'i sman dpyad rigs mang du mchis mod/ chu ser sman gsum dang bong khrag seng ldang khaṇḍa dang seng ldeng sman mar sogs grum nad la phan pa'i sbyor sde rigs kyang mang du mchis/ chu ser 'or sgo kun tu me btsa' bsreg / ces gsungs pa ni tshigs pa bcu drug pa'i mdo sogs su me btsas bsreg dgos pa de yin mod/ nad thog lag len khrod lag pa dang rkang ba'i tshigs chen khag gtso byas pa'i nad dmigs gar yod kyi tshigs dmigs su me btsa' gdab par bya'o// gzhan yang nad 'di'i bcos thabs su sman dpyad zla rgyal du/ sngon bu'i bshal dang rtsa bshal dang //yang na gu gul bshal btang ngo // gu gul phye ma dag dang ni// mu zi bre ga ti mu yi// phye ma dag ni btang ba'o// gze ma'i chu yis phul bar bya// grum bu dag la gtar bsreg spang // seng ldeng mu zi'i sman mar btang // thang dang phye ma btang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i sman sbyor rnams rgyud kyi dgongs don dang phal cher mthun mod/ de nyid las gtar bsreg spang zhes pa ni rgyud dang mi mthun par snang yang / skabs 'dir mkhal grum nad grum bu'i khongs su 'dus pa'i gnas lugs shig bstan 'dug gzhan yang zin bris mthong rtogs su/ mkhal grum la gyong bo rlan thang zhag 'ga' btang rjes a ru bcu'i steng sle tres dang / chu ser sman gsum bsnan pa yun du bsten/yang na spos dkar bcu ba dang / seng ldeng nyer gsum pa ltag pa sprod ces 210

st+waṃb smo010sprushā sgrob rwa16dzi mis ①khuzu1ku10khugasungs par gzhigs na nad 'di grum nad rigs bye brag pa zhig yin pa'i tshor snang ster srid/ des na mkhal grum dang mchin grum nag po gnyis kyang grum nad kyi khongs su 'du tshe de gnyis la'ang thog ma'i nad rgyu'i dbang gis tsha grang gnyis re 'byung srid pas/ nad gzhi 'di lta bu gnyis nub lugs gso rig gi(yālodkulkulkotho'i)yi khongs su gtogs par ngos bzung na ha cang mi 'tsham par snang /bzhi ba/ grum nad kyi bcos thabs dngos bstan pa/nad gzhi gang dang gang yin rung thog mar de'i rgyu rkyen dang de nas nad rtags sogs la rim pas dbye zhib mdzad dgos don yang mthar gtugs na rgyu de gzhom byed kyi gnyen po rnyed par brtson pa'i gom 'gros las ma 'das/rang nyid nas kyang gong du grum nad skor gyi nyog gtam lung ba gang bshad pa'i dmigs yul yang de las ma 'das phyir/ nad thog dngos kyi lag len khrod nad gzhi der gso bcos byas pa'i nyams myong tsam brjod na gsham ltar te/ sman du bong khrag nyer lnga kun gyis phan zer mod/ lha sa'i sman rtsis khang nas sdebs pa'i bong khrag nyer lnga dang nga tsho'i sman khang nas sdebs pa'i bong khrag nyer lnga gnyis nad thog tu bkol yang phal cher phan 'bras med ces brjod chog 'on kyang sbyor ba gang zhig yin rung de'i sbyor tshad dang sman rdzas rnams tshad ldan yin dgos kyang / nga tsho'i sman khang du sdebs pa'i bong khrag nyer lngar mtshon na de'i sbyor sde'i gtso sman bong khrag ni gzhung bzhin tshad ldan min par bong du yod tshad kyi khrag bkol bzhin pa dang / 211

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakyis nad thog dngos su bgyis pa'i tshor snang tsam las gzhan rna bas thos tshad dang mig gis mthong tshad du gzhi bcol ba'i gtam khab rtse tsam yang med mod/ stag mchong sar wa mchong ba'i dpe ru song yod na dpyad rtsom 'di shog ba'i phang bo zhig tu brtsis kyang chog gal te dge ba'i cha tsam re ༄ ༄mchis na kun la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces gsol ba 'debs zhor gzur gnas mkhas pas ma dag pa'i rigs la dag bcos re bya rogs zhes kha min snying nas skyabs bcol dang bcas re zhig rdzogs par bya'o//214

bod lugs gso rig gi shes rig bdag dbang skor gleng ba bden gtam dbyar gyi rnga gsang /dang po/ shes rig bdag dbang gi ngo bo tsam brjod pa/spyir shes rig gi bdag dbang(lkokhri 65rdzorsā)zhes pa ni 'das zin pa'i lo zlar mi re gnyis sam mi gang mang zhig gis tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lag rtsal lam/ yang na brtsams chos sogs shes rig gi zhing sa nas gsar gtod byas yod pa'i shul bzhag gi grub 'bras dag gsar gtod mdzad pa po rang nyid kyis bdag dbang bya rgyu'i dbang cha yod par zer/ bdag dbang bya yul de mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i ngal rtsol la brten nas 'khrungs shing de'i byed nus ni dpal 'byor dang bsam blo sogs gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i thabs lam yin/'dzam gling shes rig bdag dbang tshogs palīspo 12du)dgongs don ltar na shes rig bdag dbang la rigs gnyis mchis/ dang po ni rtsom pa po'i bdag dbang yin la/ gtso bo rang nyid kyi brtsams chos sogs 'grem spel bya rgyu'i bdag dbang de yin/ gnyis pa ni bzo grwa'i bdag dbang yin la/ der gtso bo ched khe'i bdag dbang (rdolko/)ṣṭha) dang matstshan byed ched 215

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaspyod bdag dbang(tshe'irmerdokhraṣṭha)gnyis yod/'dzam gling shes rig bdag dbang tshogs pa'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms lte gnas re hri(lkowaṃ)yi ri ne bā(rjemeṣpe)ru btsugs yod/ krung go'i rgyal khab kyang spyi lo1980lo'i zla gsum par tshogs pa 'di'i khongs su zhugs shing tshogs zhugs kyi go rim ltar rtsis na ang dgu bcu ba yin/ shes rig bdag dbang 'di mi'i bdag dbang dang dngos po'i bdag dbang gnyis spyi sdoms byas nas grub pa zhig yin/ de'i rkyen gyis cha tshang ba'i bdag dbang la de gnyis kyi phyogs nas bdag dbang dgos la/ de las kyang thog mar mi'i bdag dbang dgos/ de ni gsar gtod mdzad pa por khrims 'gal ma yin pa'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs sa gnas sogs su phan pa'i shes rig gang yin pa de gsar gtod byed rgyu'i dbang cha yod dgos/ de nas rang nyid kyis gsar gtod gnang bar gsar gtod dpang yig sprad pa'am 'grem spel byed chog pa'i chog mchan thob tshe de'i phyogs nas thon pa'i khe phan gyi dbang cha rang la yod dgos/ de'i rkyen gyis shes rig bdag dbang ni rang byung khams nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa zhig ma yin par/ mi'i rigs kyi blo stobs las gsar gtod gnang bar yul khams sam rgyal khab de'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis chog mchan thob yod pa'i rigs yin/ spyir shes rig bdag dbang sprod sa'i shes bya mtha' dag 'gro ba mi'i rigs la khe phan che ba'i shes rig kho na yin/ des na shes rig bdag dbang ma thob pa'i shes bya mtha' dag phan med yin nam zhe na/ de yang gtan nas min te/216

st+waṃsardusmo010posnga 0sa 116⑥rdu'is krokhuspu1dzu1badzidaper na shes bya khag gcig gi rin thang gzhal med yin yang de'i rin thang ngos ma zin par lus yod pa'am/ skabs bab kyi srid don dang kha phyogs mi mthun pa'i rigs lta bu dag gi dpal 'byor khe phan sogs ci tsam mtho yang yul khams de nas der bkag rgya thob pa las shes rig gi bdag dbang gtan nas thob srid kyi ma red/ gzhan skye bo su zhig gis rang nyid kyi gsar gtod gnang ba'i shes bya der rang gi rgyal khab nas ched khe'i bdag dbang gi chog mchan ma thob tshe/ rgyal khab phyi la lkog 'tshong byas nas rgyal khab de'i ched khe'i bdag dbang len pa dag khrims 'gal las kyang rgyal khab kyi gsang ba lkog 'tshong mkhan gyi nyes can du 'dug pas so//gal te mi zhig gis bya dngos gang rung gsar gtod mdzad rjes der 'brel yod sde khag gis ched khe'i bdag dbang sprad nyin nas lo nyi shu'i yun bdag dbang de rang nyid la yod pa dang / lo nyi shu'i rjes nas mu mthud bdag dbang de rang la dgos na zla drug gi sngon nas 'brel yod gong rim la snyan zhu byas nas slar lo nyi shur bdag dbang blangs chog gzhan rang nyid kyi bdag dbang de rang gi bu phrug gam nye 'brel sogs su sprod na'ang 'brel yod gong rim la snyan zhu bya dgos/ lo nyi shu'i rjes nas snyan zhu bya mkhan med tshe rgyal khab kyi spyi spyod du gyur 'gro bas der rgyal khab de yis bdag dbang bya dgos/ des na gsar gtod mdzad pa'i shes bya'i shes rig gi bdag dbang rtsom pa po'am gsar gtod mdzad pa po nyid la dbang na/rgyal khab bam mi rigs kyi shes bya mtha' dag mi rigs der dbang ba rang 217

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabazhin gyis rtogs thub/ de ni dper na nye lam krung go'i rgyal khab nas bzo bzhin pa'i chin me so'i(rsāndhulko)sman khab dang kha nā me su'ardosmukhrandhulko)sogs phyi lugs sman rdzas phal che ba 'dzam gling tshong don tshogs pa'i nang dngos su zhugs thub rjes bzo chog par mi 'dug ces tshags par du bkod yod pa'ang sman rdzas de dag gi shes rig bdag dbang krung gor med cing /phyi'i rgyal khab tu yod pas der brtsi srung byed dgos pa de yin/nye sngon krung gor shes rig bdag dbang gi shes rtogs cung dman pas mi sger gyi shes rig bdag dbang la brtsi srung ma thob pa'i gnas tshul yang mchis/ dper na spyi lo1957lor ri mo ba lo'u ci yo'u (oṃ//tshirgya)gis bris pa'i wu'u sung gis stag bsad par(tsho7༈1tsho)khyon bsdoms rigs mi 'dra ba bcu drug yod cing / khong1983lor tshe las 'das/ 1996lor khong gi bu mos rang nyid kyi a phas bris pa'i wu'u sung gis stag bsad pa'i ri mo bcu gcig par bzo bcos cung tsam byas nas hrang tung cin yang kang chang bzo grwa'i cin yang kang khreng nyang(nt+rakhyakhrithoṣāzloṣpe)gi steng bkod 'dug pa mthong / mos shes rig bdag dbang gi rtsa khrims nang bzhin gtug bsher brgyab pas/ spyi lo1997lo'i zla drug par kho mor chang bzo grwa de yis dpal 'byor gyong gud thad sgor khri nyi shu sprod rgyu dang / nyin de nas bzung cin yang chang bzo grwas ri mo de bkol mtshams 'jog rgyu bcas kyi thag bcad/ gnas tshul 'di'i khrod nas nga tshos rtogs thub pa ni phas bris pa'i ri mo'i dbang cha bu mor sprad zin zhes yig thog na med kyang bu mor dbang 218

st+waṃbardusmo0109| 0sa rwa16dzirdumis grardusku1dzukroXyod pas/ nga tsho'i yab mes kyi shul bzhag kyang nga tshor dbang dgos 'dug de ni che sa nas bshad na rgyal khab cig la rgyal khab der dbang ba'i shes rig bdag dbang mchis shing / chung sa nas bshad na gsar gtod mdzad pa'i mi sger der dbang ba'i shes rig bdag dbang mchis mi rigs shig la mtshon na mi rigs der dbang ba'i shes rig bdag dbang yang yod pa smras med yin/gnyis pa/ bod lugs sman pa tshos bod lugs gso rig gi shes rig bdag dbang la brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/krung go'i rgyal khab ni shes rig bdag dbang tshogs pa'i khongs su zhugs 'phyis rkyen da lta'i yun 'phrod bsten dang slob gso/ thon skyed sogs kyi bdag dbang gi lam lugs cha tshang byung mi 'dug pas/ yul kha shas nas sman khang dang 'phrod bsten khang sogs sger gnyer 'byor ldan pa tshor btsong zhing / de'i mjug 'bras su 'byor ldan pa tshos dpal 'byor gyi khe phan kho nar dmigs nas sgor mo len thabs byed/ dper na cang so'i su'u chon(rkuloṣṭhapo)nas sman khang tshang ma sger la btsong bar ched mkhas mi sna mang po zhig gis gshe gshe gtong bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ spyir 'phrod bsten sde khag gi las don ni nyams thag 'gro ba mi'i rigs rnams mi na ba gnas par byed cing / na ba gso bar byed pa'i thabs lam 'ba' zhig skrun rgyu de yin mod/219

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska'aphrod bsten bdag dbang gsal bo med pa'i nyin mo 'dir yul re gnyis nas yul de'i sa gnas nor srid kyi yong sgo tsam du dmigs bzhin pa'i tha shal spyod tshul yang shin tu mang / de yang 'jig rten 'dir mi'i rigs kyi shes bya med pa nas yod pa dang yod pa nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro rgyu ni gnas lugs shig tu grub/ de'i dbang gis gnas skabs nga tsho'i mig mdun na shes rig bdag dbang gi rtsa khrims tsam mchis pa 'di yang ma 'ongs par rgyal khab gzhan dang 'dra bar cha tshang ba'i ma lag cig chags par gdon mi za/des na nga tsho'i bod lugs sman pa tshos shes rig bdag dbang gi rtsa khrims la rgyab rten byas nas yul kha shas su mi re gnyis kyi longs spyod rgyas phyir byams ldan yab mes tsho'i bang so brus pa ltar gyi skyug bro ba'i bya spyod de tshor khrims mthun sgos rgol lan drag po sprod dgos/ de ltar ma byas tshe nga tsho'i bla med yab mes skyes bu dam pa rje g.yu thog pa sogs kyi mdzad rjes las sman rdzas kyi sdeb sbyor rigs mngon lkog med par pha rol bor sha la dga' ba rnams la sha'i tshul dang / khrag la dga' ba rnams la khrag gi tshul tu btsong na nga tsho'i phyi rabs gces phrug rnams kyi lag tu gyang ldebs su bris pa'i 'dod 'jo ba'i ri mo dang me long du shar ba'i baiḍūrya'i gzugs brnyan tsam 'jog rgyu las ci/ de'i rkyen gyis nga tshos gnad don 'dir bsamyo/ gzhig mi gtong ga med yin/ rang re'i bod lugs gso rig la 'di'i phyogs nas gnad don chen po bzhi 'dug pa ste re re nas brjod na/220

sas(smo010sprukau 0ba rwa16khu(mi0 grakhuskye1dzu4༷1 rgyal gnyer sman khang gang rung zhig la sman rdzas re gnyis bzo chog pa'i chog mchan thob kyang (6losbyi ) yi go rim ltar bzo sa'i cha rkyen med pas rgyang blta'i mig zung ma bgrad par rdog sne'i lam phran du bltas nas/sman pa'i rgyu drug gi bro ba spu tsam yang rang rgyud na med cing ka kha'i mgo rting mi shes pa'i sger gnyer 'byor ldan pa'am bod lugs gso rig la rgyus mnga' med pa'i sman rdzas bzo grwa sogs la btsong dang btsong bzhin pa ni/me tshan dmar po'i nang shes bzhin rkang rjen du 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'di mthong na lan rer ngu snying zhig kyang thon/2 yul de'i sa gnas srid gzhung gis gnas skabs kyi khe phan tsam du dmigs nas sngon rang nyid la yod pa'i chog mchan rnams spyang kis chos bshad pa bzhin btsan thabs kyis btsong bzhin mchis/ dpe 'di rigs ni lo gsum byis pa'i lag nas yab mes kyis gnang ba'i za phor 'phrog pa las gnyis su med/3 rgyal gnyer sman rdzas bzo grwa dang sger gnyer sman rdzas bzo grwa gang mang zhig tu bod sman gyi sbyor sde gang mang zhig thon dang thon bzhin 'dug mod/ bzo grwa de dag tu bod sman dang bod yig shes mkhan med pas/ long bas lam khrid pa'i dpe 'di spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho zhig yin nam rig gnas gong 'phel gi mtshon don zhig yin/4 bod sman bzo grwa re gnyis la (bulosbyi) yi cha rkyen yod pa ma zad/sbyor sde mang por sman rdzas 'grems spel chog mchan thob yod kyang yul so 221

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasor khyab spel gtong mi thub ces gzhan dang mnyam 'brel byed bzhin mchis/mnyam 'brel byed pa'i rgyud rim nang dpal 'byor bdag dbang dus yun thung ngu'i nang pha rol bor ches shas sprad na chog mod/ kha cig gi shes rig bdag dbang yang 'chor bzhin 'dugagong gi gnad don bzhi bor dbye zhib tsam byas na/ gnad don gsum pa ma gtogs gzhan gsum po'i khrod na phyogs gcig nas mi re gnyis la shes rig bdag dbang gi go rtogs med pa'i skyon dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas khrel med skye bo 'ga'i longs spyod rgyas phyir yin min gyi gnas tshul gang la yang bsam mno ma btang ba'i skyon bcas gnyis mchis/ lhag par gna' nas da lta'i yun phyi rol 'byor ldan pa'am srid don pa gang rung zhig gis bod kyi grub mtha' gang rung la rogs skyor ram mkhas pa gang zhig la 'bul chen bzhag pa/ yang na bod mi'i gnad don gang rung zhig la phan pa'i gtam tsam smra bar brten kho'i mtha' mjug gi dmigs byar mi lta bar da lta khos tshe rabs sngon ma'i las 'phro zin zhing / kho ni byang chub sems dpa' ga ge mo'i sprul ba de yin 'dug zer bar rang re'i bod yul 'di'i mtho dma' bar gsum kun ha cang mos/ gnas tshul 'di rgyun 'byams su song drag rkyen ma ṇi yig drug gi gzungs sngags rna bar thos ma myong ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dang rje btsun sgrol ma/ rje g.yu thog pa bcas kyi rnam sprul re gnyis kyis bod lugs gso rig gi bstan pa spel zhes mi rigs shig gi zungs khrag rngam 'thung byed bzhin pa'i snang tshul 'di skyabs rje g.yu thog 222

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska྾poordzoskyulkolkolko 136spya 2003 11 28) mdor na de ring gi nga tshor mtshon na kha sang yab mes tshos bzhag pa'i shes bya rnams la bkol spyod bdag dbang(4groṭharsā) dang don dam bdag dbajalhokṣuṣṭha)las yod tshad bdag dbajaṭhaṭwāṃṣṭha)dang thag gcod bya rgyu'i bdag dbang (klosmarsā)gnyis kyi dbang cha gtan nas med/ de'i rkyen gyis yab mes kyi bsags nor lta bu'i man ngag rnams btsong bzhin pa dag gis btsong mtshams 'jog rgyu dang btsong grabs byed bzhin pa tsho'i bsam blor 'gyur ldog 'byung rgyu ni sha rus gdung rgyud gcig pa'i spun zla tsho'i re ba yin la/ bdag gi sems khong nas rdol ba'i rtsom thung 'di'i dmigs yul yang yin/bod yig gi lam nas thengs dang por bris pa'i shes rig bdag dbang skor gyi rtsom thung 'di khyed cag gi spyan lam du phyogs pa'i skal ba tsam ldan tshe gnad don 'di rang re'i bod rigs grogs po kun gyis bsam mno gtong sa'i gnad don gal chen zhig yin 'dug snyam pa'i tshor snang zhig ster thub rgyu dang / tshor snang der brten nas khyed kyis gnad don 'di'i phyogs gang thad du zhib 'jug bya zhing de nyid don thog tu dbab par bya rgyu bcas kyi las la brtson par gyis/ bod mi'i kha dper bshad drags na pha gtam bur gnod zer ba ltar skabs bab gong tsam gyis chog par bya/bdag gi rtsom thung 'dir mkho med lab rdol lta bu'i gnas tshul 'dra lhag yod tshe de rigs dor bar bya zhing gnad che ba'i gnas tshul gang mang zhig 224

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaman ngag rin chen ril bu'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang de'i phan nus tsam brjod pa bla ma'i zhal lung /dang po/ man ngag rin chen ril bu'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/de yang sngar gyi gzhung chen rnams su ma grags shing da lta'i lag len khrod mthong dkon pa'i man ngag rin chen sbyor ba 'di/ lnga rig smra ba'i dbang bo rje btsun dam pa mdzod dge nyi ma mchog gi thugs bcud las 'khrungs pa zhig yin/ mdzod dge nyi ma mchog ni nang don rig pa dang tshad ma rig par mkhas pa'i dge bshes shig yin zhing rig gnas gsar brje chen mo'i rlung 'tshub khrod nas bod kyi rig gnas srung skyob byed zhor bod yig gi slob grwa sgrub pa'i slob gso ba chen mo zhig las/ bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung dang lag len gyis phyug pa'i gso byed pa zhig dang bod sman slob gso ba zhig tu brtsi mkhan nyung / re gnyis kyis khong ni bod lugs gso rig la mtshon na sman gyi brgyud pa med pa'i em chi zhig kyang yin par 'dod/ don dam du rje btsun dam pa khong nyid bod lugs gso rig la mkhas pa'i dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar bzhin tshad ldan bla mar bsten nas 'tshar longs byung 226

st+waṃs(smo010spru| 0ba 116dzirdumib hphukhuspu101bakhub zhig yin/ de ni khong nyid dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i chu rta(1942)lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes nyer bdun gyi nub mo khong gi 'dzin grwa gcig pa'i slob grogs gsum dang lhan dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams kyi phyogs su phebs mgo brtsams/ sde dge rdzong gsar du phebs rjes mkhyen brtse rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros kyi zhabs la gtugs te zla gcig lhag gi yun dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dbang lung khrid gsum dang zin tig ma bu cha tshang khrid pa'i go skabs thob/ spyir bla ma'i gdams ngag gser gyis nyo dgos mod/ skabs der khong ni slong mo ba zhig yin pas thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i bla ma mkhyen brtse rin po cher rten 'brel du lam bar nas gzhan la bslangs pa'i rtsam skya tsam phul ba yin gsungs/dam pa 'di ni mdzod dge nyi ma mchog gi blo ngor ches thog mar bod lugs gso rig gi sa bon gtor mkhan yin/de nas dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i shing sprel( 194cilo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i nang khong gi dge rgan sog po zhi ba lha'i thugs smon ltar/ reb tsha sku zhogs sam tā dbon chos mdzad kyis zhus ngor phyag na padmo'i rnam sprul rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i bla sman pa rtsed thang em chi'am mkhyen rab nor bu mchog las g.yu thog sman dbang yongs rdzogs dang dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i klog lung / tshe dbang bdud 'joms bka' srung gi gtad rgya dang bcas gsan/ skabs de dang bstun nas zla brgyad kyi yun mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gi zhal snga nas rin chen btso bkru chen mo'i phyag len dmar 227

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakhrid dang sman rdzas so so'i 'dul sbyong / 'bras spungs dge 'phel rir phebs nas sngo sman rigs kyi ngos 'dzin sogs gdams ngag rgya cher thob/des na mkhyen rab nor bu mchog ni dam pa khong nyid la rin chen btso bkru chen mo'i phyag len dmar khrid gnang mkhan dang / rigs mi 'dra ba'i sman rdzas so so'i 'dul sbyong dang sngo sman rnams mdzub mos ri ston gyi tshul du ngo sprod gnang mkhan yang yin pa ni gong du skabs de'i lo zla dang der 'brel yod kyi mi sna rnams gsal cha ldan par bkod zin pa 'dis gsal/de nas dgung lo nyer bzhi nas so gnyis bar rang yul stag tshang lha mo'i kirti dgon nas sgra dang snyan ngag tshad ma rig pa sogs la sbyangs zhor a lags gtsang bla rin po che'am khri zur blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho mchog gi zhabs la gtugs te gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la phyogs gang thad nas sbyangs brtson legs par mdzad cing / lhag par sman rdzas kyi ngos 'dzin dang sdeb sbyor byed thabs kyi gdams ngag rnams rgya cher thob/ dgung lo nyer brgyad bzhes pa'i chu sprul lor dam pa de yi mdun nas g.yu thog snying thig gi sman dbang dang / dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ dbang gi lha mo rig byed ma bcas kyi rjes gnang gsan bzhes kyi skal ba thob/ skabs de ni mdzod dge nyi ma mchog la mtshon na gcig nas sngar bod lugs gso rig la bag chags bzhag 'dug par bskyar sbyongs dang / gnyis nas gom gang mdun spos kyi tshul du sngar las gting zab tu 'jug pa'i go skabs zhig yin/228

sa0rdusmo010sprukau 0sa 116rdurdumi0 7khu61dzu1gokhudes na dam pa khong ni sman brgyud med pa'i em chi zhig gtan nas min par bod gso byed pa snga rabs pa'i lugs srol ltar tshad ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i gzhung dang lag len la dpyis phyin par sbyangs shing / sbyangs 'bras der brten nas sngar med gsar gtod byed mkhan zhig tu mchis/ dper na bod lugs sman rdzas phyugs rigs la bkol zhing rigs mi 'dra ba'i phyugs so so'i thun tshad gtan la dbab/ de lta bu'i gzhung lugs shig gtan du phab rjes rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs yin kyang gong rim la snyan zhu bgyis nas bod sman phyugs sman ched las slob grwa sgrub/ ched las slob grwa de ru dus da lta'ang bod sman phyugs sman ched las slob ma bsdu bzhin mchis/ gzhan skabs der khong gis bod sman gyis sman khab bzos pa sogs sngar ma mchis pa'i phyag len dang sdeb sbyor sogs kyang mang du mdzad/nad brgya sman cig gam ldan 'dus nad la ba mor nyi shar bzhin gyur ba'i man ngag rin chen ril bu 'di dam pa khong gis dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la bag chags mdzad skabs su sman rtsis rig pa'i gtsug rgyan mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis gnang ba yin nam/ sde dge rdzong gsar mkhyen brtse rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros dang khri zur blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi sus gnang ba yin par bsam mno btang tshe/ sbyor sde 'di ni dam pa khong gi blo stobs las 'khrungs pa zhig las mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gam khri zur blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs kyis gnang 229

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskaba'i gdams ngag cig min par bsam/ ci'i phyir zhe na khong nyid la rin chen btso bkru dang rin po che'i 'dul sbyong gi phyag len gnang mkhan mkhyen rab nor bu mchog nyid yin zhing / mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis gcig nas 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag rin po che zhig khong nyid gcig pur gnang mi srid/ gnyis nas mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gi phyag len yin tshe da lta lha ldan sman rtsis khang sogs su sbyor ba 'di yod dgos kyang mthong chos su dben pas so// gsum nas ril bu 'di'i sbyor sder bltas tshe gzhung snga ma rnams su de dang cha 'dra ba zhig med pas so// bzhi nas spyir dam pa khong nyid kyis bu slob rnams la rig gnas gang zhig khrid gnang mdzad kyang rang nyid kyi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus gsal bshad gnang mkhan zhig yin yang / spyi lo( 1977)lor khong gi thugs bkod ltar nyid nas bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo grags pa rgya mtsho mchog dang kirti'i skal kho rnam gnyis la mdzod dge rdzong bzhag sdom zhang du rin chen btso bkru'i phyag rgyun gnang skabs man ngag rin chen gyi gdams pa yang gnang mod/ khong nyid kyi zhal snga nas btso bkru'i phyag len 'di rtsed thang em chi'am mkhyen rab nor bu'i phyag rgyun yin gsungs pa las man ngag rin chen gyi phyag len 'di su'i yin pa'i skor ma gsungs/ skabs 'di nas nga tshos gsal rtogs thub pa ni dam pa khong nyid dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas rjes mdo smad phyogs nas ches thog mar rin chen btso bkru'i phyag rgyun spel mkhan yang yin 'dug bdag gis 'di ltar 'bri don yang man ngag rin chen gyi brgyud pa'i chu bo'i mgo 230

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprukyā 0go rwa16rdu(30 krornguzu1010khukhungs gang du thug yod par brtag zhor dam pa gong ma rnam pa'i yon tan rjes su dran pa'i tshul tsam lags/ gnyis pa/ man ngag rin chen ril bu'i phan nus/skabs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i man ngag rin chen ril bu 'di'i phan nus mdor bsdus su bkod na/ mdzod dge nyi ma'i thugs bcud las 'khrungs pa'i// man ngag rin chen ril bu'i phan nus ni// mdze nad dreg grum chu ser pags nad rigs// mo nad rlung tshabs mngal skran mkhal ma'i nad// pho smug mgul 'gag da rgan rus 'phel nad// skra byi spyi ther rnams la mchog tu bsngags// zhes dang / gtso bo'i phan nus rnams re re nas dper mtshon dang bcas te brjod na gsham gsal ltar/(1)mdze nad la mtshon na/ spyi lo1978lor klu chu rdzong shis tshang zhang dgun sa sde ba'i mi zhig gi lus yongs skrangs shing mgo bor rmas khengs pa/skra dang smin ma kha spu sogs byi zhing shul du spu nyag gcig kyang med par gyur ba la/ kun gyis gso bya der mdze nad byung 'dug ces 'brel 'dris byed mi yang med par gyur/ skabs der mdzod dge nyi ma'i thugs sras bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags pa rgya mtshos gso bya der man ngag rin chen ril bu gcig pu 'thung du bcug nas zla drug tsam 'gor rjes/ thog mar gso bya'i mgo bor skra dkar 'ga' skyes shing rim bzhin skra rdzob je mthug tu gyur ba dang lhan smin ma dang kha spu yang dkar por skyes/ mu mthud gso 231

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskasman de kho na bsten du bcug nas lo gcig tsam song mtshams su mgo skra dang smin ma sogs nag por gyur zhing rgyun ldan du gyur/ dus da lta'ang gso bya de yis khong la bka' drin che zhes mtheb mdzub bsgrengs bzhin 'dug(2)dreg grum gyi nad la mtshon na/ nad gzhi 'di gnyis las kyang gtso bo grum bu'i nad la phan gyin 'dug dper na grum bu'i nad phog nas yun ring son rjes mal stan las 'gul skyod mi thub pa'i gso bya 'ga' yang yar langs thub par gyur/ grum nad las kyang rigs gang la gtso cher phan pa sogs bdag gis bris pa'i grum bu'i nad kyi ngos 'dzin dang bcos thabs tsam brjod pa nyi gzhon bsu ba'i skya rengs zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom du 'khod zin pas 'dir bskyar zlos mi bya'o//(3)chu ser las byung ba'i pags nad rigs la mtshon na/ spyi lo 2003lor stag tsha lha mo'i kirti dgon gyi btsun pa zhig gi lus yongs rma shun mthug pos g.yog par khrin tu'u grong khyer gyi sman khang che khag tu yun ring bsten yang phan 'bras ma byung bas/ rgan grags pa rgya mtsho mchog la bsten pas khong gis gso bya der man ngag chen chen ril bu gcig pu 'thung du bcug cing nyin bco lnga tsam gyi rjes su rim bzhin pags steng gi rma shun rnams bud par gyur/ zla gsum la btung du bcug pas sangs drag byung /gzhan yang si khron mi li nas yin pa'i bod ljongs gso rig slob chen gyi slob ma zhig gi 'doms bar du rma 'brum thon zhing rlon par gyur ba dang der za 'phrug che bar gang sar bsten yang phan 'bras ma thon pas/ gso bya der 232

sa0(smo010sprusnga 00 rwa16khuspyomis 7khuzu10yokhunyin lnga ru man ngag rin chen ril bu btung du bcug par/ rim bzhin rma 'brum dang za 'phrug sogs med par gyur/(rimo nad rlung tshabs dang mngal skran rigs la mtshon na/ bdag gis mngal ske ru rma byung rkyen khams dkar mang du 'dzag pa'i gso bya de rigs sum cu yas mas la sman 'di btung du bcug pas/ kun gyis ha cang phan zer/ gzhan bu snod kyi g.yon stod 'gram du 'dug pa'i bsam bse'u'i rtsa lam na che chung4 phro⑪smo4 kre⑪yod pa'i mngal skran can gyi gso bya zhig la sman khab rgyag zhor gso sman 'di gtso bor bzung nas bsten du bcug par/nyin bcu gnyis kyi rjes su2 sgra rlabs nas bskyar brtag byas tshe skran de yongs su zhi 'dug(5)spyir mkhal nad rigs tshang mar phan yang gtso bo mkhal 'grams dang mkhal ma'i chu skran/ mkhal grang bcas la shin tu phan/ dper na mkhal 'grams bar rgyas dang smad lhung nad kyis dgye dgu dang 'gul skyod dka' ba'i gso bya nyi shu lhag la sman 'di btang bar/ mang che bar nyin bdun brgyad nas sangs drag dang / re gnyis la btung yun de las ring dgos pa'am sangs drag 'byung mi thub pa'i snang tshul yang mchis kyang phan med gcig kyang mthong ma song / gzhan yang 2sgra rlabs nas brtag rjes mkhal ma'i chu skran du ngos bzung ba'i gso bya zhig la sman 'di 'thung du bcug pas shin tu phan 'dug(6)mgo bor glo bur du skra kor kor byas nas byi 'gro ba'i rigs kyi gso 233

bod lugs gso rig gi dpyad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabya lnga tsam la sman 'di zla gcig nas gsum bar btung du bcug pas/ de rnams la sngon bzhin skra skye thub par gyur/(7)pho smug dang mgul 'gag da rgan/ rus 'phel nad rnams la phan pa'i skor bdag gis bris pa'i bad kan mgul 'gags dang smug po pho bar babs pa gnyis la brtag bcos byas pa'i myong tshor phran bu dang / da rgan nad kyi brtag bcos bla ma'i dgongs rgyan zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom gnyis su cung rgyas bshad kyi tshul du 'khod 'dug pas de'i skor yang 'dir bskyar zlos mi bya/spyir sman mchog man ngag rin chen ril bu'i phan nus bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / 'dir gcig nas de'i gtso bo'i phan nus rnams dpe mtshon tsam dang / gnyis nas rgan grags pa rgya mtsho mchog dang phran nyid nas nad thog steng sman 'di'i phan nus la cung gsal rtogs byung ba'i rigs rnams skabs 'dir bkod pa yin/ de yang rgan grags pa rgya mtshos bdag la kho bos da lta'i yun gso bya khri phrag mang por sman sprad mod/ bcos sdug nad la man ngag rin chen ril bu las phan pa zhig mi 'dug gsungs/ skabs der bdag gis khong gi gsungs mchid der do snang cher ma bgyis kyang / da lta rang nyid nas gso bcos byas pa'i myong tshor du'ang de lta bu'i sdom tshig cig mi 'jog ga med yin 'dugaskra4

st+waṃsardusmo010spru| 0sa 116dzirduskya0 krokhuskye1dzu1sadzigasum pa/ mjug bsdu ba/spyir rje btsun dam pa mdzod dge nyi ma mchog gis mdzad rjes ni de las gzhan ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’ skabs mdo smad nas ches thog mar bod yig slob grwa dang bod sman phyugs sman slob grwa btsugs shing / slob grwa de gnyis kyi ming du si khron zhing chen rnga ba khul bod yig slob 'bring dang si khron zhing chen rnga ba khul bod sman phyugs sman slob grwa zhes zer/ khong gis slob grwa de ru slob ma rnams la dpe khrid mdzad zhor phyogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i bod sman phyugs sman mi snar yang dpe khrid mdzad/ skabs der khong gis gso ba rig pa'i skor gyi dpe khrid mdzad skabs rgyud bzhi las tshig gcig kyang ma dor bar mgo nas rgya gar skad du dang sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo zhes srol rgyun ltar byed/ gso ba rig pa ma yin pa'i rig gnas gzhan rnams khrid kyang de bzhin byed/gnas tshul de'i dbang gis bung ba padmar 'khor ba bzhin bod kyi rig gnas la dung zhen che ba'i bu slob rnams mang nas mang du phyin rkyen bod ljongs dang si khron kan su'u yun nan mtsho sngon sogs gang sa nas 'ongs pa'i ched las mi 'dra ba'i slob ma sum stong brgyad brgya lhag gso skyong byas/gzhan skabs der gso rig rgyud bzhi dang bai sngon sogs nub par dogs nas rigs mi 'dra ba'i glegs bam mang po snum par brgyab rjes de'i phyogs su blo kha 'khor ba'i mkhas dbang dang bod rig gnas kyi rgyud spel bzhin pa'i lte gnas sogs la bskur gnang mdzad/ khong gis bskyangs pa'i slob skra5

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskam de dag gi khrod na da lta skad grags che ba'i dgon pa'i dgon bdag bla ma dang dge bshes/ rtsom pa po/ dge rgan/ sman pa sogs mang du 'dugakhong gis 'di lta bu'i rlabs chen gyi bgyi ba zhig don du gnyer skabs sa 'og gi dgon pa dang srol rgyun ngan pa'i rgyun skyong mkhan sogs kyi ming btags nas lan rer brdung brdeg gi mnar gcod kyang mang du 'khel/ khong ni mi rigs 'di'i rig gnas srung skyob dang dar spel gyi ched du mi tshe 'bul mkhan zhig yin phyin paṇa chen sku phreng gong mas kyang khong la gzengs bstod gnang ba dang lhan khong gi bzhugs mal du'ang sku dngos bzhugs gnang mdzad/ gzhan skyabs rje gung thang rin po che nas kyang khong la khyod kyis nye sngon bod kyi rig gnas srung skyob sogs kyi ched dka' las mang po brgyab pa dang / der g.yur za'i 'bras bu yang smin 'dug da dung lo shas yun de bzhin byed dgos zhes pa'i bka' gsung byon/ spyir mdzod dge nyi ma khong gi rnam thar ni ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa gda' mod/ bdag gis bris pa 'dir brjod 'dod rnams tshul bzhin bkod ma thub pa'am dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gang mang zhig lus 'dug pa sogs mang /mdor na ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’ rlung 'tshub khrod nas bod lugs gso rig gtsor byas pa'i bod kyi rig gnas myur skyob dang dar spel gyi ched du thabs brgya jus stong gis las la brtson zhing / der skyabs rje gung thang rin po che nas gsungs pa ltar g.yur za'i 'bras bu smin pa zhig ni mdo smad phyogs na re gnyis tsam las mi 'dug ces brjod chog chog yin/2smo

st+waṃbardusmo010sprushā 0zhwa 116rdurdumib 7khuzu1dzu1sadzimajug mthar dpyad rtsom 'di brgyud de rigs mthun skye bo gang mang zhig gi blo ngor mdzod dge nyi ma zhes pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi sna 'di'i bag chags tsam yod rgyu ni dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri ba'i dmigs yul dang po yin/ de ni mi rigs la byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mkhas chen rnams la rjes su yi rangs bya rgyu ni nged cag mi rigs sam yang na 'dzam gling yongs kyi spyod lam legs po zhig ma yin nam/237

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskakhu ba dang rkang klad pa bsam bse'u bcas kyi 'brel ba'i skor phran tsam gleng ba/de yang dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud du lus zungs kyi dwangs ma'i cha rnams ches mdor bsdus sgos dwangs ma khrag sha tshil rus rkang khu ba bcas bdun gyi khongs su 'dus par byas shing / gzhung tshig 'dir phyi rabs pas 'grel mdzad skabs mang che bas dwangs ma las khrag dang khrag las sha/ sha las tshil/ tshil las rkang / rkang las khu bar 'gyur zhes gsungs pa las/ skabs 'di'i brjod gzhir gyur ba'i klad pa ni dwangs snyigs gang gi khongs su gtogs pa'i nges pa rnyed dka'/ dper na mes po'i zhal lung dang bai sngon du thog ma'i dwangs ma de yang mchin pa'i gnas su slebs pa'i tshe/ mchin pa la gnas pa'i bad mkhris rlung gsum gyi bya ba byas pa la brten nas de'i dwangs ma rnams khrag 'ba' zhig tu gyur la/ khrag gi dwangs ma de yang sha'i gnas su song ba'i tshe de'i dwangs ma de rnams las sha 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ro// de bzhin du sha yi dwangs ma de tshil gyi gnas su song ba'i tshe de'i dwangs ma de rnams tshil du 'gyur zhing / tshil gyi dwangs ma de las ni rus par 'gyur la/ rus pa'i dwangs ma de las rkang mar du 238

st+waṃbardusmo010spru| 0sa 116khurdumib graX610krodzi'agyur ba dang / rkang mar de las kyang khu ba ste khams dkar dmar du 'gyur ba yin no zhes gsungs/ dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa ru'ang /dwangs ma las khrag de las sha// sha las tshil te de las rus// rus rkang de las khu ba yin zhes gsungs 'dug pas/ gzhung lugs 'dir rgyus mnga' che ba'i skye bo gang mang zhig gis rkang las thad kar khu ba dkar dmar gnyis su 'gyur bar bsam/ yang so ma rā dza ru/ klad pa'i snying dang 'brel ba ste//la la klad pa'i rgya yang zer// dbus na sa bon bcud kyi rtsa// lus kyi bde ba rgyas par byed// ces dang / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos su/ skyes pa'i lus kyi dwangs ma khrag yin cing // khrag gi dwangs ma 'dus pa thig le ste// zhes gsungs yod pa mthong tshe gang mang zhig gis lus zungs bdun gyi phyi ma khu ba'i 'gyur tshul thad dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang so ma rā dza/ dge chos kyi 'dod pa'i bstan bcos gsum gyi dgongs pa so sor 'dug par 'dod cing / re gnyis kyis gong gsum las gang zhig don dngos dang mthun pas 'thad ldan du 'jog cing gang zhig dor byar brtsi ba sogs kyi kha tshod gcod dang gcod mus su mchis/ don ngo mar dgongs don phyi ma gnyis kyang rgyud kyi dgongs pa las gnyis su med/ de ni re re nas bshad na gsham gsal ltar te/dang po/ klad pa dang khu ba'i 'brel ba/lus zungs rnams dwangs ma nas rim bzhin phyi mar 'gyur ba'i brgyud 239

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kunda dasas pa'i zla zeskarim nang sbubs su yod pa'i rkang rnams su 'gyur la/ klad pa dang gzhung pa'ang rus sbubs su gnas pas rkang gi khongs su gtogs/ de ni skyem pa'i tshig don nyi ma las/ rus pa rus pa'i me drod kyis smin cing dwangs snyigs phye ba las dwangs ma rkang mar dang / de'i khongs su gtogs pa klad pa dang gzhung par gyur zhes dang / dpal mgon gyi 'grel ba las/ rus pa'i bu gar rus pa'i me drod kyis smin par byas pa las/ dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye nas rus pa'i dwangs ma rkang mar la yang rkang zhun bu dang lha ba klad pa'o//klad pa'i dwangs ma de rkang dang gzhung pa'i dwangs ma rnams so// rus pa'i snyigs ma so sen mor 'gyur ro// rkang pa'i bu gar rkang pa'i me drod kyi smin par byas pa las/ dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye nas/ rkang gi dwangs ma khu bar 'gyur zhes gsungs pas so// de na skyem pa tshe dbang dang dpal mgon gyi dgongs pa rgyud dang mes zhal bee sngon sogs dang ma mthun pa yin nam zer na/ de gtan nas min te/ bshad rgyud du lus zungs rnams ches mdor bsdus sgos gsungs shing / der mes zhal dang bai sngon du de bzhin ches mdor bsdus sgos 'grel ba mdzad la/ rgyud sogs su'ang klad pa dang gzhung pa rkang gi khongs su bsdus 'dug pa ni rgyud kyi dug gi le'u ru/ rus las klad gzhung rkang du 'gyur ba'i phyir// zhes dang / gzhan bshad rgyud du/rkang zad sbubs stong mgo mkhor mig 'grib 'gyur// zhes gsungs don yang rkang gi khongs gtogs klad pa zad tshe klad gnas mgo bo stong zhing mgo yu 'khor ba sogs 'byung ba dag gis gsal/ snang tshul 'di'i 'og nas nga 240

st+waṃ0rdusmo010sprusnga 00 116dzi(mi0 7rduzu1khu1sakhutshor gsal rtogs thob rgyu zhig 'dug pa ni gzhung gang dang gang du rkang zhes 'dug tshe rkang kho nar go ba mi len par de'i khongs gtogs klad pa dang gzhung pa sogs su go min dpyad rgyu de yin/ de'i rkyen gyis bshad rgyud du dwangs ma khrag sha tshil rus rkang khu ba zhes rkang gi dwangs ma las khu ba thon zhes pa'ang mdor bsdus sgos gsungs pa las khu ba'i 'byung gzhi dngos klad pa yin pa ni zla rgyal las/ nang gi ljon shing rtsa bzhi dang // spyi bo dag tu 'dus pa ni// rlung gis lus kyi sa bon bzung // tshangs pa dung gi 'khor lo ste// lus zungs sa bon rtsa yin no// zhes dang / bai sngon du/ klad pa dang gzhung pa nas sa bon dkar dmar gnyis su smin zhes gsungs yod pas khu ba'i 'byung gnas rkang gi khongs gtogs klad pa yin par bye brag tu ngos bzung yod pas gsal/ de yang rgyud bzhi'i mgo rting bar gsum la rgyus lon cung zad byas tshe rgyud rang du yang de bzhin gsungs 'dug ste/ dper na sbyar dug gso ba'i le'u ru/ klad gzhung sa bon dkar dmar gnyis su smin zhes gsungs pas so// yang mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos su/ skyes pa'i lus kyi dwangs ma khrag yin cing // khrag gi dwangs ma 'dus pa thig le ste zhes dang / yang de las/zas kyi khu ba thigs pa bdun tsam gyis// mi yi lus la khrag thigs gcig 'grub cing // khrag gi thigs pa dkar yol gang tsam las// khu ba thigs pa phra mo gcig tsam 'grub ces gsungs par/ dpal ldan gso rig la rgyus mnga' dben pa'i mi zhig gis bltas tshe khrag las thad kar khu bar 'gyur 241

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabazhin pa'i snang ba zhig ster mod/ dam pa khong nyid de tsam mi rtogs shing mi'i lus kyi shes byar rgyus mnga' med pa'i skye bu zhig gtan nas min/skabs 'di'i brjod don dngos ni khrag nas sha dang / de nas tshil de nas rus de nas rkang de nas khu ba rnams su 'gyur ba'i brgyud rim dag bsdus nas gong ltar gsungs/ zhar byung yang de las/ zla mtshan dus kyi dang po'i nyin gsum la// bud med gcig pur dben pa'i phyogs su sdod// bzhi ba'i nyin mor lus kun khrus bya zhing // dri bzang snum gyis bsku zhing legs par bya// nyin 'di rnams su gal te 'khrig byed na// shin tu ma rung gdol ba'i spyod par 'gyur// zla mtshan babs nas lnga ba bdun pa dgu// de bzhin bcu gcig bcu gsum bco lnga yi// nyin 'di rnams la gal te mngal chags na// bu mo skye bar 'gyur bas spangs kyang rung // drug pa brgyad pa bcu dang bcu gnyis nyin// de bzhin bcu bzhi'i nyin mo 'di rnams la//nyal bo brten cing gal te mngal chags na// skyes pa'i phru gu bu ru 'byung ba yin// zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyud du/ gcig gsum lnga bdun dgu la bur 'gyur te// gnyis dang bzhi drug brgyad par bu mor 'gyur// zhes gsungs 'dug pa gnyis kyang zhib brtag ma bgyis tshe cung mi mthun pa 'dra mod/ legs par dpyad na mdo don gcig tu mchis te/ rgyud bzhir zla mtshan 'bab yun nyin gsum byas shing / nyin bzhi ba de dang por brtsis/'dod bstan du nyin bzhi bar dri bzang snum gyi bsku mnye bya ba'i nyin du bzhag cing de'i phyi nyin nyin lnga bar rtsis/ de'i dbang gis rgyud du gsungs 242

st+waṃsardusmo010pyi| 0ba 116khurdumi0 gradzizu101bakhupa'i skabs 'dir ya grangs kyi nyin rnams 'dod bstan du cha grangs kyi nyin du gyur/ de bzhin rgyud du gsungs pa'i cha grangs kyi nyin yang 'dod bstan du ya grangs kyi nyin du gyur/ zhar byung 'di ltar bkod don yang las dang po ba re 'gas dge chos kyi 'dod bstan dang gso rig rgyud bzhi'i dgongs don gnyis tha dad du 'dug zer bar/ de ltar ma yin zhing phyogs gang thad nas dgongs don gcig tu 'khums pa'i ra sprod tsam du skabs 'di'i dpyad rtsom dang 'brel med pa'i tshan pa 'di bkod pa lags/klad pa de khu ba'i dngos rgyu dang brgyud rgyu gnyis las brgyud rgyu yin/dngos rgyu yin tshe rang gi bskyed bya'i 'bras bu de dang bar du rgyu'i chos gzhan brgyud mi dgos par skyed nus pa'i rgyu yin dgos shing / brgyud rgyu yin tshe rang gi 'bras bu de skyed byed yin yang rang gis dngos su skyed par 'bras bu de'i rgyun zhig skyed cing de brgyud nas rang gi 'bras bu de skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin dgos pas/ klad pa nas bu 'dzin byed kyi khams dkar dmar la smin dgos pa'i bar du rgyu'i rkyen gzhan dang 'phrad dgos pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa/ bsam bse'u dang khu ba'i 'brel ba/bsam bse'u zhes pa ni yang tig zab gsang lde mig las/ bsam bse'u ni khams dkar dmar gsog pa'i snod/ 'dod pa'i bde ba myong ba'i rten/mngal gnas lus can 'tsho ba'i bcud kyi yur ba/ sbrum bu'i phyi'i lha gos bcas yin no// zhes dang / yang byang ba'i yan lag brgyad pa ru/ khams 243

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rṣa gces btus kyā dgyes pa'i zla zeskakun 'dus pa dkar dmar gyi// snyigs ma gsog snod bsam bse'u// thun mong phyir na don kun 'brel// zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam bse'u ni klad pa nas smin pa'i khu ba de lus kyi gang sar khyab pa rnams bsdu gsog byed mkhan gyi gsog snod cig yin zhing / der gtso bo'i bsam bse'u dang cha shas bsam bse'u gnyis su mchis/ de ni byang ba'i yan lag brgyad pa ru/ bu snod gsang sgro 'di'i dum bu// zhes dang / yang pod dmar las/ khams kun 'dus pa bsam bse'u ni// thun mong phyir na don kun 'brel// pho mo'i sa bon 'byung ba'i snod// bu snod gsang sgro'ang 'di'i dum bu// yin phyir snod drug grangs su 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar tshigs pa bcu gsum 'og gnas pa de gtso bo'i bsam bse'u dang / pho'i gsang sgro dang mo'i bu snod gnyis ni cha shas bsam bse'u yin 'dug pa gsal/ klad pa nas rim bzhin smin pa'i khu ba de rgyu lam gang du brten nas gsang sgror babs pa yin zhe na/ rdo rje gling ba'i rtsa rlung thig le'i skor las/ 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma khams byang chub sems kyi thig le zhes pa de lus gnas gang nas babs pa yin snyam na/ dper na lo 'dabs ldan pa'i shing gi rtser char gyi zil ba chags pa de rlung gis g.yos pa'am skyes bu gang dag gi lag pas bskul ba sogs kyi rkyen las zil ba de dag sa yi steng du lhung bas sa gzhi brlan zhing rtsi thog skyes pa ltar/ 'byung lnga'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams lus kyi cha shas kun la khyab cing gnas pa las skyes bu gang dga' bzhi'i bde ba 'phel te bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i tshe khyab byed rlung gi byed las kyis khams kun 244

sasardu'i010spru| 00 rwa16khurdumigo ⑪khuskye1dzukrokhugayos pa'i dwangs ma de bsam bse'u zhes tshigs pa bcu gsum gyi g.yon ngos kyi rtsa lam der 'dus skabs thur sel rlung gis thur du drangs te padmo'i lam nas mngal gyi sbubs su bskyal bas/ ma'i thur sel rlung ngam 'dzin 'bri'i rlung gis 'dzin pas mngal chags pa'i sa bon byed pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar sa'i rlangs pa nam mkhar 'thim pa'i dpe bzhin bsam bse'u'i gnas su gsog yang dge chos kyi 'dod bstan du/ gzugs can dngos po dkrugs shing bsrub pa na// rang gi snying bo 'byin pa chos nyid de//sprin dag bsrubs na char ba'i rgyun 'bebs shing // shing dag bsrubs na me lce 'byung ba 'dra// de bzhin 'o ma'i bcud ni mar yin kyang // dang po 'o ma'i nang du 'dres te gnas// 'on kyang zom du blugs nas dgrogs pa na// 'o ma rnams la rim gyis drod langs nas// nang gi bcud rnams thon nas zur du 'ong // de bzhin khrag gi dwangs ma thig le yang // dang po khrag gi nang du thim nas yod// 'on kyang pho mo sbyar nas bsrubs pa na// chags pa'i stobs kyis khrag la drod langs nas// mar dang 'dra ba'i khu ba 'thon te 'ong // zas kyi khu ba thigs pa bdun tsam gyis// mi yi lus la khrag thigs gcig 'grub cing // khrag gi thigs pa dkar yol gang tsam las//khu ba'i thigs pa phra mo gcig tsam 'grub// ces gsungs pa yang gong gi dgongs don dang gcig tu 'khums te/ de ni khu ba'i cha rnams lus kyi gang sar khyab yod cing / khyab yod pa'i khu ba de phor mtshon na 'khrig sbyor skabs gtso bo'i bsam bse'u'i gnas brgyud de gsang sgror 'bab/ 'dir 245

bod lugs gso rig gi dgrad rṣa gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zega'abab par byed pa klad pa'i skul nus dgos shing / skul nus der brten nas lus kyi gang sar khyab pa'i cha rnams 'o ma las mar bton pa bzhin khrag gi 'khor skyod du brten te mjug mthar cha shas kyi bsam bse'u gnas gsang sgror gsog dgos pas so// gnas der bu 'dzin byed kyi khams dkar sa bon dngos la smin pa'i byed las mchis/ bud med kyi mngal gnas su de bzhin bu 'dzin byed kyi khams dmar sa bon dngos la smin pa'i byed las mchis/ de na gtso bo'i bsam bse'u yi nus par brten nas thog mar tshigs pa bcu gsum 'og 'dus shing / de nas cha shas bsam bse'u yi nus par brten nas pho mo so sor bu 'dzin byed kyi khams dkar dmar gnyis su smin dgos pas/ bsam bse'u ni khu ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin 'dug de yang rang gi lhan cig byed 'bras rang gi rdzas rgyun ma yin par gtso bor skyed byed de lhan cig byed rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin pas/ bsam bse'u ni khu ba'i rdzas rgyun ma yin yang de'i byed las kyis gsog cing smin par byed pas na'o//gzhan yang so ma rā dza ru/ klad pa'i snying dang 'brel ba ste// la la klad pa'i rgya yang zer// dbus na sa bon bcud kyi rtsa// lus kyi bde ba rgyas par byed// ces gsungs pa de ni klad pa nas khams dkar dmar thad kar bsam bse'u ru rgyu sa'i nges gtan gyi lam zhig min la/ de yang rgyud las/klad pa rtsa yi rgya mtsho chen po las// rtsa ba lta bur thur du zug pa yi// bya ba byed pa'i chu rtsa bcu dgu yod// ces gsungs pa'i rtsa bcu dgu bo'i khongs 2slo

st+waṃ0rdusmo010spru5 00 rwa1khyidzirdumi0 krodziskye1khu1paXsu rtsa 'di thad kar mi gtogs kyang bcu dgu zhes pa ni rags pa'i dbang du gsungs pa las de min gyi bya ba byed pa'i chu rtsa gang mang yod pa'ang smras med yin/ de'i rkyen gyis klad pa las byung ba'i sa bon bcud kyi rtsa 'di'i byed las kyis lus kyi gang sar khyab pa'i khams dkar dmar lhan cig bsdu bar byed pas na de bzhin brjod do// 247

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeskabod yig ni bod lugs gso rig gi srog shing yin pa'i skor phran tsam brjod pa bden gtam mtsho byung lha mo'i pi wang /skad dang yi ge ni mi rigs shig grub byed kyi bla srog gtso bo yin la/yul srol goms gshis dang chos lugs gnyis ni bla srog ldan pa'i mi rigs de'i rgyan gos lta bu yin/nga tsho spre'u byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud pa gangs can pa tshor mtshon na thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs shig grub byed kyi bla srog ldan la de mdzes spras bdag skyong byed spyad kyi rgyan gos kyang ldan/ ngo ma nga tsho ni bla srog med pa'i mi rigs sam gos med sgren mor rgyu ba'i mi rigs shig gtan nas min/spyir mi rigs zhes par si ta len gyis kyang mi rigs shig yin phyin der spyi mthun gyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba dang / spyi mthun gyi sa'i khyab khongs/ spyi mthun gyi skad yig dang bsam pa'i 'du shes bcas cha rkyen bzhi bo 'di tshang na da gzod mi rigs zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dogs chog ces gsungs pa ltar/mi rigs grub byed kyi cha rkyen rnams 'u cag la 'dzoms yod pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i mes po tshos rang nyid kyi bla srog der brten nas go la zlum po'i steng na 248

st+waṃsardusmo010smya| 0sa 116khurdumis krokhuzu1khu1sardusu la'ang gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rig gnas bcu'i bang mdzod bskrun/bang mdzod 'dir 'jig rten pa tshor mtshon na 'dzad med longs spyod rgyas byed dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu ldan la/ dam pa lha chos pa tshor mtshon na thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phangs su bgrod sa'i bde lam ldan/ de'i rkyen gyis ngas thog mar de ring 'di nas sngon byon byams ldan yab mes tshor sgo gsum gus pas phyag gsum 'tshal rgyu dang / de nas bdag lta bu'i skye bo re gnyis la 'jigs snang dang bsam gzhig gi khrod nas mtshan nyid yer 'dug pa'i 'byung rkyen tsam 'god rgyu/de na bdag gi sems khral lci mo 'di'i 'byung gzhi gtso bo ni de ring gi nyin mo 'dir gangs can pa tsho'i bla srog la rmas skyon thebs shing rgyan gos kyang ral bar gyur 'dug pa de yin/ bla srog la rmas skyon ji ltar thebs 'dug zer na/ bla srog ni mig yod kyang long ba'i tshul dang rna yod kyang 'on pa'i tshul/ ngag yod kyang lkugs pa'i tshul bcas kyi brtul zhugs bzung nas 'dug dgos pa de yin/ de yang bod rigs las byed pas rang gi las gnas nas bod yig bkol e thub bya rgyu phar zhog rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod nas phan tshun bar kha brda byed skabs kyang rgya skad kho na lab pa ma zad/ rang gi bu phrug gi rgyud la bod ces pa ni rjes lus dang tha shal gyi mi rigs shig red snyam pa'i bag chags bzhag des bod rigs las byed pa'i phru gu mang por bod yig slob tu 'jug rgyu lta zhog bod skad kyang mi shes pa'i gnas su gyur/ gal te bod skad lab tshe ngo tshar brtsi ba'am yang na 249

bod lugs gso rig gi dgyed rtsom gces btus kunda dgyes pa'i zla zeska bod rigs byis pa re gnyis la khyod bod e yin zhes dris tshe/ nga bod min zer ba lta bu/ bdag gi pha yul gyi bod rigs las byed pa'i byis pa zhig la khyod bod red ces lab tshe nga bod min zer zhor ngu bzhin 'dug gnad don 'di'i skor la kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas/ khyod tshos bod skad bshad par ngo tsha na/ ma bshad na chog la/ bod lwa gyon par ngo tsha na de yang ma gon na chog mod/ 'on kyang khyod tshos sha dang rus pa ji ltar byed rgyu yin/ khyod tsho'i skye yul bod rigs khyim yin pa ni ji ltar byas kyang bsgyur thabs med/ khyod tsho'i pha mes yang mes rnams bod rigs yin/gal te khyod tsho'i byed tshul der bltas na/ khyod tshos mi rigs bsgyur rgyu red/da skabs nga tsho'i mi rigs la 'di 'dra'i bya ba ya mtshan can mang po 'dug ces gsungs pa yang don gnad la 'khel ba'i bla med bka' mchid zhig tu gda'/ spyir krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims su'ang mi rigs rang skyong sa khul du mi rigs de'i skad yig gtso bor bzung nas bkol spyod byed dgos zhes pa'i mdzub ston mchis mod/ bod yul gyi yul so so'i srid don las khungs dag tu bod yig bkol spyod mi byed cing /tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs tshang mas rgya skad bshad bzhin pa'i gnas tshul ni/ ri dwags rgyal bo seng ge yang phyi rol gyi dgras ma 'jig par rang gi khong bar gnas pa'i srin bus 'jig pa ltar/ rang re'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bod kyi shes rig 'di yang phyi'i 'gal rkyen sogs kyis ma 'jig par bod mi rang gis der dga' zhen dang bdag po ma brgyab par mthong chung 250

st+waṃbardusmo010sprusnga 0ba 116rdu(mib krordu61dzu10rdubyas nas rtsa brlag tu 'gro nyen che/dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i mgor bcings 'grol dmag bod yul du skyod skabs ting zho phing gis khyod tsho bod yul tu 'byor tshe yul de'i chos lugs dang yul srol goms gshis la brtsi bkur byed dgos pa ma zad/skad dang yi ge gnyis legs par sbyangs dgos/ de ltar ma byas tshe khyod tshor ngag yod kyang lkugs pa yin zhes bshad pa ltar/ bcings 'grol dmag mi tshos dang thog khong gi dgongs pa ltar bgyis mod/ rim bzhin dgongs don de ni ma ning gi bu bzhin gyur bar ma zad/ bod yul gyi bod pa tshos rgya skad dang rgya yig ma shes tshe ngag yod kyang lkugs par gyur/gnad don 'di'i skor la ma'o tse tung gis kyang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad yig dang rig gnas gong spel gtong bar phyogs gang thad nas rogs ram byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs yod/ gal te mi rigs gang zhig gis rang nyid kyi skad dang yi ge bkol spyod ma byas tshe mi rigs de dus thung ngu'i nang 'jig nges/ de ni dmag don pa si ta len gyis mi rigs shig rtsa stong du 'gro na thog mar mi rigs de'i skad yig rtsa stong du 'gro nges/ de bas nga tshos gong gsal gyi gnas lugs 'di yid la bzung nas rang gi lte khrag 'pho sa'i ma yum gangs ljongs 'di legs par 'dzugs skrun byed dgos na/thog mar de'i bla srog lta bur gyur ba'i skad dang yi ge la gces spras bya rgyu ni gnad dam pa yin/ de ltar ma byas tshe mi rigs dar rgyas zhes pa'i brgya bshad stong bshad kyi tshig la mdo khab rtse tsam yang med/251
